# Outbox + Integration Events 指南

:::info 发布版本来源
本页由本仓库的发布标签生成，源文件为 [`docs/guides/outbox-and-integration-events.md`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/docs/guides/outbox-and-integration-events.md)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

> 怎么在一个 Kun 服务里把一条领域事件翻译成跨服务的 Integration Event，让它原子地落库、异步地发到 RabbitMQ，并且在消费端幂等。
>
> 参考：`docs/adr/kun/ADR-015-Outbox-pattern.md` · `docs/design/why-outbox.md` · `src/Kun.EventBus/AGENTS.md`

## 适用对象

在 Kun 下游服务里新加一条跨服务消息：

- 需求是"业务写库和事件发送不能分开成功/失败"（典型双写问题）；
- 希望消费者能安全重放（`at-least-once` + 幂等）；
- 希望跨服务追踪（traceparent / tracestate）不断档。

进程内领域事件经 `IDomainEventDispatcher` 在提交前派发；只有通知 handler 显式登记的集成事件进入 Outbox。

## 原子性边界

Kun 的 Outbox 核心是：**聚合根变更 + `OutboxMessage` 行 在同一个 `SaveChangesAsync` 事务里落库**。publish 到 RabbitMQ 是由后台服务 `KunOutboxRelay` 异步做的。

```
[Command Handler]
   │
   ├── aggregate.DoSomething()            // 产生 IDomainEvent
   ├── IIntegrationEventBus.Publish(ev)   // 登记到 IntegrationEventBuffer (未落库)
   │
   └── unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync()
           │
           ├── EfUnitOfWork 收集 ChangeTracker 里的 IDomainEvent
           ├── In-process 分发，domain-event handler 往 Buffer 塞 integration events
           ├── 读取发布时已生成的 OutboxMessage 行
           │     • EventTypeId    (从 IEventTypeRegistry 查，例如 "order.placed.v1")
           │     • Payload        (完整信封，业务数据使用登记的 JsonTypeInfo 序列化)
           │     • TraceParent / TraceState  (发布时的来源与 Activity)
           │     • TenantId       (ITenantContext 注入)
           │     • Status = Pending
           ├── 把 OutboxMessage 行写入同一个 DbContext
           └── DB transaction commit ← 聚合变更 + outbox 行一起成功，或一起失败。
                                          这一步是整个 pattern 的原子边界。
```

数据库保存失败时，聚合和消息行一起回滚。当前工作单元保留消息供重试，释放请求作用域时一并释放。

## 稳定事件 ID

Integration Event 的身份标识是一个字符串，不是 CLR 类型名：

```
{bounded-context}.{event-name}.v{version}
e.g.  order.placed.v1
      inventory.changed.v2
      payment.refunded.v1
```

用 `AssemblyQualifiedName` 是**错的**——你 rename 一次、搬一个命名空间，消费端就认不出旧消息了。注册通过 `IEventTypeRegistry`（DI 注册时构建），查询通过 `IEventTypeRegistry.Resolve(string) → Type?` / `GetEventType(Type) → string?`。

版本演进：一条事件的 payload shape 变化了，**bump `.v{n}` 后缀、新增一个 CLR 类**，不要原地改 v1 的字段——在途的旧消息必须还能反序列化。

## 发布示例

场景：下单命令触发 `OrderPlaced` 整合事件，下游 `fulfillment` 服务消费它插一行待发货记录。

### 定义 Integration Event

只发布事件定义的 Contracts 包引用 `Kun.EventBus.Abstractions`，即可使用稳定标记、含 `JsonTypeInfo<T>` 的注册端口与 `Kun.Core.Domain.IIntegrationEvent`；无需引用带 Redis 和后台宿主的 `Kun.EventBus`。标记接口继续由 `Kun.Core` 定义，新包导出同一类型。应用宿主仍引用 `Kun.EventBus` 装配实际注册表与 Outbox；原包通过类型转发兼容原程序集里的三个迁移类型。

```csharp
public sealed record OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent(
    Guid OrderId,
    Guid CustomerId,
    DateTimeOffset PlacedAt);
```

Kun 不强制 marker interface（`IIntegrationEvent` 以约定存在，但发布端只看 `class` 约束 + 注册表里有没有）。把它放在 `Contracts/` 或 `IntegrationEvents/` 子目录，和下游一起维护。

### 注册事件类型

```csharp
services.AddKunEventBus(eb => eb.Register("order.placed.v1", OrderJsonContext.Default.OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent));
services.AddKunEventsBroker(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IConfiguration>().GetConnectionString("RabbitMQ")!);
services.AddKunOutboxRelay<OrderDbContext>();
```

事件登记使用源生成的 `JsonTypeInfo`。在登记了多个严格上下文的宿主中，`AddKunOutboxRelay()` 从数据目录收集上下文。普通 `KunDbContext` 使用泛型重载，每个宿主只启动一个投递服务。

### 在 Command Handler 里发布

```csharp
public sealed class PlaceOrderCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<PlaceOrderCommand, Result<Guid>>
{
    private readonly OrderDbContext _db;
    private readonly IIntegrationEventBus _events;
    private readonly IUnitOfWork _unitOfWork;

    public PlaceOrderCommandHandler(OrderDbContext db, IIntegrationEventBus events, IUnitOfWork unitOfWork)
    {
        _db = db;
        _events = events;
        _unitOfWork = unitOfWork;
    }

    public async ValueTask<Result<Guid>> Handle(PlaceOrderCommand r, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var order = Order.Place(r.CustomerId, r.Lines);
        _db.Orders.Add(order);

        // Publish 使用当前来源构造信封，捕获 trace 并将行暂存到 IntegrationEventBuffer。
        using var origin = EventEnvelopeScope.Begin(new EventOrigin("sample.order", EventActor.Service("order-service")));
        _events.Publish(new OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent(order.Id, order.CustomerId, order.PlacedAt));

        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(ct);  // ← 原子边界：聚合 + OutboxMessage 一起 commit
        return Result<Guid>.Ok(order.Id);
    }
}
```

如果 `SaveChangesAsync` 抛异常，`Publish` 登记的事件也跟着回滚；`IntegrationEventBuffer` 是 scoped 的，请求结束就释放，不会污染下一个请求。

## 消费示例

下游 `fulfillment` 服务消费 `order.placed.v1`：

```csharp
public sealed class OrderPlacedIntegrationEventHandler
    : IIntegrationEventHandler<OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent>
{
    private readonly FulfillmentDbContext _db;

    public OrderPlacedIntegrationEventHandler(FulfillmentDbContext db)
    {
        _db = db;
    }

    public ValueTask HandleAsync(
        OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent @event,
        MessageContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        // 订阅器已检查成功记录，处理器成功后才写入标记。
        // 但 at-least-once 是合约底线：Handler 必须对"重复投递"安全。
        // 做法：在 domain 层保证操作幂等（把 context.MessageId 当幂等键），
        //      或在 db 层加一个 unique index 兜底。
        _db.FulfillmentTickets.Add(new FulfillmentTicket(
            IdempotencyKey: context.MessageId,   // ← 用 message id 做业务幂等键
            OrderId: @event.OrderId,
            CreatedAt: @event.PlacedAt));
        return new ValueTask(_db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken));
    }
}
```

注册：

```csharp
services.AddKunEventBus(eb =>
{
    eb.Register("order.placed.v1", OrderJsonContext.Default.OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent);
    eb.UseRedisIdempotency();
});
services.AddKunEventsBroker(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IConfiguration>().GetConnectionString("RabbitMQ")!);
services.AddKunEventsSubscriber("fulfillment", sub => sub.Subscribe<OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent, OrderPlacedIntegrationEventHandler>("orders"));
```

宿主登记 Redis 的 `IConnectionMultiplexer`。订阅器按服务、订阅及消息 ID 查成功记录，处理器成功后写入记录并确认消息。竞争队列的消费者名为 `fulfillment.orders`，默认记录七天。处理器仍需对并发重复投递保持业务幂等。

`MessageContext` 属性：

- `MessageId` (Guid) — 一条消息的唯一 id，消费端幂等键首选。
- `EventType` (string) — 稳定事件 id，等同 `OutboxMessage.EventTypeId`。
- `OccurredOn` (DateTimeOffset) — 发布端事件发生时刻。
- `TraceParent` (string?) — 信封中的 W3C 父上下文。订阅器从 AMQP 头读取可选的 `tracestate`，创建消费 span。

## 测试

用 [`Kun.Testing.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Testing.EntityFrameworkCore) 里的 `OutboxAssertions`：

```csharp
[Fact]
public async Task PlaceOrder_stages_OrderPlaced_in_outbox()
{
    // Arrange
    var cmd = new PlaceOrderCommand(customerId: Guid.NewGuid(), lines: [...]);

    // Act
    var result = await _mediator.Send(cmd, CancellationToken.None);

    // Assert — 业务路径
    result.ShouldBeSuccess();

    // Assert — Outbox 里正好一条 order.placed.v1 行
    var outboxRow = _dbContext.ShouldHaveExactlyOneOutboxMessage("order.placed.v1");
    outboxRow.Payload.Should().Contain(result.Value.ToString());
}
```

也有 `ShouldHaveOutboxMessage` / `ShouldNotHaveOutboxMessage` 两个同家族 helper。只有 `IEnumerable<OutboxMessage>` 快照？同样三个 helper 都给了 `this IEnumerable<OutboxMessage>` 重载。

## W3C trace 传播

发布时优先使用信封作用域的 `TraceParent`，其次使用当前 W3C Activity，无可用上下文时生成新的 traceparent。当前 Activity 的 TraceState 随消息行保存。

`KunOutboxRelay` 拉到这一行时，会用 `ActivityContext.TryParse(TraceParent, TraceState, out var ctx)` 还原出 parent context，创建 publish span 作为它的 child。broker 把两个 header 透传到 consumer 侧，consumer 端同样还原后，handler 的所有 span 挂回原请求的 trace 里。

这不同于 Kun ADR-013 的 baggage 富化——baggage 是 **请求作用域**的用户维度（`tenant.id` / `user.id`），跟 trace 上下文是两回事。Outbox 传的是 **trace 上下文本身**。两者互不干扰。

## 反模式

### 1. 直接调 broker 绕过 Outbox

```csharp
// ❌ 不要
await _publisher.PublishAsync(new OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent(...));
await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
```

broker 先成功、db commit 失败的窗口里事件已经发出去了，下游已经处理了一个不存在的订单。走 `IIntegrationEventBus.Publish` + `SaveChangesAsync` 才是原子路径。

### 2. 用 AssemblyQualifiedName 当事件 ID

```csharp
// ❌ 不要
eb.Register<OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent>(typeof(OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent).AssemblyQualifiedName!);
```

命名空间 / 程序集重命名就全盘崩溃，在途消息直接无法反序列化。用稳定字符串 `"order.placed.v1"`。

### 3. 非幂等的消费 Handler

```csharp
// ❌ 不要
public ValueTask HandleAsync(OrderPlacedIntegrationEvent e, MessageContext ctx, CancellationToken ct)
{
    _metrics.IncrementCounter("orders.placed");  // 重复投递 = 计数失真
    _db.Orders.Add(new Order { Id = e.OrderId, ... });  // 重复投递 = 主键冲突
    return _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
}
```

处理器可能因并发或上次提交后进程退出而重复执行。将 `context.MessageId` 作为业务幂等键，在同一事务中保存成功记录和业务结果。

### 4. 跨 handler 修改 MessageContext

`MessageContext` 是 per-message 元数据，不是共享篮子。别给它加 mutable 字段、别用它传 app-specific state。需要跨服务传数据？塞进 integration event payload 本身。

## 边界 / 后续

Kun ADR-015 还有两个 follow-up 未 ship：

- **§F1 — 死信（dead-letter）**：`MaxAttempts` 次重试后消息进入 `Failed` 状态，目前没有自动 DLQ 表或告警。需要人工捞出来。
- **§F2 — 按租户批次优先级**：投递器按到期条件领取消息，同批按 `OccurredAt` 排序，没有 tenant-level 权重调度。时敏型 webhook SLA 下游有需求时再做。

§F3（`Kun.Testing.EntityFrameworkCore` Outbox 断言）已在 KN-SELF-014 + KN-SELF-016 ship，是上面测试小节直接调的 `OutboxAssertions`。

## 可靠性边界与迁移（S1-KUN-002）

2026-10-09 用真实 Catalog 的 `CreateProductCommandHandler`、领域通知与 PostgreSQL 实证：旧路径商品已写入而 Outbox 为 0。修复后同一断言为 1；通知失败时两者都不提交。

- `KunMediator.Send` 内的 `Publish` 复用当前命令 scope；直接调用 UoW 时默认 `InProcessDomainEventDispatcher` 通过 `IScopedPublisher` 显式复用调用方 scope。自定义领域派发器也必须如此装配，参见 Catalog 示例。通知禁止直接调用 broker 或另起持久化 scope；外部副作用应转换为集成事件。
- `EfUnitOfWork` 提交前 drain 级联领域事件，完成后才把 Buffer 加入业务上下文；数据库保存失败保留暂存消息供同 scope 重试。通知自身失败后该工作单元不可再保存，必须释放 scope 后重试整个命令，防止提交半个通知链。
- PostgreSQL 投递循环以 `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` 领取到期行并提交租约，在 broker 确认后逐条标记成功。停机交还本批未发的行，进程意外退出时其他副本等租约过期后接管。
- 宿主可在 `AddKunEvents(options => …)` 配置 `OutboxLockMode.Redis`，通过共享 `IConnectionMultiplexer` 在行租约外增加按 schema 的互斥。
- Outbox 新增可空 `NextAttemptAt` 列，首次运行前生成并应用宿主迁移。Catalog 与 Order 已附迁移。发布失败时按 `RetryBaseDelay × 2^(AttemptCount-1)` 退避，封顶一分钟；时间与失败原因一起持久化，重启后仍遵守。达到 `MaxAttempts` 后保留 Failed 行供运维处理。
- RabbitMQ 发布等待 broker confirm。普通事件使用 `mandatory: false`：没有队列绑定该事件的路由键时，broker 丢弃这条事件并照常确认，Outbox 行标为已发布，不报错也不重试。需要接收事件的宿主要在生产方发送之前部署订阅，让队列完成绑定。
- 消费端先查成功记录，执行 handler，成功标记后才 ack；失败不留成功标记。默认 Redis `idemp:{consumer}:{messageId}` 对应任务所说的 processed_messages 成功记录语义，重试成功后只有一条；已有自定义存储需实现新增 `IsProcessedAsync` 才有预查去重，否则保留至少一次执行。
- 消费失败通过持久化 quorum 重试队列做指数延迟，采用 at-least-once dead-letter 策略与 reject-publish；重试只回到原消费者组的队列，不向其他组重新广播。消息 `Type` 保留稳定事件 ID；达到上限后确认发布到 DLX。仅在重试／死信副本收到 publisher confirm 后 ack 原消息。配置依据 [RabbitMQ quorum 队列文档](https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/quorum-queues#activating-at-least-once-dead-lettering)。
- 发布与订阅各自持有连接。发布失败由持久化 Outbox 重试，消费会话中断后重连并重新声明订阅。

这些机制提供至少一次投递。broker 已确认但 Outbox 状态尚未提交、业务副作用已完成但 Redis 标记尚未写入等崩溃窗口仍会重放，写类 handler 必须通过业务幂等键或同事务消费记录避免重复副作用；不承诺跨数据库、Redis、broker 的 exactly-once。

# NuGet 包迁移指南

:::info 发布版本来源
本页由本仓库的发布标签生成，源文件为 [`docs/guides/package-migration.md`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/docs/guides/package-migration.md)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

首个合并版发布后，从平台 0.x 或内核 2026.10.25 升级的项目可按以下步骤选择版本。内核档从 nuget.org 还原，平台档从 CavaiLAB 的 GitHub Packages 还原。beta 版本的两档包均从 GitHub Packages 还原。

1. 在该版本的 GitHub Release 下载 `NuGet.config` 与 `release-packages.json`。前者列出准确的包源映射，后者列出该版本的全部包和档位。已有包源配置的项目合并相应条目。
2. 使用有读取包权限的账号与令牌设置 `KUN_PLATFORM_FEED_USER` 和 `KUN_PLATFORM_FEED_TOKEN`，然后更新项目的 `PackageReference`。采用中央包管理的项目还需更新 `Directory.Packages.props`。
3. 将使用的 Kun 包固定到同一个日历版本。使用内部接口的包之间声明精确版本依赖。运行 `dotnet restore --configfile NuGet.config`，再构建并执行项目的测试。

## 内核包的替代项

| 停发的包 | 使用方要做的调整 |
| -------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Kun.Audit` | 命令审计契约使用 `Kun.Audit.Abstractions`，按宿主选择 `Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore` 或 `Kun.Audit.Postgres`。 |
| `Kun.Auditing` | 实体变更审计迁至 `Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore`。 |
| `Kun.Dapper` | 原生 PostgreSQL 通道使用 `Kun.Data.Native.Postgres` 与 `Kun.Data.Native.Abstractions`。逐条迁移自定义 SQL。 |
| `Kun.Infrastructure` | 写侧直接使用业务 DbContext 与工作单元，读侧直接投影为查询 DTO。 |
| `Kun.MultiTenancy.EntityFrameworkCore` | 引用 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`，更新注册扩展所在的命名空间。 |
| `Kun.Saga` | 补偿编排器归档。依赖它的业务需要保留当前版本，或在应用中迁移编排与补偿逻辑后升级。 |
| `Kun.Sandbox` | 沙箱已归档。先迁移宿主中的隔离实现，再移除包引用。 |
| `Kun.Storage` | 引用 `Kun.Storage.Abstractions`，并按后端选择 `Kun.Storage.Local`、`Kun.Storage.S3` 或 `Kun.Storage.Oss`。 |

## 同名包的行为变化

- `Kun.EventBus.RabbitMQ` 使用组件事件信封与相应拓扑。升级前核对发布端与订阅端的交换机、路由键、消息形状和消费者组，协调切换生产与消费。
- `Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore` 属于平台档，升级时将这个包的源映射指向 GitHub Packages。实体审计与业务事务的接线见该版本的包说明。
- `Kun.AspNetCore` 与 `Kun.Grpc` 不再自带权限判定。HTTP 端点的 `RequireKunPermission` 与 gRPC 的授权拦截器（`AddKunAuthorizationInterceptor`）由 `Kun.Authorization.AspNetCore` 提供，它属于平台档，从 GitHub Packages 还原。原来用这两处权限判定的项目要引用它，只从 nuget.org 还原的项目要为它映射源。没有登记授权拦截器时，`Kun.Grpc` 拒绝执行标了 `[RequiresPermission]` 的方法。
- `Kun.Gateway` 提供类库。把宿主的可执行入口切到网关宿主，使用平台外壳时再引用 `Kun.Gateway.Shell`。选项类型 `KunGatewayOptions` 换成 `Kun.Gateway.Abstractions` 里的 `GatewayConfiguration`，`ExternalIssuer`、`ExternalAudience`、`InternalIssuer` 依次改名为 `IdentityIssuer`、`IdentityAudience`、`Issuer`。Redis 固定窗口计数器的类型（`IRedisRateLimitStore`、`RateLimitHitResult`、`RedisRateLimitStoreOptions`、`RedisFixedWindowRateLimitStore`）改在 `Kun.RateLimit` 命名空间，注册扩展 `AddKunRedisRateLimitStore` 改在 `Kun.RateLimit.Extensions`。
- 租户上下文使用 `Guid?` 表示租户或平台作用域。处理消息与网络输入时先验证租户标识，数据库与既有消息的文本按原有格式读写。
- `Kun.MultiTenancy` 不再提供可替换的租户解析器与选项：`DefaultTenantResolver`、`ITenantResolver`、`ITenantIdSource`、`KunMultiTenancyOptions` 与 `AddKunMultiTenancy(Action<KunMultiTenancyOptions>)` 已删除。宿主登记 `AddKunMultiTenancy()`，在认证之后挂载 `UseKunMultiTenancy()`。租户只从已认证主身份唯一的 `tenant_id` 读取，请求头不再作为来源，没有缺省租户回落。
- `Kun.Security` 的 `AddKunSecurity()` 不再登记 `ITenantContext`，`JwtTenantContext` 已删除。需要租户上下文的宿主另调 `AddKunMultiTenancy()`。
- `IKunPlugin<TConfig>` 的实现通过 `ConfigTypeInfo` 提供源生成的 JSON 元数据。使用 `JsonSerializerDefaults.Web` 保持配置属性名匹配规则。
- HTTP 错误与进程内错误使用 `Kun.Errors` 定义的错误码和 `ErrorDetail`。依赖旧错误字面或响应结构的调用方需要同步更新解析逻辑。

各项公共 API、注册方法与部署变更见[版本变更记录](/sdk/kun/releases/index.md)。

# Read-Side Patterns: Writing Query Handlers

:::info 发布版本来源
本页由本仓库的发布标签生成，源文件为 [`docs/guides/read-side-patterns.md`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/docs/guides/read-side-patterns.md)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

This guide covers the recommended patterns for query handlers in Kun. It assumes you understand
the write/read split; for the reasoning behind that split see
[docs/design/why-cqrs.md](/sdk/kun/architecture/why-cqrs.md).

***

## The Write/Read Rule

Query handlers must not use `KunDbContext`, `IUnitOfWork`, or any EF Core type. They open a
connection from an `NpgsqlDataSource`, run raw SQL with Dapper, and return flat DTOs. Kun does not
ship a read-side package: the application references Npgsql and Dapper directly. The rule is not
enforced by the build, so reviewers check that query handlers take no EF Core types.

The short version:

- Command handler: inject `IRepository<T>` or `KunDbContext` (via EF). Transactional.
- Query handler: inject `NpgsqlDataSource`. No change tracking, no aggregates.

***

## Recommended Query Handler Pattern

The standard shape for a Kun query handler:

```csharp
using Dapper;
using Kun.Core.Cqrs;
using Npgsql;

public sealed class GetProductByIdQueryHandler(NpgsqlDataSource readDataSource)
    : IRequestHandler<GetProductByIdQuery, ProductDto?>
{
    public async ValueTask<ProductDto?> Handle(
        GetProductByIdQuery request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var connection = await readDataSource.OpenConnectionAsync(cancellationToken);

        const string sql = """
            SELECT "Id",
                   "Name",
                   "Description",
                   "Price",
                   "CategoryId",
                   "Stock"
            FROM   "catalog"."catalog_products"
            WHERE  "Id" = @Id
              AND  "IsDeleted" = false
            """;

        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<ProductDto>(
            new CommandDefinition(sql, new { request.Id }, cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }
}
```

This is the handler from
`samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog/Application/Queries/GetProductByIdQueryHandler.cs`.

Key points:

- **`NpgsqlDataSource.OpenConnectionAsync`** returns an open connection from the data source's
  pool. Dispose it with `await using`; disposing returns it to the pool.
- **Parameterized SQL** via the anonymous object `new { request.Id }`. Never interpolate values
  directly into the SQL string.
- **Pass the cancellation token** through `CommandDefinition`, so a cancelled request also cancels
  the query.
- **Column names match the DTO property names** exactly (case-sensitive on PostgreSQL). The
  catalog's EF mapping keeps PascalCase column names, so the query selects them quoted; with
  snake_case columns, alias each one with `AS "PropertyName"`.
- **Schema-qualify table names.** The catalog tables live in the `catalog` schema, and the read
  connection does not set `search_path`.
- **Soft-delete filter** (`"IsDeleted" = false`) applied directly in SQL. There is no EF Core
  global filter on the read side — the SQL is the filter.
- The handler returns `null` when no row matches; the endpoint turns that into `Results.NotFound()`,
  and `Kun.Errors.AspNetCore` (`UseKunErrors()`) writes the empty 404 as an ErrorDetail with the
  error code `NOT_FOUND`.

***

## Registering the Read-Side Data Source

Register one `NpgsqlDataSource` for the read side in `Program.cs`:

```csharp
var readCs = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("CatalogDbRead") ?? writeCs;

builder.Services.AddSingleton(_ => NpgsqlDataSource.Create(readCs));
```

- The container owns the data source and disposes it on shutdown.
- Give the read side its own connection string to point it at a replica; the catalog sample
  falls back to the write connection when `ConnectionStrings:CatalogDbRead` is not set.
- If the application talks to more than one PostgreSQL database, register each data source under
  a key (`AddKeyedSingleton`) and resolve it with `[FromKeyedServices]`, so a handler cannot pick
  up the wrong one.

***

## Pagination

Kun does not ship paging types. Define the request and result shapes your API needs next to the
query:

```csharp
public sealed record ListProductsQuery(int Page = 1, int PageSize = 20) : IQuery<ProductPage>;

public sealed record ProductSummaryDto(Guid Id, string Name, decimal Price, int Stock);

public sealed record ProductPage(IReadOnlyList<ProductSummaryDto> Items, int TotalCount);
```

Run the count and the page on the same connection. Dapper's `QueryMultiple` does both in one
round trip:

```csharp
public sealed class ListProductsQueryHandler(NpgsqlDataSource readDataSource)
    : IRequestHandler<ListProductsQuery, ProductPage>
{
    public async ValueTask<ProductPage> Handle(
        ListProductsQuery request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var connection = await readDataSource.OpenConnectionAsync(cancellationToken);

        const string sql = """
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "catalog"."catalog_products" WHERE "IsDeleted" = false;
            SELECT "Id", "Name", "Price", "Stock"
            FROM   "catalog"."catalog_products"
            WHERE  "IsDeleted" = false
            ORDER  BY "Name", "Id"
            LIMIT  @PageSize OFFSET @Offset;
            """;

        var parameters = new { request.PageSize, Offset = (request.Page - 1) * request.PageSize };
        await using var multi = await connection.QueryMultipleAsync(
            new CommandDefinition(sql, parameters, cancellationToken: cancellationToken));

        var totalCount = await multi.ReadFirstAsync<int>();
        var items = (await multi.ReadAsync<ProductSummaryDto>()).ToArray();
        return new ProductPage(items, totalCount);
    }
}
```

- `Page` is 1-based; validate `Page` and `PageSize` in the query's validator.
- Order by a unique key last (`"Id"` above), so rows do not move between pages.
- For large tables, prefer keyset pagination (`WHERE ("Name", "Id") > (@AfterName, @AfterId)`)
  over `OFFSET`, which reads and discards every skipped row.

***

## DTO Design

DTOs on the read side are intentionally flat. They are shaped for the API consumer, not for the
domain model.

Rules:

- **No aggregate nesting.** A `ProductDto` does not contain an `OrderDto`. If a view needs data
  from two aggregates, join the tables in SQL.
- **No domain types.** DTOs use primitive types (`string`, `decimal`, `Guid`, `int`) or simple
  value types. Never expose `Money`, `Address`, or other value objects from the domain layer in a
  DTO — that would create a dependency on `Kun.Core` in the read result.
- **Name for the consumer, not the table.** Column aliases can differ from table column names.
  Shape the DTO for what the API consumer needs to display or act on.
- **Immutable records.** Use `sealed record` with positional properties for DTOs. Records are
  value-comparable, serializable, and clearly signal "data container, not entity".

The `ProductDto` from the catalog sample:

```csharp
// samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog/Application/Queries/ProductDto.cs
public sealed record ProductDto(
    Guid Id,
    string Name,
    string Description,
    decimal Price,
    Guid CategoryId,
    int Stock);
```

The query from `GetProductByIdQuery`:

```csharp
// samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog/Application/Queries/GetProductByIdQuery.cs
public sealed record GetProductByIdQuery(Guid Id) : IQuery<ProductDto?>;
```

`IQuery<TResponse>` is a marker interface in `Kun.Core.Cqrs` that extends `IRequest<TResponse>`.
Using `IQuery` rather than `IRequest` directly signals intent and allows pipeline behaviors to
discriminate between commands and queries at registration time.

***

## Anti-Patterns

### Do not inject KunDbContext in a query handler

```csharp
// Wrong — do not do this
public sealed class GetProductByIdQueryHandler(CatalogDbContext db)
    : IRequestHandler<GetProductByIdQuery, ProductDto?>
{
    public async ValueTask<ProductDto?> Handle(...)
    {
        return await db.Products
            .Where(p => p.Id == request.Id)
            .Select(p => new ProductDto(...))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

Problems with this pattern:

1. `CatalogDbContext` inherits `KunDbContext` which has global query filters, change tracking, and
   concurrency checks active. A query handler does not need any of this and pays the overhead.
2. `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` is not AOT-compatible (no `IsAotCompatible` in its csproj). Injecting it into a
   query handler that runs in an AOT-published service will fail at publish time with trim warnings
   or at runtime with reflection errors.
3. `UnitOfWorkPipelineBehavior` calls `SaveChangesAsync` after every registered handler in the
   write pipeline. If a query handler is registered in the same pipeline stack as a command
   handler that has `UnitOfWorkPipelineBehavior`, the query will trigger a `SaveChangesAsync`
   call. This is harmless but wasteful — and it signals a pipeline configuration mistake.

### Do not load aggregates and project at runtime

```csharp
// Wrong — loads the entire aggregate graph, then discards most of it
var product = await _repository.GetByIdAsync(request.Id, ct);
return new ProductDto(product.Id, product.Name, ...);
```

Problems:

1. Loading an aggregate through `IRepository<T>` uses EF Core change tracking. Every property on
   the entity is loaded even if the DTO only needs three of them.
2. If the aggregate has navigation properties (owned entities, collections), EF Core may issue
   additional queries. The N+1 problem manifests here.
3. The aggregate is loaded into memory, partially read, then immediately discarded. The CPU and
   allocation cost is wasted.
4. Kills AOT compatibility for the same reasons as injecting `KunDbContext` directly.

Write the SQL to return only the columns you need. If the SQL feels verbose, that verbosity is
honest — it reflects exactly what data is fetched.

***

## AOT Note

Dapper's classic API (`QueryAsync<T>`, `QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<T>`) builds the row reader for
`T` with runtime reflection, so it is not trim- or AOT-safe. Kun does not wrap Dapper. If a
service that runs query handlers is published with Native AOT, choose one of these in that
service's own project:

- add Dapper's source generator (the `Dapper.AOT` package) and mark the query methods with
  `[DapperAot]`, so the reader is generated at build time; or
- read rows with `NpgsqlDataReader` directly and construct the DTOs by hand.

Either way, `dotnet publish -p:PublishAot=true` with warnings as errors catches a reflection-based
read path before deployment. The catalog sample is not AOT-published and uses the classic API.

# SaaS 多租户策略选型指南

:::info 发布版本来源
本页由本仓库的发布标签生成，源文件为 [`docs/guides/saas-multitenancy.md`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/docs/guides/saas-multitenancy.md)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

> Kun Framework 通过 `Kun.Core.MultiTenancy` + `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy` 提供三种 SaaS 数据隔离策略：**Row** / **Schema** / **Database**。本文档帮你在合规、运维成本、租户规模三个维度上做出取舍，并给出各自的落地配方。
>
> 参考：[`docs/adr/kun/adr-p2d-multitenancy.md`](/sdk/kun/architecture/adr-p2d-multitenancy.md) · 白皮书 §12.2

***

## TL;DR 选型决策树

```
租户数 > 数百?
├─ 是 → 合规需要"单租户数据导出"?
│       ├─ 是 → Schema
│       └─ 否 → Row
└─ 否 → 单租户数据量 > 数百 GB 或强合规（金融/医疗/GDPR 数据主权）?
        ├─ 是 → Database
        └─ 否 → Schema（或 Row 若对合规无硬要求）
```

## 对比表

| 维度 | **Row**（共享库） | **Schema**（独立 Schema） | **Database**（独立库） |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **隔离层级** | 应用层（`TenantId` 列 + 全局查询过滤器）+ PostgreSQL RLS 兜底 | 同库不同 schema | 完全独立的数据库实例 |
| **典型租户规模** | 数千到数十万 | 几百到几千 | 最多数百 |
| **单租户数据量** | 小（\< 几十 GB） | 中（几十 GB - 几百 GB） | 任意 |
| **合规友好度** | 普通 B2B SaaS | 支持"单租户导出"（pg_dump schema） | 强合规（数据主权、独立备份/RPO/RTO） |
| **运维成本** | 最低（单一数据库） | 中（schema 数量线性增长） | 高（数据库数量线性增长，secrets 管理） |
| **迁移执行时机** | App 启动时 `Database.MigrateAsync` | 租户开户时 `ITenantProvisioner.ProvisionAsync` | 租户开户时 `ITenantProvisioner.ProvisionAsync` |
| **实现基础件** | `AddKunTenantRls()` + `IMultiTenant` 全局过滤器（已落地 Sprint 1） | `AddKunMultiTenancy<T>(o => o.Strategy = Schema)` + `ITenantDbContextFactory<T>`（Part 2） | `AddKunMultiTenancy<T>(o => o.Strategy = Database)` + `IDbConnectionResolver`（Part 3） |
| **跨租户查询** | 原生支持（`IgnoreQueryFilters`） | 不支持（需要单独的 `AdminDbContext` 枚举 schema） | 不支持（需要枚举所有连接） |

***

## 策略一：Row

### 适用场景

- 租户数量大、单租户数据量小的 B2B SaaS（协作工具、CRM、业务仪表板）
- 合规要求普通（租户隔离满足"查询过滤 + defence-in-depth"即可）

### 落地配方

```csharp
// Program.cs
builder.Services.AddKunEntityFrameworkCore();
builder.Services.AddKunTenantRls();               // 启用 RLS 拦截器
builder.Services.AddDbContext<CatalogDbContext>((sp, opts) =>
{
    opts.UseNpgsql(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("Default"));
    opts.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor>());
});
```

请求范围里的 `ITenantContext.TenantId` 为 `Guid?`。平台范围使用 `null`。实体的 `IMultiTenant.TenantId` 与 PostgreSQL 的行级策略使用同一份小写、带连字符的 UUID 文本。

实体实现 `IMultiTenant`。

```csharp
public class Product : AggregateRoot<Guid>, IMultiTenant
{
    public string TenantId { get; private set; } = default!;
    public string Name { get; private set; } = default!;
    // ...
}
```

### 数据库侧 RLS 策略

```sql
-- 在 products 表上启用 RLS
ALTER TABLE products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON products
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true));
```

`TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor` 会在每笔事务开始时执行 `set_config('app.current_tenant_id', @t, true)`，配合 PgBouncer transaction-pool 模式工作正常。

***

## 策略二：Schema

### 适用场景

- 租户数适中、需要"单租户逻辑导出"（`pg_dump -n <tenant>`）
- 每个租户共享同一 Postgres 实例但 schema 级隔离（兼顾合规与运维成本）

### 落地配方

```csharp
// 1. 注册策略 + 消费者自己的 ITenantDbContextFactory
builder.Services.AddKunMultiTenancy<CatalogDbContext>(o =>
{
    o.Strategy = TenantIsolation.Schema;
});

builder.Services.AddSingleton<ITenantDbContextFactory<CatalogDbContext>, CatalogTenantDbContextFactory>();

// 2. DbContext 在 OnConfiguring 读取当前租户，按 tenant_id 切 schema
builder.Services.AddDbContext<CatalogDbContext>((sp, opts) =>
{
    var tenantId = sp.GetRequiredService<ITenantContext>().TenantId
        ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Tenant required.");
    var schema = sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<KunMultiTenancyOptions>>().Value.GetSchemaName(tenantId);
    opts.UseNpgsql(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("Default"))
        .UseKunSchema(schema)  // 上下文的 DefaultSchema 应使用相同的名称
        .ReplaceService<IModelCacheKeyFactory, KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory>();
});

// 3. Consumer 自己实现 factory（~10 lines）
public sealed class CatalogTenantDbContextFactory : ITenantDbContextFactory<CatalogDbContext>
{
    private readonly string _connectionString;
    private readonly KunMultiTenancyOptions _tenancy;
    public CatalogTenantDbContextFactory(IConfiguration cfg, IOptions<KunMultiTenancyOptions> tenancy)
    {
        _connectionString = cfg.GetConnectionString("Default")!;
        _tenancy = tenancy.Value;
    }
    public CatalogDbContext CreateForTenant(Guid tenantId)
    {
        var opts = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<CatalogDbContext>()
            .UseNpgsql(_connectionString).UseKunSchema(_tenancy.GetSchemaName(tenantId)).Options;
        return new CatalogDbContext(opts, new FixedTenantContext(tenantId));
    }
}

// 4. 租户开户时调 provisioner
await provisioner.ProvisionAsync(new TenantInfo(tenantId));   // 自动 CREATE SCHEMA + migrations
```

`KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory` 确保每个租户有独立的 EF 模型缓存键（否则第一个租户的已编译模型会被第二个租户复用，schema 错位）。

默认架构名由 `tenant_` 和去掉连字符的 32 位小写 UUID 组成。开户器和上下文工厂使用同一项 `SchemaPrefix`。已有按旧标识命名的租户架构需要在切换前迁移。

### 运维注意

- 迁移无法在 app 启动时批量跑（可能还没注册所有租户），必须走 `ITenantProvisioner` 的开户钩子。
- Deprovision 默认抛 `NotSupportedException`；设 `AllowDestructiveDeprovision = true` 才会 `DROP SCHEMA ... CASCADE`。

***

## 策略三：Database

### 适用场景

- 强合规（金融、医疗、GDPR 数据主权 = 不同租户数据不同地理分区）
- 单租户数据量大（单库 > 500 GB），需要独立备份/复制/RPO/RTO
- 租户数量较少（运维成本与租户数线性相关）

### 落地配方

```csharp
// 1. 注册策略（默认 resolver 从 TenantsConnectionOptions 读）
builder.Services.Configure<TenantsConnectionOptions>(
    builder.Configuration.GetSection(TenantsConnectionOptions.SectionName));
builder.Services.AddKunMultiTenancy<CatalogDbContext>(o =>
{
    o.Strategy = TenantIsolation.Database;
});

// 2. Consumer factory 按 tenant 解析连接字符串
public sealed class CatalogTenantDbContextFactory : ITenantDbContextFactory<CatalogDbContext>
{
    private readonly IDbConnectionResolver _resolver;
    public CatalogTenantDbContextFactory(IDbConnectionResolver resolver) { _resolver = resolver; }
    public CatalogDbContext CreateForTenant(Guid tenantId)
    {
        var opts = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<CatalogDbContext>()
            .UseNpgsql(_resolver.ResolveConnectionString(tenantId)).Options;
        return new CatalogDbContext(opts, new FixedTenantContext(tenantId));
    }
}
```

appsettings.json：

```json
{
  "Kun": {
    "MultiTenancy": {
      "Tenants": {
        "ConnectionStrings": {
          "01900000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001": "Host=db-acme;Database=catalog;Username=u;Password=p",
          "01900000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002": "Host=db-fabrikam;Database=catalog;Username=u;Password=p"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### 关键约束

- **连接串表的键是租户 UUID 的小写 D 格式**：配置里的 `ConnectionStrings` 节先绑定到 `TenantsConnectionOptions.ConfiguredConnectionStrings`，宿主启动时校验每个键并并入 `ConnectionStrings`，默认 resolver 从后者读。键不是非空的小写 D 格式 UUID（大写、带花括号、不带连字符的都不行），或同一租户在代码与配置里给了不同的连接串，宿主启动失败，错误信息里写出那个键。代码里直接写 `ConnectionStrings`。
- **数据库 _创建_ 不在框架责任范围**：`DatabasePerTenantProvisioner.ProvisionAsync` 假设数据库已由运维流水线（Terraform / K8s Operator / 云 API）创建好，只跑 `Database.MigrateAsync` 拉齐 schema。如需自动 `CREATE DATABASE`，继承 `DatabasePerTenantProvisioner<T>` 覆盖 `ProvisionAsync`。
- **`DeprovisionAsync` 默认 no-op**：删除租户数据库的决策需要运维流程（连接池、复制、备份），框架不越权。
- **跨租户查询反模式**：禁止在 Command handler 里遍历所有连接做聚合查询。如需租户级管理视图，单独建一个 `AdminDbContext` 显式枚举连接池，并用不同的 `ICurrentUser` 角色守卫。

***

## 共通设计原则

1. **三种策略不混用于同一 `DbContext` 类型**：选一种注册，不要运行时切换（`IOptionsMonitor` 的 Strategy 变化不会重新连线 DI）。
2. **请求租户仅在对应的作用域内有效**。`AddKunMultiTenancy()` 默认登记单例上下文。HTTP 与 gRPC 在认证后使用 `Kun.MultiTenancy.TenantRequestBoundary` 进入请求作用域。消费端可把已经授权的租户传给 `TenantContextPropagator.BeginScope`，在处理完成时释放作用域。
3. **迁移工具链**：`dotnet ef migrations add` 需要 design-time `ITenantContext`。本仓库的 sample 使用 `DesignTimeTenantContext` 返回 `"public"` 作为占位符，避免 design-time 挂空依赖。

***

## 相关代码

- `src/Kun.Core/MultiTenancy/` — `ITenantContext`、`TenantIsolation`、`TenantInfo`、`ITenantProvisioner`、`NullTenantProvisioner`
- `src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/MultiTenancy/` — 全部三种策略的运行时件（`KunMultiTenancyOptions`、`ITenantDbContextFactory<T>`、`KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory`、`SchemaPerTenantProvisioner<T>`、`DatabasePerTenantProvisioner<T>`、`IDbConnectionResolver`、`OptionsBasedTenantConnectionResolver`、`TenantsConnectionOptions`、`KunMultiTenancyServiceCollectionExtensions`）
- `src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/Interceptors/TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor.cs` — Row 策略的 RLS defence-in-depth
- `docs/adr/kun/adr-p2d-multitenancy.md` — 设计取舍完整 ADR

# Schema-per-service with `KunDbContext`

:::info 发布版本来源
本页由本仓库的发布标签生成，源文件为 [`docs/guides/schema-per-service.md`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/docs/guides/schema-per-service.md)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

> **Scope**: how to run multiple Kun-based services against a single PostgreSQL
> instance by giving each service its own schema (`catalog`, `order`, …), with
> business tables, the Outbox, and the EF migrations-history table
> all co-located under that schema.
>
> Applies to: any `KunDbContext`-derived DbContext using `Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL`.
>
> Last updated: 2026-04-22.

## Why schema-per-service

Running many services against one physical Postgres instance is operationally
cheap (one cluster to patch, one backup path, one connection pool). But putting
everything in `public` makes name collisions inevitable — two services both want
an `outbox_messages`, an `__ef_migrations_history`, and so on.

Kun's answer: each service overrides `KunDbContext.DefaultSchema` with its own
name (`"catalog"`, `"order"`, etc.), and `UseKunSchema(schema)` on the options
builder wires the migrations-history table into the same schema. A
`SchemaConsistencyInterceptor` then fails fast at the first `SaveChangesAsync`
if the two ever disagree, so misconfigurations surface in dev instead of
silently leaking rows across schemas in production.

## End-to-end recipe

### 1. Override `DefaultSchema` on your DbContext

```csharp
using Kun.Core.MultiTenancy;
using Kun.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

public sealed class CatalogDbContext : KunDbContext
{
    public DbSet<Product> Products => Set<Product>();

    public CatalogDbContext(
        DbContextOptions<CatalogDbContext> options,
        ITenantContext tenantContext)
        : base(options, tenantContext)
    {
    }

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    protected override string? DefaultSchema => "catalog";

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder); // applies HasDefaultSchema(DefaultSchema)
        modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new ProductConfiguration());
    }
}
```

`KunDbContext.OnModelCreating` calls `modelBuilder.HasDefaultSchema(DefaultSchema)`
before applying the Outbox and tenant-filter configurations, so every
unqualified `.ToTable("x")` lands under `catalog`.

### 2. Chain `UseKunSchema("catalog")` in the design-time factory and DI

The design-time factory drives `dotnet ef migrations add`:

```csharp
using Kun.Core.MultiTenancy;
using Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.Extensions; // UseKunSchema lives here
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design;

internal sealed class CatalogDesignTimeFactory
    : IDesignTimeDbContextFactory<CatalogDbContext>
{
    public CatalogDbContext CreateDbContext(string[] args)
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<CatalogDbContext>()
            .UseNpgsql("Host=localhost;Database=catalog_design;Username=postgres;Password=postgres")
            .UseKunSchema("catalog")   // wires MigrationsHistoryTableSchema
            .Options;

        return new CatalogDbContext(options, NullTenantContext.Instance);
    }
}
```

Same pattern in the runtime `AddDbContext` call:

```csharp
services.AddDbContext<CatalogDbContext>((_, options) =>
    options
        .UseNpgsql(connectionString)
        .UseKunSchema("catalog"));
```

Order matters: `.UseNpgsql(...)` must precede `.UseKunSchema(...)` so the
relational provider extension already exists by the time `UseKunSchema` mutates
`MigrationsHistoryTableSchema`.

### 3. Regenerate migrations under the new schema

For an existing service already carrying `public`-schema migrations, regenerate
them once:

```bash
# Remove the old public-schema migrations
dotnet ef migrations remove \
  --project samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog \
  --startup-project samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog \
  --force

# Re-add under the new schema — the DesignTimeFactory's UseKunSchema("catalog")
# drives the correct MigrationsHistoryTable schema.
dotnet ef migrations add Initial_SchemaQualified \
  --project samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog \
  --startup-project samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog \
  --output-dir Infrastructure/Migrations
```

Inspect the generated `_Initial_SchemaQualified.cs` — every `CreateTable` /
`CreateIndex` / `DropTable` call now carries `schema: "catalog"`, and the
generated `ModelSnapshot.cs` starts with `.HasDefaultSchema("catalog")`.

#### Windows / Git Bash note

Both of the commands above must run with `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` in Git Bash,
otherwise `--project` values get path-mangled:

```bash
MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 dotnet ef migrations add Initial_SchemaQualified \
  --project samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog \
  --startup-project samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog \
  --output-dir Infrastructure/Migrations
```

Run the two services' `dotnet ef migrations add` commands **sequentially**
(not in parallel) — they compete for the same `src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`
build artefacts.

### 4. Create the schemas in Postgres

`dotnet ef database update` will call `EnsureSchema("catalog")` via the
generated migration, so in most cases you do nothing. For a plain
`EnsureCreatedAsync()` flow (tests / quick prototyping), EF also issues
`CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS catalog`. You can create the schemas ahead of
time if you want the service accounts to have restricted grants:

```sql
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS catalog;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "order";  -- note: 'order' is reserved, quote it
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA catalog TO svc_catalog;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA "order" TO svc_order;
```

### 5. Verify with `dotnet ef migrations list`

After migrations regenerate, confirm the history table lives in the right
schema:

```bash
dotnet ef migrations list --project samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog
# shows catalog.__ef_migrations_history
dotnet ef migrations list --project samples/Kun.Sample.Order
# shows order.__ef_migrations_history
```

## The safety net: `SchemaConsistencyInterceptor`

`KunDbContext.OnConfiguring` unconditionally registers a
`SchemaConsistencyInterceptor` whose job is exactly one thing: compare
`Model.GetDefaultSchema()` against the relational provider's
`MigrationsHistoryTableSchema` at the first `SaveChangesAsync`, and throw
`InvalidOperationException` with a remediation hint when they diverge.

This catches the most common error — overriding `DefaultSchema` on your
DbContext but forgetting to call `UseKunSchema(...)` on the options builder.
Without the interceptor, business tables would land under `catalog` while
`__ef_migrations_history` silently stays in `public`, a migration-drift
timebomb. With the interceptor, the first save fails loudly:

```
InvalidOperationException: KunDbContext.DefaultSchema='catalog' does not match
MigrationsHistoryTable schema='(null)'. Call .UseKunSchema("catalog") on
DbContextOptionsBuilder to wire both consistently.
```

The check is gated by `Interlocked.CompareExchange` so it runs exactly once
per DbContext instance — zero overhead after the first transaction.

## Outbox co-location

Because the `KunDbContext` base class applies `HasDefaultSchema(DefaultSchema)`
**before** `ApplyConfiguration(new OutboxMessageConfiguration())`, the Outbox
table inherits the same schema without any extra configuration.

This is deliberate — having `catalog.outbox_messages` in the same schema as
`catalog.catalog_products` lets a single transaction atomically commit both,
which is the entire point of the Outbox pattern. Putting the outbox in a
shared `outbox` schema would break that atomicity story (cross-schema writes
still commit atomically, but the operational mental model gets muddier, and
separate grants / backup policies become harder to reason about).

## Running multiple services against one PostgreSQL

Once each service has its own schema, they can target the same physical
Postgres instance and the same logical database. Aspire wires this up
trivially — the `Kun.Sample.AppHost` sample points `Catalog` and `Order` at
the same `postgres` resource:

```csharp
var postgres = builder.AddPostgres("postgres");
var kun = postgres.AddDatabase("kun");

builder.AddProject<Projects.Kun_Sample_Catalog>("catalog")
    .WithReference(kun);
builder.AddProject<Projects.Kun_Sample_Order>("order")
    .WithReference(kun);
```

With schema-per-service in place, the two services coexist without name
collisions — each `SELECT * FROM catalog.outbox_messages` stays well-scoped.

## Reference implementation

- `src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/KunDbContext.cs` — `DefaultSchema` virtual
  property + auto-registration of the interceptor.
- `src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/Extensions/KunDbContextOptionsBuilderExtensions.cs` —
  the `UseKunSchema` extension.
- `src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/Interceptors/SchemaConsistencyInterceptor.cs` —
  the fail-fast guard.
- `samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog/Infrastructure/CatalogDbContext.cs` + migrations —
  concrete example with a `catalog` schema.
- `samples/Kun.Sample.Order/Infrastructure/OrderDbContext.cs` + migrations —
  concrete example with an `order` schema.
- `tests/Kun.IntegrationTests/Persistence/SchemaPerServiceTests.cs` —
  Testcontainers-backed test that boots two `KunDbContext` subclasses under
  distinct schemas against one Postgres and asserts physical isolation in
  `information_schema.tables`.

# Tracing Tour: Reading Distributed Traces in the Aspire Dashboard

:::info 发布版本来源
本页由本仓库的发布标签生成，源文件为 [`docs/guides/tracing-tour.md`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/docs/guides/tracing-tour.md)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

This document walks through the OpenTelemetry traces you will see when running the Kun sample
stack via `dotnet run --project samples/Kun.Sample.AppHost`. It assumes Docker and the Aspire
workload are installed and the stack is running. For setup instructions see
[docs/getting-started.md](/sdk/kun/getting-started.md).

***

## W3C Trace Context and OTLP

Every Kun service propagates traces using the
[W3C Trace Context](https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/) standard. Each in-process span records
a `traceparent` header that carries the `TraceId` and `SpanId`. When a request crosses a process
boundary — HTTP, gRPC, or the Outbox — the receiving side extracts the parent context and creates
a child span under the same `TraceId`. The result is a single trace tree that spans every hop
from the initial HTTP request to the final consumer acknowledgement.

Spans are exported via OTLP. When running under .NET Aspire the `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`
environment variable is set automatically to the Aspire Dashboard's collector endpoint. The
Dashboard collects and renders all spans without any additional configuration in the services
themselves. Framework modules (`src/Kun.*`) contain no OTel package dependencies — all
`AddKunObservability` wiring lives in the sample composition root
(`samples/Kun.Sample.Shared/OpenTelemetryExtensions.cs`) so the framework remains AOT-clean.

***

## What Instruments What

### Kun.Mediator

**ActivitySource name:** `Kun.Mediator`

`TracingBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>` wraps every `ISender.Send` and `IPublisher.Publish` call
(see `src/Kun.Mediator/Behaviors/TracingBehavior.cs`). It starts an `ActivityKind.Internal` span
named `Mediator.Send {RequestTypeName}` — for example `Mediator.Send CreateProductCommand` or
`Mediator.Send GetProductByIdQuery`.

The span is a child of the ambient activity at dispatch time, which is typically the ASP.NET Core
server span for the incoming HTTP request. Because the Mediator span is internal, it appears as a
nested block directly under the HTTP span in the Dashboard timeline.

Tags set on this span:

| Tag | Value |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| (none beyond span name) | The request type name is encoded in the span name |

If you want to add custom tags (e.g. command ID, tenant ID), do so from within the handler by
calling `Activity.Current?.SetTag(...)`.

### Kun.EventBus.EntityFrameworkCore

**ActivitySource name:** `Kun.EventBus.EntityFrameworkCore`

The EF relay creates one `ActivityKind.Producer` span named `outbox.publish` for each delivery
attempt. The envelope writer stores the W3C parent identifier and trace state with the Outbox
row during the command. The relay restores that parent before handing the stored envelope to
the configured publisher. A retry creates another span with the same message ID.

Tags set on `outbox.publish`:

| Tag | Value |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `messaging.system` | `outbox` |
| `messaging.destination` | Stable event type ID, e.g. `product.published.v1` |
| `messaging.message_id` | UUID of the `OutboxMessage` row |

### Kun.Grpc

**ActivitySource name:** `Kun.Grpc`

`KunTracingInterceptor` (see `src/Kun.Grpc/Interceptors/KunTracingInterceptor.cs`) runs first in
the interceptor chain registered by `AddKunGrpc`. It starts an `ActivityKind.Server` span named
`grpc.server` for each unary, client-streaming, server-streaming or duplex RPC call. The span
remains active until the awaited handler completes, including all stream operations.

Tags set:

| Tag | Value |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rpc.system` | `grpc` |
| `rpc.method` | Full gRPC method path, e.g. `/catalog.CatalogService/GetProduct` |
| `rpc.type` | `unary`, `client_streaming`, `server_streaming` or `duplex_streaming` |
| `rpc.grpc.status_code` | Final gRPC status code; faults also mark the activity as Error |

If a downstream service calls a Kun gRPC service, the caller's `HttpClient` instruments propagate
the `traceparent` header via the standard gRPC client instrumentation wired in
`AddKunObservability`. The server interceptor picks up the parent context automatically from the
incoming metadata — `ActivityKind.Server` causes the OTel SDK to look for an inbound W3C header.

***

## How to Read a Happy-Path Trace

Place an order using the Catalog and Order endpoints in the [getting started walkthrough](/sdk/kun/getting-started.md).
Find its `POST /demo/orders` request in the Aspire Dashboard.

1. The mediator span contains the gRPC stock reservation for each order line.
2. The handler stages an `order.completed.v1` envelope in the same transaction as the order.
   The envelope carries the producer, actor, message ID and W3C trace parent.
3. The EF relay claims the row and opens `outbox.publish` with its stored parent. The Order
   sample logs the delivery. Its span tags include the event type and message ID.
4. In a host configured with RabbitMQ, the publisher sends the envelope to `qian.events`
   under the subject `order.completed`. A registered subscriber restores the envelope's parent
   for its `consume order.completed` span and acknowledges after successful processing.
   The publish and consume spans share the trace that the command stored in the envelope.

***

## How to Read Outbox Lag

Outbox lag is the time between when an integration event was enqueued (the producer's
`SaveChangesAsync` commit) and when it was actually published to the broker (the
`outbox.publish` span).

To measure lag in the Dashboard:

1. Find the `Mediator.Send` span for a command that produces an integration event (e.g.
   `CreateProductCommand`).
2. Note its **end timestamp** — this is approximately when `SaveChangesAsync` committed and the
   outbox row was written.
3. Find the `outbox.publish` span for the same message (match by `messaging.message_id`, or by
   `messaging.destination` + approximate time).
4. The **start timestamp** of `outbox.publish` minus the end timestamp of the producer span is
   the outbox lag for that message.

The EF relay immediately polls again after a nonempty batch. The following defaults apply to
`KunEventsOptions` in the publisher host.

| Setting | Default | Effect |
| ---------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `BatchSize` | 100 | Maximum rows claimed per context per cycle |
| `PollInterval` | 1 second | Delay after an empty cycle |
| `PublishTimeout` | 10 seconds | Confirmation deadline per message |
| `LeaseDuration` | 30 seconds | Other replicas can claim unfinished rows after expiry |
| `MaxAttempts` | 5 | Maximum attempts after transient failures |
| `RetryBaseDelay` | 1 second | Initial exponential backoff |

A message in `OutboxStatus.Failed` will not be retried automatically. Monitor for `Failed` rows
in the `outbox_messages` table and alert on them — they represent messages that could not be
delivered after all attempts.

***

## Pitfalls and Common Gaps

### Background services that do not start an activity

`KunOutboxRelay` is a `BackgroundService` implementation.
Its `ExecuteAsync` loop does not have an ambient `Activity` unless one is explicitly started.
This means:

- Any log message emitted inside the loop but outside a span will have no `TraceId` attached in
  structured logs.
- Any child activity started without an explicit parent context appears as a root span in OTLP.

If you add custom background services to your application and want their spans connected to
a broader trace, you must restore the parent context manually — the same pattern used by
`KunOutboxRelay` with `ActivityContext.TryParse`.

### async void timers and fire-and-forget

Avoid `async void` methods and `_ = Task.Run(...)` inside handlers or background services.
Exceptions thrown on `async void` paths crash the process without ending any open spans, leaving
dangling incomplete spans in the Dashboard. Use `async Task` and `await` throughout.

### Gateway observability

The standalone `Kun.Gateway` host registers `AddKunObservability` with service name
`kun-gateway`, configured through `KunObservability`. EF instrumentation is disabled because
this host does not access EF. Native AOT hosts must set `IncludeEfCore=false`; a runtime-feature
guard removes that reflection-based path at link time and rejects attempts to enable it at runtime. ASP.NET request spans cover proxy and JWKS requests, while
HttpClient instrumentation covers downstream calls; there is no separate custom transform span.
The gateway remains in the Native AOT audit. Consumers that reference the gateway package in
their own host choose their own observability registration.

### Key span names to recognize at a glance

| Span name | Source | Meaning |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `Mediator.Send {Type}` | `Kun.Mediator` | A command or query was dispatched |
| `outbox.publish` | `Kun.EventBus.EntityFrameworkCore` | An outbox row was published to the broker |
| `consume {subject}` | `Kun.EventBus.RabbitMQ` | The subscriber dispatched an envelope |
| `grpc.server` | `Kun.Grpc` | A unary or streaming gRPC call was handled |

# Command 校验指南（Kun.Validation）

:::info 发布版本来源
本页由本仓库的发布标签生成，源文件为 [`docs/guides/validating-commands.md`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/docs/guides/validating-commands.md)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

> 怎么在一个 Command/Query Handler 上挂校验，并且让失败以 `Result.Fail(...)`（错误码 `INPUT_INVALID`，带逐项字段错误）而不是异常的形式流到调用方。
>
> 参考：`docs/adr/kun/ADR-011-Result-async-extensions.md` · `docs/adr/kun/ADR-014-Validation-Result-behavior.md`

## 适用对象

在下游服务里新加一条 Command/Query，打算：

- 用 `IRequest<Result>` 或 `IRequest<Result<TValue>>` 返回业务结果（而不是抛 `ErrorException` 让 HTTP / gRPC 宿主翻译）；
- 在 Handler 之外把"请求形状合法性"（非空、长度、枚举范围等）挡住；
- 写单元测试时能直接断言 `result.Error.Code` 是 `PlatformErrors.InputInvalid`，不需要 `Assert.ThrowsAsync<ErrorException>`。

如果你只写内部小工具、Handler 返回 `TResponse` 且可以接受异常语义，见下方 `ValidationPipelineBehavior` 路径；否则默认选 Result 路径。

## 选型决策树

Kun.Validation 目前出三个 Pipeline Behavior，按 Handler 响应类型二选一：

| Handler 响应签名 | 选的 Behavior | 失败时的行为 | 注册扩展 |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `IRequest<TResponse>`（非 Result） | `ValidationPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>` | 抛 `ErrorException` | `AddValidationBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>()` |
| `IRequest<Result<TValue>>` | `ValidationResultPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TValue>` | 返回 `Result<TValue>.Fail(error)` | `AddValidationResultBehavior<TRequest, TValue>()` |
| `IRequest<Result>`（无返回值命令） | `ValidationResultPipelineBehavior<TRequest>` | 返回 `Result.Fail(error)` | `AddValidationResultBehavior<TRequest>()` |

三个 Behavior 给出的是同一个 `Kun.Errors.Error`：错误码 `PlatformErrors.InputInvalid`（`INPUT_INVALID`，400），`Errors` 按校验器的注册顺序列出各校验器给的字段错误，至多 100 项（ErrorDetail 契约的上限，多出的丢弃）。HTTP 宿主装了 `Kun.Errors.AspNetCore`（`AddKunErrors()` 加 `UseKunErrors()`）时，抛出版的异常、Result 版经 `EnsureSuccess()` 抛出的异常都写成 problem+json 的 ErrorDetail，`errors[]` 的每一项是字段错误码加 JSON Pointer。

> **铁律**：同一 `TRequest` 不要同时注册抛出版 + Result 版。Pipeline 会按注册顺序串成链，同一组校验器跑两遍，先注册的那个决定失败的形状（抛异常还是返回 Result），后一个形同虚设。Kun 不在运行时拦截该错配（成本高、场景罕见），只靠 Code Review + 这份文档挡。

## 例 1：`Result<TValue>` 命令

场景：下单命令 `CreateOrderCommand → Result<OrderDto>`，两个校验器（数量 > 0、产品 ID 不为空）。

### Command + Validator

```csharp
public sealed record CreateOrderCommand(Guid ProductId, int Quantity)
    : IRequest<Result<OrderDto>>;

public sealed class CreateOrderQuantityValidator : IValidator<CreateOrderCommand>
{
    public ValueTask<ValidationResult> ValidateAsync(
        CreateOrderCommand instance,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (instance.Quantity > 0) return ValueTask.FromResult(ValidationResult.Success);

        return ValueTask.FromResult(ValidationResult.Failure(
        [
            new FieldError(PlatformErrors.OutOfRange, ErrorPointer.Input("quantity")),
        ]));
    }
}

public sealed class CreateOrderProductIdValidator : IValidator<CreateOrderCommand>
{
    public ValueTask<ValidationResult> ValidateAsync(
        CreateOrderCommand instance,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (instance.ProductId != Guid.Empty) return ValueTask.FromResult(ValidationResult.Success);

        return ValueTask.FromResult(ValidationResult.Failure(
        [
            new FieldError(PlatformErrors.Required, ErrorPointer.Input("productId")),
        ]));
    }
}
```

一项字段错误是两样东西：错误码与出错位置。

- 错误码用平台内置的字段级错误码，与 JSON Schema 的关键字一一对应：`REQUIRED`、`TYPE_MISMATCH`、`VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED`、`OUT_OF_RANGE`、`PATTERN_MISMATCH`、`FORMAT_INVALID`、`UNKNOWN_PROPERTY`（`PlatformErrors` 上的同名字段）；也可以用组件自己登记的业务错误码。
- 位置是指向请求体的 JSON Pointer，按客户端提交的成员名写（这里请求体是 camelCase）。用 `ErrorPointer.Input(...)` 拼，数组下标传整数：`ErrorPointer.Input("items", 0, "qty")` 得到 `#/items/0/qty`。
- 取值受限时可以带上允许值：`new FieldError(PlatformErrors.ValueNotAllowed, ErrorPointer.Input("purpose")) { Allowed = AllowedValues.Of("attachment", "avatar") }`。

校验器不写文案：响应里的 `message` 按请求语言从错误码目录里取。

### DI 注册

```csharp
services.AddValidator<CreateOrderCommand, CreateOrderQuantityValidator>();
services.AddValidator<CreateOrderCommand, CreateOrderProductIdValidator>();

services.AddKunMediator(mediator =>
{
    mediator.AddValidationResultBehavior<CreateOrderCommand, OrderDto>();
    // mediator.AddRequestHandler<...>() — 由源生成器自动填
});
```

`AddValidator<,>` 挂在 `IServiceCollection`，`AddValidationResultBehavior<,>` 挂在 `KunMediatorBuilder`——分开是因为 Validator 是按请求类型注册的 transient，Behavior 是 Mediator pipeline 链上的一环。

### Handler

Handler 直接写成功路径；Validator 失败时 Behavior 已经短路，Handler 不会被调到。Handler 里的业务失败优先用组件登记的具体错误码（`ErrorCode.Business(...)` 定义，`AddKunErrors(catalog => catalog.Register(...))` 登记）；通用的 404、409 可以直接用 `PlatformErrors.NotFound`、`PlatformErrors.Conflict`。

```csharp
public sealed class CreateOrderCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<CreateOrderCommand, Result<OrderDto>>
{
    public async ValueTask<Result<OrderDto>> Handle(
        CreateOrderCommand request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // 走到这里时 Quantity > 0 且 ProductId != Guid.Empty 已成立。
        var product = await _products.GetAsync(request.ProductId, cancellationToken);
        if (product is null)
            return Result<OrderDto>.Fail(new Error(PlatformErrors.NotFound));

        var order = await _orders.CreateAsync(product, request.Quantity, cancellationToken);
        return Result<OrderDto>.Ok(OrderDto.From(order));
    }
}
```

### 测试

```csharp
[Fact]
public async Task Validator_fails_returns_input_invalid()
{
    var services = new ServiceCollection();
    services.AddValidator<CreateOrderCommand, CreateOrderQuantityValidator>();
    services.AddKunMediator(m =>
    {
        m.AddRequestHandler<CreateOrderCommand, Result<OrderDto>, CreateOrderCommandHandler>();
        m.AddValidationResultBehavior<CreateOrderCommand, OrderDto>();
    });
    var sender = services.BuildServiceProvider().GetRequiredService<ISender>();

    var result = await sender.Send(new CreateOrderCommand(Guid.NewGuid(), 0), CancellationToken.None);

    Assert.True(result.IsFailure);
    Assert.Same(PlatformErrors.InputInvalid, result.Error.Code);
    var field = Assert.Single(result.Error.Errors);
    Assert.Same(PlatformErrors.OutOfRange, field.Code);
    Assert.Equal("#/quantity", field.Pointer);
}
```

更多断言帮助（`ResultAssertions.ShouldBeFailure(...)`、`ShouldHaveErrorCode(PlatformErrors.InputInvalid)` 等）在 `Kun.Testing`。

## 例 2：`Result` 命令（无返回值）

场景：删除用户命令 `DeleteUserCommand → Result`，一个校验器（`UserId` 非空）。适用于幂等写命令、删除、标记为已读等"跑完了就行、没什么可返回"的业务。

```csharp
public sealed record DeleteUserCommand(Guid UserId) : IRequest<Result>;

public sealed class DeleteUserValidator : IValidator<DeleteUserCommand>
{
    public ValueTask<ValidationResult> ValidateAsync(
        DeleteUserCommand instance,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (instance.UserId != Guid.Empty) return ValueTask.FromResult(ValidationResult.Success);

        return ValueTask.FromResult(ValidationResult.Failure(
        [
            new FieldError(PlatformErrors.Required, ErrorPointer.Input("userId")),
        ]));
    }
}

// DI：
services.AddValidator<DeleteUserCommand, DeleteUserValidator>();
services.AddKunMediator(m =>
{
    m.AddValidationResultBehavior<DeleteUserCommand>();  // 注意：只有一个类型参数
});

// Handler：
public sealed class DeleteUserCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<DeleteUserCommand, Result>
{
    public async ValueTask<Result> Handle(DeleteUserCommand r, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var user = await _users.GetAsync(r.UserId, ct);
        if (user is null) return Result.Fail(new Error(PlatformErrors.NotFound));
        await _users.DeleteAsync(user, ct);
        return Result.Ok();
    }
}
```

`AddValidationResultBehavior<TRequest>()`（单参数）闭合在 `IRequest<Result>` 上；`AddValidationResultBehavior<TRequest, TValue>()`（双参数）闭合在 `IRequest<Result<TValue>>` 上。名字一样，只靠类型参数数量区分。

## 反模式

### 1. 同一 `TRequest` 注册两个 Behavior

```csharp
// ❌ 不要这样
m.AddValidationBehavior<CreateOrderCommand, Result<OrderDto>>();          // 抛出版
m.AddValidationResultBehavior<CreateOrderCommand, OrderDto>();            // Result 版
```

Pipeline 会串成链，同一组校验器跑两遍：先注册的抛出版先抛 `ErrorException`，Result 版永远走不到。跑不出来预期结果，IDE 也不会警告。

### 2. 在 `Result`-Handler 里抛 `ErrorException`

```csharp
// ❌ 不要这样
public async ValueTask<Result<OrderDto>> Handle(...)
{
    if (request.Quantity < 0)
        throw new ErrorException(/* ... */);   // 业务层不该为校验失败抛异常
    // ...
}
```

把校验放进 Validator；Handler 里用 `Result<TValue>.Fail(error)` 直接返回。根 [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/AGENTS.md#运行时约定)「运行时约定」：业务失败返回 `Result` / `Result<T>`，异常只留给系统性故障（并发、网络、基础设施）。抛异常会破坏下游 `Match / Bind / Tap` 组合链（Kun ADR-011）。

### 3. 在 Validator 里调数据库 / 外部服务

```csharp
// ❌ 不要这样
public async ValueTask<ValidationResult> ValidateAsync(CreateOrderCommand r, CancellationToken ct)
{
    var product = await _db.Products.FindAsync(r.ProductId, ct);   // 跨层了
    if (product is null) return ValidationResult.Failure(/* ... */);
    // ...
}
```

Validator 只处理"请求形状合法性"（类型、范围、非空、正则）。凡是需要外部状态（"ProductId 对应的产品是否存在"、"该用户是否有权限"）的判断都是语义校验，归 Handler。Validator 纯函数化保证：AOT 友好、单元测试不需要 mock 任何 DbContext、Pipeline 中多个 Validator 可以并行跑。

## 排错

- **Behavior 没生效**：检查 `AddKunMediator(m => …)` 里是否真的调了 `AddValidation…Behavior`；源生成器只注册 Handler 本身，Behavior 需要显式挂到 builder。
- **打了 `AddValidator<,>()` 但 Validator 没跑**：确认 Validator 实现了 `IValidator<T>`（not `IValidator<TRequest, TResponse>`），且 `T` 精确匹配 Command 类型（`CreateOrderCommand` 不是 `object`）。
- **响应里的 `errors[]` 少了几项**：ErrorDetail 至多 100 项，Behavior 按校验器的注册顺序保留前 100 项。
- **错误响应不是 problem+json**：HTTP 宿主没装 `Kun.Errors.AspNetCore`。`AddKunErrors()` 登记错误码目录与异常处理，`UseKunErrors()` 放在管道最前面。

## 相关

- [Kun ADR-011 Result async extensions](/sdk/kun/architecture/adr-011-result-async-extensions.md)—`Result<T>` 的 `Map/Bind/Tap/Ensure/Match` 组合面。
- [Kun ADR-014 Validation Result behavior](/sdk/kun/architecture/adr-014-validation-result-behavior.md)—两个 Result 版 Behavior 的设计决策。
- [src/Kun.Validation/](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Validation)—`IValidator<T>`、`ValidationResult` 与三个 Behavior。
- [src/Kun.Errors/](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Errors)—错误码与错误码目录、`Error`、`FieldError`、`ErrorPointer`、平台内置错误码 `PlatformErrors`。
- [src/Kun.Testing/](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Testing)—`ResultAssertions.ShouldBeFailure` 等断言帮助。
- [docs/design/when-to-use-currentuser.md](/sdk/kun/architecture/when-to-use-currentuser.md)—Kun 选型指南的样板格式，本文跟它的结构一致。

# 命令审计与实体审计

:::info 发布版本来源
本页由本仓库的发布标签生成，源文件为 [`docs/security/audit-log.md`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/docs/security/audit-log.md)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

成功命令的哈希链由 `qian.audit` 组件维护。需要记录业务实体变化的宿主可以另外启用实体审计。

## 命令审计哈希链

`Kun.Audit.Abstractions` 定义 `Kun.Audit.IAuditWriter` 和 `Kun.Audit.IAuditReader`。平台的命令运行时把成功命令的审计记录与业务写入放在同一事务。命令返回失败或抛出异常时，事务回滚，命令链只保留已提交的记录。

`Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore` 提供 EF 宿主的实现，`Kun.Audit.Postgres` 提供原生 PostgreSQL 实现。两者保留相同的链协议、数据库 schema 和租户边界。普通读取与验链使用当前租户；平台级方法要求宿主显式提供有权限的插件上下文。组件装配和查询方式见 [EF 提供者](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore/README.md)与[原生提供者](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Audit.Postgres/README.md)。

## 实体审计与读取

非严格的 `KunDbContext` 可从 `Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore` 登记实体拦截器。启动登记会拒绝严格上下文。宿主照常提供租户与已认证主体，按需登记数据库、数据约定、事件目录和要审计的实体。

```csharp
using Kun.Auditing.DependencyInjection;

services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));
services.AddKunDataConventions<AppDbContext>();
services.AddKunAuditing<AppDbContext>();
services.AddAuditable<Order>();
services.AddKunEventBus(registry => registry.RegisterAuditing());
```

每个已登记实体的变化生成本库的 `AuditLog` 与一个 `kun.audit.event.v2` Outbox 信封。日志、Outbox 行与信封使用相同 ID。业务实体、日志和 Outbox 在同一个数据库事务中提交。已有 v1 宿主通过 `AddAuditingInterceptor` 使用当前正在保存的上下文暂存 `kun.audit.event.v1`。默认写入端在保存失败或取消时撤回本次添加的审计行，保留同一上下文里其他业务消息以供重试。实体应使用保存前即可确定的主键。

信封的 producer 为 `qian.audit`。在命令或其他 `EventEnvelopeScope` 内保存时，保留作用域里的 actor、相关 ID 与 trace；不在作用域内时，主体取 `AuditContext.ActorId`，没有就取已认证用户。两者都没有时保存被拒绝：抛出错误码为 `EVENTS_PUBLISH_REJECTED` 的 `KunEventsException`，业务实体、日志与 Outbox 都不写入。后台作业、匿名请求等没有已认证用户的保存，要先用 `EventEnvelopeScope.Begin` 以实际的服务主体打开作用域，打开后可用同一上下文重试。平台级事件的租户为 null。原有 v1、v2 业务字段均在信封的 `payload` 中。

网关的内部令牌用 `sub` 标识当前主体，`principal_kind` 标识主体类型。业务审计可通过 `ICurrentUser` 取得已验证身份，需要记录委托关系时使用验证后的 `Principal.Actor`。链路关联使用当前 Activity 的 TraceId。

应用可在当前租户的业务上下文中，通过 `db.Set<AuditLog>()` 与 EF 查询读取实体日志，继续使用本业务的访问控制和租户过滤。命令链的分页读取及验链分别使用 `IAuditReader.ReadAsync` 和 `VerifyAsync`。

## 数据约定

模型配置最后调用 `modelBuilder.ApplyKunDataConventions()`，保存拦截器通过 `AddKunDataConventions<TContext>()` 自动装配：

- 表、列、键、索引使用 snake_case；未赋值的 Guid 主键生成 v7，显式主键保持不变。
- `IAuditedObject` 新增时写 `created_at/created_by`，修改时仅刷新 `updated_at/updated_by`，禁止改写创建字段。
- 主体支持 `string`、`Guid?`、`long?`、`int?`。匿名或系统操作写 null，不用空 Guid 或 0 冒充主体；无法转换的已认证主体拒绝保存。
- 主体取自上下文创建时解析到的 `ICurrentUser`；宿主没有登记身份适配器时按匿名写 null。数据约定不登记 `ICurrentUser`，身份适配器与它的登记先后不影响结果。
- C# 无约束泛型的 `T?` 不会把值类型自动变成可空值类型。已有 `AggregateRoot<TKey>`（Guid 主体）需显式迁移为 `AggregateRoot<TKey, Guid?>`，并生成相应数据库迁移；旧公共基类保持兼容。
- 审计实体映射 shadow `KunRowVersion` 至 PostgreSQL `xmin`。冲突保留 `DbUpdateConcurrencyException`；需要 Result 边界时调用 `SaveChangesResultAsync()`，映射为平台错误码 `CONFLICT`（409），不自动覆盖获胜写入。

## 从旧包迁移

- 原 `Kun.Audit` 命令管道和本地链存储已归档。依赖命令审计的宿主接入平台命令审计组件；原先由旧管道记录的失败命令不会进入替代链。
- 原实体读端口 `IAuditReader.QueryAsync`、`AuditQuery` 和 `EfAuditReader` 已归档；实体日志继续保存在业务数据库。
- 实体审计代码改为引用 `Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore`。原生链提供者改为引用 `Kun.Audit.Postgres`。组件 ID、链数据与既有 Postgres schema 保持兼容。

# Multi-Tenancy: Row-Level Security as Defence in Depth

:::info 发布版本来源
本页由本仓库的发布标签生成，源文件为 [`docs/security/multi-tenancy-rls.md`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/v2026.11.24/docs/security/multi-tenancy-rls.md)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Kun enforces tenant isolation at two independent layers:

1. **Application layer** — `KunDbContext` applies a global query filter to every
   entity implementing `IMultiTenant`, scoping reads by `ITenantContext.TenantId`.
   This is implemented inside the EF Core query pipeline.
2. **Database layer** — PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies defined on
   each tenant-scoped table, driven by the session variable
   `app.current_tenant_id` that Kun pushes in on every connection open.

Either layer alone is enough for the happy path; both together give a
belt-and-braces posture: a bug in the ORM filter does not silently leak rows,
and a bug in the RLS policy is caught by the ORM filter. This document covers
the second layer.

***

## 查询过滤器与共享模型

`KunDbContext` 的租户过滤器通过当前执行查询的 DbContext 读取租户，不把第一个宿主的 `ITenantContext` 实例留在缓存模型里。这样同租户的多个宿主或请求访问器复用模型时，旧访问器退出作用域或切到其它租户都不会改变新请求的过滤条件。

不继承 `KunDbContext` 的上下文须实现 `IKunMultiTenantDbContext`，并在 `OnModelCreating` 中调用 `modelBuilder.ApplyKunMultiTenantFilters(this)`。原来只收 `ITenantContext` 的重载已经删除：只捕获租户 ID 常量也无法兼容默认共享模型，旧调用者改用当前 DbContext 入口。继续使用 `AddKunTenantRls<TContext>()` 的双拦截器与模型缓存装配；模型缓存不能替代数据库隔离。

`TenantContextBindingTests` 使用 PostgreSQL 和受限应用角色单独验证 EF 过滤层，明确复用同一个模型，并让前一个访问器退出作用域或切到另一个租户；基础类与 DbContext 重载在默认和按租户缓存两种配置下都须只返回当前请求的租户行。

## The TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor

`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/Interceptors/TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor.cs`

The interceptor hooks EF Core's `DbConnectionInterceptor` events:

- `ConnectionOpenedAsync` → emits `SET app.current_tenant_id = '<tenant>'`
  when `ITenantContext.TenantId` is non-empty; `RESET app.current_tenant_id`
  otherwise.
- `ConnectionClosingAsync` → emits `RESET app.current_tenant_id` so pooled
  connections never leak the previous request's tenant scope.

Only activates when the underlying `DbConnection` is `Npgsql.NpgsqlConnection`
(namespace-prefix check on the type's FQN). Other providers are silently
no-ops so this module does not need to take a direct Npgsql dependency.

### SQL-injection guard

`SET` statements cannot be parameterised, so the tenant id is inlined into the
command text. The interceptor refuses to emit the command unless the value
matches the strict whitelist:

```
^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$
```

Exposed as `TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor.SafeTenantIdPattern`. A tenant id
that does not match (spaces, quotes, semicolons, etc.) throws
`InvalidOperationException` rather than being silently coerced.

### Registration and wiring

`AddKunEntityFrameworkCore` registers the interceptor as Scoped. It does not
activate until the caller wires it into a specific `DbContextOptionsBuilder`:

```csharp
services.AddKunEntityFrameworkCore();
services.AddDbContext<CatalogDbContext>((sp, opts) =>
{
    opts.UseNpgsql(connectionString);
    opts.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor>());
});
```

Per-scope semantics: each resolved `CatalogDbContext` picks up the scope's
`ITenantContext`, so each request gets the tenant id scoped to itself.

***

## Database-side policy template

The interceptor only sets the session variable — it does not create RLS
policies. Those live with the service's schema migrations. Template for a
tenant-scoped table `orders`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE orders ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
-- FORCE is critical: without it the table owner (the account running
-- migrations) bypasses RLS and all queries from the service would ignore
-- the policy. FORCE makes the policy apply even to the owner.
ALTER TABLE orders FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY orders_tenant_scope ON orders
    USING      (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true))
    WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true));
```

- `USING` — rows visible to `SELECT`/`UPDATE`/`DELETE` operations.
- `WITH CHECK` — rows permitted by `INSERT`/`UPDATE` operations.

Without `WITH CHECK`, a user could insert a row belonging to another tenant,
then lose sight of it via `USING`.

The `true` second argument to `current_setting` is _missing_ok_ — PostgreSQL
returns an empty string instead of raising if the variable is unset. Pair with
a `NOT NULL` constraint on `tenant_id` so the empty-string case does not match
real rows.

***

## Tests

`tests/Kun.IntegrationTests/MultiTenancy/TenantRlsTests.cs` spins a Postgres 16
container via Testcontainers and verifies:

- **RLS isolates rows without the EF filter**: the test entity deliberately
  does _not_ implement `IMultiTenant`, so EF's global query filter cannot
  account for the observed tenant isolation — any separation comes entirely
  from the RLS policy driven by the interceptor.
- **Cross-tenant writes are rejected**: inserting a row with another tenant's
  id surfaces a `DbUpdateException` (Postgres code `42501 / 23514`).
- **Unsafe tenant ids are blocked before hitting the server**: a tenant id
  containing `'; DROP TABLE ...; --` trips the whitelist and throws
  `InvalidOperationException`.

***

## Operational notes

- **Connection pooling**: the `ConnectionClosingAsync` RESET ensures a pooled
  connection returned to Npgsql does not carry the previous request's tenant
  scope into the next borrower. A failure to RESET is logged (warning) rather
  than thrown, because the connection is about to close anyway and we do not
  want to convert a close-path hiccup into a user-visible error.
- **Providers other than PostgreSQL**: the interceptor is a no-op. MySQL's
  user-defined variables use different syntax (`SET @...`) and MySQL does not
  have first-class RLS; if you need equivalent enforcement there, layer a
  session-level procedure or a column-level check constraint.
- **Non-tenant-scoped connections**: when a request has no tenant context
  (e.g. an admin console running under `NullTenantContext`), the interceptor
  emits `RESET` so the session variable is cleared. Any RLS policy evaluating
  against `current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)` will then match
  only rows whose `tenant_id` equals the empty string — typically nothing.

## 后台链路与生产装配（S1-KUN-001）

```csharp
services.AddKunSecurity();
services.AddKunMultiTenancy();
services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));
services.AddKunTenantRls<AppDbContext>();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseKunMultiTenancy();
```

`AppDbContext` 继承 `KunDbContext`，或实现 `IKunMultiTenantDbContext`。泛型 RLS 入口自动附加两种拦截器与缓存键；无泛型旧重载只注册拦截器，保留既有手动装配的兼容性。租户 HTTP 入口只读取已认证主身份的唯一 `tenant_id`，值为 D 格式的非空 UUID。租户业务使用缺省模式。需要同时服务平台身份与匿名端点的宿主显式选择 `TenantRequestMode.PlatformPrincipalAllowed`，并通过授权策略控制路由。

`AddKunMultiTenancy()` 以单例登记 `AsyncLocalTenantContext`，并保留宿主已登记的 `ITenantContext`。只有显式进入的作用域提供当前租户，包括由 HTTP 中间件进入的作用域。自定义上下文应实现 `BeginScope` 以支持请求和后台工作。

消费端在解析 handler 及其 scoped 依赖前，从信封恢复 `MessageContext.TenantId` 并打开作用域；多租户宿主的缺失或非法租户消息在幂等标记前进入死信队列。租户标识是内部可信发布者的信封元数据，不应直接接收外部请求字段；消息代理权限仍需由宿主限制。Outbox 发布器核对行与信封的租户；订阅器从信封进入租户作用域，平台级消息须由订阅显式选择接收。

在自定义后台任务中用 `using (tenantContext.BeginScope(tenantId))` 包围处理逻辑；不要把某个租户的 DbContext 保存为单例。PgBouncer 事务池下仍需显式事务，自动装配不改变其事务边界要求。

验收证据位于 `BackgroundTenantFlowTests`（真实 PG + RabbitMQ，A/B 交替、EF 与 RLS 独立断言、无租户／非法租户死信）、`ProductionTenantTests`（真实 RSA JWT 验证）、`TenantContextRegistrationTests` 与 `SubscriberTests`。
