### Added — Sprint 1 gap-closure (2026-04-22)

- **Kun.Storage.Abstractions / Kun.Storage.Local / Kun.Storage.S3** (P0-1): three
  new packages landing `IFileStorage` with the seven SAD §6.4 operations, a
  `FrozenSet` of the four canonical "active web" MIME types that trigger
  force-download on S3 presigned URLs, a dev-grade local filesystem
  implementation, and an AWSSDK-based S3 implementation. S3 is the repo's first
  non-AOT library module (A6) — explicitly excluded from the CI AOT-zero-warning
  matrix; documented in `src/Kun.Storage.S3/AGENTS.md`.
- **Kun.EntityFrameworkCore**:
  - `KunDbContext.DefaultSchema` virtual property + auto-registered
    `SchemaConsistencyInterceptor` (P0-3 M5). Overriding `DefaultSchema` without
    calling `.UseKunSchema(schema)` on the options builder now throws
    `InvalidOperationException` with a remediation message at the first
    `SaveChangesAsync`. Outbox rows, tenant/audit columns, and the migrations
    history table all co-locate under the service schema.
  - `UseKunSchema(schema)` extension method on `DbContextOptionsBuilder` that
    wires `MigrationsHistoryTableSchema` through `RelationalOptionsExtension`.
    Provider-agnostic — stays out of the Npgsql dependency.
  - `TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor` + `AddKunTenantRls()` (P1-4). Opt-in
    defence-in-depth layer that emits
    `SELECT set_config('app.current_tenant_id', @tenant, true)` at every
    transaction start so PostgreSQL RLS policies enforce isolation even when a
    caller bypasses the EF global query filter. Hooks
    `DbTransactionInterceptor.TransactionStartedAsync` — PgBouncer
    transaction-pool safe.
- **Kun.EventBus**: `IEventTypeRegistry.GetAll()` returns every registered
  `(eventId, clrType)` pair in stable alphabetical order, enabling the
  `tools/Kun.IntegrationEvents.SchemaGen` JSON-Schema export tool (P1-1).
- **Kun.Gateway**:
  - `ITracedCurrentUser` sub-interface + `trace_id` claim on the minted S2S
    JWT (P0-2). Default `EmitTraceIdClaim = true`; kill-switchable.
  - `KunInternalJwksEndpoint.MapKunInternalJwks()` — internal-network JWKS
    route gated on `IHostEnvironment.IsDevelopment()` OR
    `KunGatewayOptions.ExposeInternalJwks = true` (P1-3). Fail-closed:
    Production returns 404 unless opted in.
  - `IS2sPrincipalResolver` + `NoOpS2sPrincipalResolver` (P1-6). Optional
    enrichment hook the issuer runs before claim mapping. Default registered
    via DI. `S2sTokenIssuer` grows a 4-arg ctor taking the resolver; the
    3-arg overload is kept obsolete with `DiagnosticId = "KUN0002"` for one
    release, scheduled for removal in `0.2.0`.
- **Kun.EventBus.Outbox**: `IOutboxWriter` primitive (P0-4). Non-aggregate
  enqueuers (future audit interceptor, storage event adapters) can drop
  `OutboxMessage` rows into the current transaction without implementing the
  full `IIntegrationEventBus` surface. `IntegrationEventOutboxAccumulator`
  resolves to both `IIntegrationEventBus` and `IOutboxWriter` from a single
  scoped instance so aggregates and non-aggregate collaborators share one
  in-request buffer.
- **samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog** and **samples/Kun.Sample.Order**: override
  `DefaultSchema => "catalog"` / `"order"`; design-time factories chain
  `.UseKunSchema(...)`. Migrations regenerated; outbox, saga, business tables,
  and `__ef_migrations_history` all land under the service schema.
- **samples/Kun.Sample.Catalog**: `AddOpenApi()` + `MapOpenApi()` guarded on
  `IsDevelopment()` as the reference wiring for **P1-7** (OpenAPI pipeline
  template).
- **samples/Kun.Sample.Storage**: new Minimal API sample demonstrating
  force-download via `Kun.Storage.Local` — no AWS credentials required.
- **tools/Kun.IntegrationEvents.SchemaGen**: console tool (non-AOT) that emits
  `{eventId}.schema.json` per registered integration event using
  `JsonSchema.Net.Generation`. Consumers provide a public static zero-arg
  factory method that returns `IEventTypeRegistry` (P1-1).
- **docs**:
  - `docs/roadmap.md` — consolidated public roadmap (replaces the 495-line
    `TODO.md` at repo root, merged 2026-04-22).
  - `docs/schema-per-service.md` (P1-8) — end-to-end recipe for running many
    Kun services against one Postgres with service-scoped schemas.
  - `docs/openapi-template.md` (P1-7) — source-gen-friendly OpenAPI wiring
    guidance with environment gating + CI smoke-test recipe.
  - `src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/README.md` (P1-5) — PgBouncer transaction-pool
    compatibility notes (required connection-string parameters) +
    RLS-with-explicit-transactions contract.
- **tests**:
  - `tests/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.Tests` — new xunit.v3 project with schema /
    interceptor / RLS unit coverage (11 cases).
  - `tests/Kun.IntegrationTests/Persistence/{RlsEnforcementTests,TenantRlsInterceptorPgBouncerTests,PgBouncerCompatTests,SchemaPerServiceTests}` +
    `tests/Kun.IntegrationTests/Fixtures/PgBouncerPostgresFixture` — acceptance
    paths for P0-3 / P1-4 / P1-5, Docker-gated with `Assert.Skip` when
    containers aren't reachable.
  - `tests/Kun.Gateway.Tests` grows five new cases for
    `KunInternalJwksEndpoint` (gating matrix + document shape) and five for
    `IS2sPrincipalResolver` / obsolete-ctor compat.
- **Kun.Auditing** (P1-2): new AOT-candidate module wiring an EF Core
  `SavingChanges` interceptor that iterates `ChangeTracker.Entries()`,
  keeps only entity types registered via explicit
  `services.AddAuditable<TEntity>()` (no runtime attribute scan — A3
  path c), and enqueues one `AuditEventIntegrationEvent` per mutation
  through `IOutboxWriter` (the P0-4 primitive). Payload is the M4
  13-field record with stable event id `kun.audit.event.v1`; JSON via a
  source-generated `AuditJsonContext`. `AuditContextMiddleware` captures
  IP / User-Agent / TraceId into a scoped `AuditContext` before the EF
  interceptor runs. DI helpers: `AddKunAuditing`, `AddAuditable<T>`,
  `AddAuditingInterceptor(DbContextOptionsBuilder, IServiceProvider)`;
  stable event id wired via `IEventTypeRegistrar.RegisterAuditing()`.
- **Kun.EventBus** (architect M2): `IEventTypeRegistrar.Register<TEvent>`
  gains an overload that accepts a source-generated `JsonTypeInfo<TEvent>`;
  `IEventTypeRegistry.GetJsonTypeInfo(Type)` exposes it. The outbox
  accumulator now prefers the typed serializer when registered and falls
  back to reflection-based `JsonSerializer.Serialize(obj)` only when no
  info is supplied — the fallback path carries `[RequiresUnreferencedCode]`
  and `[RequiresDynamicCode]` annotations so the AOT analyzer flags
  callers that haven't migrated.
- **Kun.Gateway** (review #7): `MapKunJwks` + `MapKunInternalJwks` accept
  an optional `Func<HttpContext, bool>? additionalGate` that runs after
  the environment / `ExposeInternalJwks` check. Typical use: RFC1918
  allow-list for production deployments without service-mesh isolation.
- **Kun.Gateway** (review #2): `S2sTokenIssuer.IssueForAsync(ClaimsPrincipal, CancellationToken)`
  lets callers await the configured `IS2sPrincipalResolver` without
  `.GetAwaiter().GetResult()` blocking. The sync `IssueFor` stays for
  back-compat and delegates to the async path internally.
- **Kun.Gateway** (review #1): both JWKS endpoints share a DI-registered
  `JwksResponseBuilder` singleton that caches the JWK response keyed on
  public-key-file mtime. Rebuilds only on key rotation; typical downstream
  JWKS fetch is a single `File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc` stat.
- **Kun.Storage.Local** (review #3): streaming `MaxBytes` enforcement.
  `UploadAsync` now rejects oversized uploads mid-copy via a chunked
  `ReadAsync` loop backed by `ArrayPool<byte>` — no more "park a 1 GB
  payload on disk before deleting it" failure mode.
- **Kun.Storage** (review #6): `ObjectMetadata.ContentType` is now
  `string?`. `S3FileStorage.ListAsync` reports `null` instead of a
  synthetic `"application/octet-stream"` when the S3 listing API omits
  the content type — callers needing it follow up with
  `GetMetadataAsync` per item.

### Migration guide — `alpha.1` → `alpha.2`

All Sprint 1 changes are **additive**. `PublicAPI.Shipped.txt` is untouched;
every new member lives in `PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt`. Consumers upgrading
from `0.1.0-alpha.1` do not need to change code to keep the old behaviour,
but the new capabilities below require explicit opt-in:

1. **Per-service schemas** (P0-3). To run multiple Kun services against one
   Postgres instance without name collisions:
   - Override `DefaultSchema` on your `KunDbContext` subclass: `protected override string? DefaultSchema => "catalog";`.
   - Chain `.UseKunSchema("catalog")` on the options builder alongside
     `.UseNpgsql(...)`.
   - Regenerate migrations so they emit `schema: "catalog"` — see
     [docs/schema-per-service.md](/sdk/kun/guides/schema-per-service.md).
   - `SchemaConsistencyInterceptor` auto-registers via `KunDbContext.OnConfiguring`
     and will throw at first `SaveChangesAsync` if you miss either step.
2. **trace_id claim** (P0-2). `S2sTokenIssuer` now emits a `trace_id` claim
   when `Activity.Current` is live AND an HTTP context is in scope (M3
   guard). Downstream services see it on `JwtCurrentUser` via
   `ITracedCurrentUser.TraceId`. Default on; kill-switch via
   `KunGatewayOptions.EmitTraceIdClaim = false`.
3. **IFileStorage** (P0-1). Add `.AddKunLocalFileStorage(...)` (dev) or
   `.AddKunS3FileStorage(...)` (prod) to compose storage. `Kun.Storage.S3`
   is non-AOT — exclude from your AOT publish matrix if you have one.
4. **IOutboxWriter** (P0-4). Non-aggregate code can now enqueue outbox
   messages via `IOutboxWriter.Enqueue<TEvent>(evt)`. Existing
   `IIntegrationEventBus.Publish<T>` remains — both resolve to the same
   scoped accumulator instance. Prefer `IOutboxWriter` from interceptors
   and infrastructure code; `IIntegrationEventBus` for aggregate flows.
5. **Tenant RLS** (P1-4). Opt-in via `services.AddKunTenantRls()`. Wire the
   resulting interceptor into your DbContext options with
   `.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor>())`.
   Only needed when the database has `CREATE POLICY` rules using
   `app.current_tenant_id`.
6. **IS2sPrincipalResolver** (P1-6). `S2sTokenIssuer`'s 3-arg ctor is
   marked `[Obsolete(DiagnosticId = "KUN0002")]` and scheduled for removal
   in `0.2.0`. Switch manual construction sites to the 4-arg ctor, passing
   `NoOpS2sPrincipalResolver.Instance` for the identity transform. Custom
   enrichment: register your own `IS2sPrincipalResolver` implementation
   before `AddKunGateway`. DI-wired consumers do not need code changes.
7. **Internal JWKS endpoint** (P1-3). `app.MapKunInternalJwks()` at
   `/internal/.well-known/jwks.json`. Gated: Development auto-on, Production
   returns 404 unless `KunGatewayOptions.ExposeInternalJwks = true`. The
   existing public `/.well-known/jwks.json` route is unchanged.
8. **PgBouncer transaction mode** (P1-5). Append
   `No Reset On Close=true;Max Auto Prepare=0` to any Npgsql connection
   string routed through PgBouncer; see
   [src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/README.md](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/690477294ecbb034d92a8594034fa36f3e39f9f6/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore/README.md).
9. **OpenAPI** (P1-7). `builder.Services.AddOpenApi();` +
   `if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment()) app.MapOpenApi();`. Requires the
   `Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi` package.
10. **JSON Schema export** (P1-1). `IEventTypeRegistry.GetAll()` enumerates
    every `(eventId, clrType)` pair in stable order — used by
    `tools/Kun.IntegrationEvents.SchemaGen`. Provide a public static
    zero-arg factory method that returns your registry to plug into the
    tool; see `tools/Kun.IntegrationEvents.SchemaGen/README.md`.
11. **Auditing** (P1-2). Opt-in via `services.AddKunAuditing()` +
    `services.AddAuditable<YourEntity>()` for each entity you want audited.
    Attach the interceptor to your DbContext with
    `options.AddAuditingInterceptor(sp)` inside the factory lambda.
    Wire the stable event id via
    `services.AddKunEventBus(b => b.RegisterAuditing())`.
12. **AOT-safe outbox serialization** (architect M2). Upgrade existing
    `bus.Register<T>("t")` calls to
    `bus.Register<T>("t", MyJsonContext.Default.T)` to thread a
    source-generated `JsonTypeInfo<T>` through the outbox accumulator.
    Reflection fallback still works for non-AOT consumers but now warns
    via `[RequiresUnreferencedCode]` at call sites.
13. **JWKS `additionalGate`** (review #7, optional). Pass a predicate to
    `MapKunJwks` / `MapKunInternalJwks` to restrict by IP range or header
    when NetworkPolicy / mesh isn't available. Default behavior unchanged
    when the parameter is omitted.
14. **`S2sTokenIssuer.IssueForAsync`** (review #2). Prefer the async
    overload for hot-path token minting; the sync `IssueFor` delegates to
    it via `.GetAwaiter().GetResult()` and stays available for existing
    synchronous call sites.

### Highlights (2026-04-24 / 04-25)

**Phase 1 ［下游的智能体产品］ consumer gap fully closed.** Five tickets landed in one burst (23 commits on `main`, all pushed to `origin`):

- **P1-KN-001** `Kun.Storage` — new 15th module (`IFileStorage` 7-method contract + `ContentDispositionPolicy` + S3/MinIO/Local backends).
- **P1-KN-002** S2S JWT claims alignment (`Kun.Security.S2SJwt` rewritten around `S2SJwtIssueRequest`, emits `roles`/`membership_id`/`trace_id`, default TTL 15 min, multi-aud header bug fixed).
- **P1-KN-003** Attribute-driven integration-event registration (`[IntegrationEventId("event.v1")]` + `Register<TEvent>()` overload).
- **P1-CS-011** `TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor` — opt-in defence-in-depth behind the EF global filter; PG-only, whitelist-guarded.
- **P1-CS-019** `Kun.Audit` — new 16th-slot abstraction module (tamper-evident hash-chained operation audit + Mediator pipeline behaviour + 21 xunit cases).

Framework module count: 13 → 15. Test projects: 11 → 13. Validation / AOT publish matrix / NuGet release / Aspire runtime drill / SG regression remain open — see `docs/roadmap.md` for the outstanding-work roadmap（原 `TODO-remaining.md` 已于 2026-06-12 并入该文件）.

### Added — Kun.Audit module (Phase 1 P1-CS-019)

- New `Kun.Audit` abstraction module (IsAotCandidate=true, HasPublicApi=true): tamper-evident operation audit for CQRS commands via a Mediator pipeline behaviour + pluggable `IAuditSink`. Matches SAD v3.0 §15.5 `audit.operations` contract (prev_hash + content_hash).
- `AuditContentHasher.Compute`: canonical `id|tenant|actor|command|ISO-timestamp|latency|outcome|errorCode` + SHA-256 over `prev || canonical`, lower-case hex. Timestamp pinned to round-trip `O` format with `InvariantCulture` so hashes are stable across culture / timezone.
- `IAuditChainState.AppendAsync`: atomic read-previous / compute-new / commit-new, serialised per tenant key so concurrent commands on the same tenant cannot fork the chain. `InMemoryAuditChainState` uses per-tenant `SemaphoreSlim`; production deployments are expected to back this with a durable DB-level coordinator (documented in `docs/security/audit-log.md`).
- `AuditLogPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>`: captures actor/tenant/timing/outcome per handler invocation. Original handler exception is preserved via `ExceptionDispatchInfo`. Audit-write failures are logged at Warning and swallowed — audit MUST NOT convert a successful handler into a failure nor mask a business exception.
- DI: `AddKunAudit()` wires `InMemoryAuditChainState` + `InMemoryAuditSink` + `TimeProvider.System` as `TryAdd` defaults; `AddAuditBehavior<TCommand, TResponse>()` on `KunMediatorBuilder` opts one command in at a time so queries stay unaudited.
- New doc `docs/security/audit-log.md` covers record shape, chain semantics, serialisation contract, in-memory limitations, production shape, wiring, failure semantics, and chain-verification procedure.
- 21 xunit cases in `tests/Kun.Audit.Tests` cover the hash matrix, concurrent chain serialisation (100-task storm), sink ordering/null-guards, behaviour success/exception paths, sink-failure non-propagation, consecutive-entry linking, and per-tenant chain isolation.
- Registered in `Kun.sln` under GUID `{A100000E-...}`; `src/AGENTS.md` / `README.md` module matrix / `docs/architecture/module-map.md` updated.

### Added — Kun.EntityFrameworkCore tenant-RLS interceptor (Phase 1 P1-CS-011)

- New `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.Interceptors.TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor`: opt-in EF `DbConnectionInterceptor` that pushes `ITenantContext.TenantId` into the PostgreSQL session variable `app.current_tenant_id` on connection open and RESETs it on close. Gives ［下游的智能体产品］ a second isolation layer behind the existing EF global query filter when paired with RLS policies on the database schema.
- Activates only on Npgsql connections (nominal FQN check) so `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` does not need a direct Npgsql package dependency; MySQL / SQL Server / other providers silently no-op.
- Tenant id is whitelisted against `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$` before inlining into the `SET` command (PostgreSQL `SET` cannot be parameterised); unsafe values throw `InvalidOperationException` rather than being coerced.
- Registered as Scoped by `AddKunEntityFrameworkCore`; callers opt in per `DbContextOptionsBuilder` via `opts.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor>())`.
- New doc `docs/security/multi-tenancy-rls.md` covers defence-in-depth rationale, policy template (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + USING + WITH CHECK), wiring, and ops notes.
- Three xunit integration cases in `tests/Kun.IntegrationTests/MultiTenancy/TenantRlsTests.cs` run against a live Postgres 16 container: RLS isolation proven _without_ the EF filter (test entity deliberately omits `IMultiTenant`), cross-tenant write rejection via WITH CHECK, and whitelist rejection of unsafe tenant ids.

### Added — Kun.EventBus attribute-driven registration (Phase 1 P1-KN-003)

- New `[IntegrationEventId("bounded-context.event.v1")]` attribute so the stable token lives next to the event record instead of being repeated in DI wiring.
- `IEventTypeRegistrar.Register<TEvent>()` no-arg overload reads the attribute at DI-registration time. Marked `[RequiresUnreferencedCode]`; AOT-strict consumers can keep calling `Register<TEvent>(string)` to stay reflection-free. The resulting runtime registry is still the zero-reflection `FrozenDictionary`-backed `EventTypeRegistry`.
- Missing attribute yields an actionable `InvalidOperationException` pointing the caller at either decorating the type or using the explicit string overload.
- Samples (`Kun.Sample.Catalog.Contracts`, `Kun.Sample.Order.Contracts`) migrated to the attribute so the pattern is visible to framework users.
- 7 new xunit cases in `Kun.EventBus.Tests/IntegrationEventIdAttributeTests.cs` cover attribute validation, presence/absence, attribute-vs-string equivalence, and fluent chaining.

### Changed — Kun.Security.S2SJwt (Phase 1 P1-KN-002)

- `IS2SJwtIssuer.IssueAsync` now takes a single `S2SJwtIssueRequest` record. The prior 5-positional-parameter signature is removed (API was in `PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt` with no in-repo consumers besides tests).
- New claim emission, aligned with SAD v3.0 §12: `roles` (multi-valued), `membership_id`, `trace_id` — all optional via the request record. Pre-existing `sub`, `jti`, `tenant_id`, `scope`, `session_id` remain.
- Multi-audience tokens now fold `aud` into the payload as a JSON array (previously, multi-audience tokens leaked `aud` into the JWT _header_ — correctness bug, now fixed).
- `S2SJwtOptions.DefaultLifetimeSeconds` default bumped from 300 → **900** (15 minutes) per SAD §12; individual calls can still override via `S2SJwtIssueRequest.Lifetime`.
- `docs/security/s2s-jwt.md` extended with a ［下游的智能体产品］ Set B section explaining why both `Kun.Gateway.S2sTokenIssuer` (RS256, 60s) and `Kun.Security.S2SJwt.S2SJwtIssuer` (ES256, 15min) coexist and when to use each.

### Added — Kun.Storage (Phase 1 P1-KN-001)

- **Kun.Storage** module (trim-safe, `IsAotCandidate=false` due to AWSSDK.S3 reflection):
  - `IFileStorage` seven-method contract: `PutObject` / `GetObject` / `HeadObject` / `DeleteObject` / `ListObjects` / `CreatePresignedUploadUrl` / `CreatePresignedDownloadUrl`.
  - Supporting types: `ObjectMetadata` / `ObjectSummary` / `ObjectDownload` (IAsyncDisposable) / `PutObjectOptions` / `PresignedUploadRequest+Url` / `PresignedDownloadRequest+Url`.
  - `ContentDispositionPolicy`: active-web MIME whitelist (HTML/SVG/XML/JS/WASM/XHTML/ECMAScript) + RFC 5987 attachment builder. Enforced at every write path and every presigned-download URL so user-uploaded content cannot render inline.
  - `S3FileStorage` (AWSSDK.S3, compatible with MinIO via path-style + custom endpoint). Auto-probes stored MIME on presigned GET to inject `ResponseContentDisposition` attachment override.
  - `LocalFileStorage`: 2-layer path-traversal defense (syntactic + semantic), `.kunmeta` JSON sidecar for metadata, HMAC-SHA256-signed `kun-local://` stub URLs for presigned ops (dev-only).
  - DI: `AddKunStorage` / `AddLocalStorage` / `AddS3Storage` with central `StorageOptions`.
- **Tests**:
  - `tests/Kun.Storage.Tests`: ContentDispositionPolicy matrix, LocalFileStorage round-trips + traversal + attachment enforcement, mocked-S3 unit tests, DI resolution tests.
  - `tests/Kun.IntegrationTests/Storage/S3FileStorageIntegrationTests.cs` + `Fixtures/MinioFixture.cs`: MinIO Testcontainer with real `HttpClient` round-trips against presigned URLs.
- **Docs**: new `src/Kun.Storage/AGENTS.md`, module added to `src/AGENTS.md`, README, `docs/architecture/module-map.md`; ［第一阶段差距盘点］ updated to mark P1-KN-001 complete.

### Merge — main → develop reconciliation (2026-04-25, `sync-main-into-develop`)

- Union merge across five design-divergent groups, arbitrated against `docs/whitepaper.md`:
  - **Kun.Audit** — writer/reader abstraction (develop) + hash-chain pipeline behaviour (main) coexist in one module. `AddKunAudit().UseEventBus()` and `AddAuditBehavior<TReq,TResp>()` both available.
  - **Kun.EventBus** — three `Register<TEvent>` overloads (string / string+JsonTypeInfo / \[IntegrationEventId] attribute) all retained.
  - **Kun.EntityFrameworkCore** — `TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor` (connection-scoped) + `TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor` + `SchemaConsistencyInterceptor` all retained; consumers pick per-deployment.
  - **Kun.Security.S2SJwt** — dual `IssueAsync` overloads (record `S2SJwtIssueRequest` + legacy 5-param). `DefaultLifetimeSeconds` set to **300** per whitepaper §9.6 zero-trust TTL upper bound (60–300s).
  - **Kun.Storage** — main's 7-method `IFileStorage` contract wins (whitepaper §13.1; develop's variant lacked `RequiredHeaders` on presigned upload, making SigV4 S3 uploads unreliable, and had no response-Content-Disposition override for active-MIME attachment enforcement). develop's split-module skeleton `Kun.Storage.Abstractions` / `.Local` / `.S3` preserved for Phase 2 implementation; `src/Kun.Storage/` old legacy files removed.
- **P1-KN-002 TTL correction** — the main-side note about `DefaultLifetimeSeconds` bumping to 900 is superseded: per whitepaper §9.6 ("TTL 控制在 60 秒到 5 分钟"), default is 300 seconds. Explicit callers may still override via `S2SJwtIssueRequest.Lifetime`.
- Pre-push hook installed at `.git/hooks/pre-push` to refuse direct pushes to `main`.

### Fixed

- **Kun.Gateway**: `S2sTokenIssuer` now injects `IHostEnvironment` and throws `InvalidOperationException` when the signing key file is missing in non-Development environments, preventing silent ephemeral-key self-signing in production.

- **Kun.Gateway**: `AddKunGateway` without a `reverseProxyConfig` section now registers a startup-time `IHostedService` that fails fast with a user-friendly message if no `IProxyConfigProvider` is registered, instead of deferring the error to the first proxied request.

- **Kun.Gateway.Tests**: regression tests added for production key-file safety guard, startup config validation, and double-registration behavior.

- **Kun.Saga**: registered `ISystemClock` in `AddKunSaga` (required by
  `SagaOrchestrator`); `SagaStepExecutor` now persists state via
  `DbContext.SaveChangesAsync` after each entry; forward execution advances
  step index and marks completed; reverse compensation walks back to 0 and
  marks compensated; `ISagaOrchestrator` moved from Singleton to Scoped to
  match its Scoped dependency `ISagaInstanceStore`.

### Added — M1 交付（阶段一：奠基）

**Kun.Core** (v1.1)

- `Domain/DomainException`：带 `Code` 字段的领域异常基类
- `Domain/IDomainEventDispatcher`：同进程内领域事件分发接口

- 为已有公开类型（AggregateRoot / Entity / ValueObject / Result / Error / Auditing 标记）补齐 XML 注释
- 单元测试 32/32（Domain + Results）

**Kun.Mediator** (v1.2)

- 核心接口：`ISender`、`IPublisher`、`INotification`、`INotificationHandler<T>`、`IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>`、`RequestHandlerDelegate<TResponse>`
- `KunMediator`：基于 `FrozenDictionary<Type, RequestHandlerBase>` 的 O(1) 无反射调度
- `KunMediatorBuilder`：手工注册 API —— `AddRequestHandler<TReq, TResp, THandler>()`、`AddPipelineBehavior<TReq, TResp, TBehavior>()`、`AddNotificationHandler<TNotification, THandler>()`

- 单元测试 8/8（Dispatch + Pipeline 洋葱顺序）

**Kun.Validation** (v1.3)

- `IValidator<T>` + `ValidationResult` + `ValidationError` + `ValidationException`
- `Behaviors/ValidationPipelineBehavior<TReq, TResp>`：聚合所有验证器，invalid 时抛 `ValidationException`
- `DependencyInjection/KunValidationServiceCollectionExtensions`：`AddValidator<T, TValidator>()` + `AddValidationBehavior<TReq, TResp>()`
- 单元测试 12/12

**Kun.Sample.Minimal**（新增）

- AOT 候选的控制台样例，演示 Command / Query / Notification 经 `KunMediator` 的完整调度链路
- 附带 `ActivityListener` 观察 `TracingBehavior` 输出
- `dotnet run` 本地验证通过

### Deferred（M1 已决定延后的项，详见 docs/roadmap.md）

- `Kun.Mediator.SourceGenerator` / `Kun.Validation.SourceGenerator`：当前用手工注册 API 替代，SG 作为 stretch goal（ralplan ADR fallback 路径）
- `Kun.Validation` 属性包（`[Required]`、`[MaxLength]` 等）：无 SG 时属性无运行时意义，与 SG 一同回归
- Result-aware 验证 Behavior（返回 `Result.Fail(Error.Validation(...))`）：可在核心抛异常 Behavior 之上封装，follow-up
- AOT 启动时间 benchmark：本地 Windows 缺 C++ linker，延至 CI 或用户本地 Linux 跑

### Added — M2 交付（阶段二：持久化双引擎）

**Kun.EventBus** (v2.1, AOT-candidate abstractions)

- `OutboxMessage`：富领域模型，含 `MarkPublished` / `MarkFailed` / `IncrementAttempt` 状态转换方法
- `OutboxStatus`：`Pending` / `Published` / `Failed` 枚举
- `IntegrationEventBuffer`：scoped 累加器，在 `SaveChangesAsync` 前收集待发事件
- `EventTypeRegistry`：`FrozenDictionary<string, Type>` 支持的 O(1) 稳定事件类型查找；`IEventTypeRegistry` / `IEventTypeRegistrar` 接口
- `IIntegrationEventHandler<TEvent>` + `MessageContext`：消费端处理器契约
- `IIntegrationEventPublisher`：每条消息的 broker 传输抽象
- `IProcessedMessageStore`：幂等消费存储抽象；`InMemoryProcessedMessageStore`（测试用）、`RedisProcessedMessageStore`（SETNX + EX，键格式 `idemp:{consumer}:{messageId}`）
- `IOutboxMessageStore`：持久层扫描抽象
- `OutboxPublisherBackgroundService`：BackgroundService，可配置批量大小、轮询间隔、最大重试次数、指数退避；每条消息启动 `ActivitySource("Kun.EventBus.Outbox")` span，从 `TraceParent`/`TraceState` 列恢复父 trace
- `OutboxPublisherOptions`：BatchSize=50 / PollInterval=2s / MaxAttempts=5 / RetryBaseDelay=1s
- DI 构建器：`KunEventBusBuilder`（`.UseInMemoryIdempotency()` / `.UseRedisIdempotency()`）、`KunEventBusServiceCollectionExtensions`、`KunOutboxPublisherExtensions`
- 单元测试 11/11

**Kun.EntityFrameworkCore** (v2.2, trim-safe, IsAotCandidate=false)

- `KunDbContext`：`IMultiTenant` 全局查询过滤器 + `ISoftDelete` 软删除过滤器
- `OutboxMessageConfiguration`：EF Core `IEntityTypeConfiguration<OutboxMessage>`，含索引
- `EfUnitOfWork`：单次 `SaveChangesAsync` 原子提交聚合变更 + Outbox 行 + 领域事件分发
- `IntegrationEventOutboxAccumulator`：W3C `TraceParent`/`TraceState` 捕获（via `Activity.Current`）
- `UnitOfWorkPipelineBehavior`：Mediator pipeline behavior，写命令专用
- `NoOpDomainEventDispatcher`：默认无操作实现；`MediatorDomainEventDispatcher` 由样例服务提供
- `IUnitOfWork` 接口
- DI：`KunEntityFrameworkCoreServiceCollectionExtensions`
- 单元测试集成（Testcontainers PostgreSQL，Docker 不可用时自动跳过）

**Kun.Dapper** (v2.3, AOT-candidate)

- `IReadDbConnectionFactory`：读端连接工厂抽象；调用方负责 dispose
- `PageRequest`：1-based 页码 + `Offset` 计算属性
- `PagedResult<T>`：`TotalPages` / `HasNextPage` / `HasPreviousPage` + `Empty(PageRequest)` 工厂方法
- `ReadDbOptions`：`ConnectionString` 配置
- DI：`KunDapperServiceCollectionExtensions.AddKunDapper`
- 单元测试 10/10

### Added — M3 交付（阶段三：消息总线）

**Kun.EventBus** (v3.x 追加)

- `IIntegrationEventPublisher`：每条消息的 broker 传输接口（从 M2 正式确定契约）
- `IProcessedMessageStore` 完整实现（InMemory + Redis），含幂等键格式文档

**Kun.EventBus.RabbitMQ** (AOT-candidate，RabbitMQ.Client 7.x)

- `RabbitMqOptions`：ConnectionString / ExchangeName / ConsumerName / PrefetchCount / MaxDeliveryAttempts / IdempotencyTtl
- `RabbitMqConnectionProvider`：单例懒初始化连接，`AutomaticRecoveryEnabled=true`，`IAsyncDisposable`
- `RabbitMqIntegrationEventPublisher`：`IIntegrationEventPublisher` 实现；topic exchange；headers 含 traceparent/tracestate/tenantId/messageId/occurredAt；持久化消息
- `RabbitMqIntegrationEventSubscriber`：BackgroundService；`AsyncEventingBasicConsumer`；per-type durable 队列 + binding；prefetch；W3C trace 恢复；x-death 计数 → DLX
- `IdempotentConsumerDecorator`：handler 成功后调用 `IProcessedMessageStore.TryMarkProcessedAsync`
- `DeadLetterHandler`：`{exchange}.dlx` fanout + `{consumer}.dead-letter` 队列
- `ISubscriptionDispatcher` + `TypedSubscriptionDispatcher<TEvent>`：AOT 安全有类型调度，无 `MakeGenericType`
- `KunRabbitMqBuilder`：`.Subscribe<TEvent, THandler>(eventTypeId, typeInfo)` 流式注册
- `KunRabbitMqServiceCollectionExtensions.AddRabbitMq`
- 单元测试新增 6 个，总计 79/79 通过
- M3 3.4（Testcontainers.RabbitMq 轮转测试）延后至 CI

### Added — M4 交付（阶段四：Saga 编排器）

**Kun.Saga** (AOT-candidate)

- 抽象：`ISagaContext` / `ISaga<TContext>` / `ISagaStep<TContext>` / `ISagaOrchestrator`
- 异常：`SagaStepFailedException` / `SagaNotFoundException`
- 持久化：`SagaInstance`（富状态转换：`StartCompensating` / `Complete` / `Fail`）、`SagaStepQueueEntry`、`SagaState`（Running/Compensating/Completed/Compensated/Failed）、`StepDirection`（Execute/Compensate）
- `ISagaInstanceStore`：持久层抽象；`EfSagaInstanceStore`：EF Core 实现，含 `(state, timeout_at)` 和 `(processed_at, enqueued_at)` 索引
- `SagaOrchestrator`：原子 start + 首步 enqueue（与触发命令同一 EF Core 事务）
- `SagaStepExecutor`：BackgroundService，正向执行 + 逆序补偿；`ActivitySource("Kun.Saga")`，span 名 `saga.step.execute` / `saga.step.compensate`，tags: `saga.step_index` / `saga.saga_id` / `saga.direction` / `saga.name`
- `SagaTimeoutDetector`：BackgroundService，每 5 秒扫描超时实例并触发补偿
- `SagaRegistry`：`FrozenDictionary` + 闭包泛型委托，AOT 安全，无 `MakeGenericType`
- DI：`KunSagaBuilder` + `AddKunSaga` 扩展
- 单元测试 18/18

### Added — M5 交付（阶段五：宿主层、RPC 与安全网关）

**Kun.Security** (M5.1, AOT-candidate)

- `S2sTokenOptions`：Issuer / Audience（默认 `kun-internal`）/ Lifetime（默认 60s）/ SigningAlgorithm（默认 RS256，HS256 明确禁止）/ JwksUri / ValidIssuers
- `IKunJwksProvider` + `FileKunJwksProvider`：文件监视 JWKS 提供者
- `KunServiceAuthenticationExtensions.AddKunServiceAuthentication`：JwtBearer 验证，`ValidAlgorithms=["RS256","ES256"]`，HS256 被拒绝
- `JwtTenantContext`：从 `ClaimsPrincipal` 提取 `tenant_id` 实现 `ITenantContext`
- `JwtCurrentUser`：从 `ClaimsPrincipal` 提取 `sub` / `name` / `roles` 实现 `ICurrentUser`
- `PropagateS2sTokenHandler`：`DelegatingHandler`，将入站 `Authorization` 头复制到出站请求
- DI：`AddKunSecurity`（注册 `ITenantContext` + `ICurrentUser`）/ `HttpClientBuilder.AddKunServiceAuth`
- 单元测试 7/7（valid、HS256 拒绝、wrong aud、expired、key rotation）

**Kun.AspNetCore** (M5.2, AOT-candidate)

- `KunEndpointRouteBuilderExtensions`：`MapCommand<TCommand, TResp>` + `MapQuery<TQuery, TResp>`（ISender glue）
- `ErrorToProblemDetailsExtensions`：`Error.ToProblemDetails()` 映射（Validation→400 / NotFound→404 / Conflict→409 / Unauthorized→401 / Forbidden→403）
- `KunExceptionHandler`：`DomainException` → 400 ProblemDetails
- `KunHealthChecksExtensions`：健康检查注册
- DI：`KunAspNetCoreServiceCollectionExtensions`
- 单元测试 11/11

**Kun.Grpc** (M5.3, AOT-candidate)

- `KunResultToRpcInterceptor`：`ResultFailureException` → `RpcException` 状态码映射；`Error.Code` 复制到 trailers
- `KunServerAuthInterceptor`：强制 `HttpContext.User` 已认证且含 `tenant_id` claim
- `KunTracingInterceptor`：`ActivitySource("Kun.Grpc")` span，`rpc.system=grpc` / `rpc.method` tags；拦截器顺序：Tracing → Auth → ResultMapping
- DI：`AddKunGrpc` 链式注册三个拦截器
- 单元测试 13/13

**Kun.Gateway** (M5.4, AOT-candidate，Web Host)

- `KunGatewayOptions`：ExternalIssuer / ExternalAudience / ExternalJwksUri / InternalIssuer / InternalAudience / InternalTokenLifetime(60s) / SigningKeyPath / PublicKeyPath
- `S2sTokenIssuer`：加载 PEM RSA 私钥，铸造 RS256 JWT，复制 `sub` / `tenant_id` / `roles` 声明
- `S2sAuthTransform`：YARP `RequestTransform`，将 Authorization 头替换为内部 token
- `JwksEndpoint.MapKunJwks`：`/.well-known/jwks.json`，`kid` = SHA-256(modulus) 前 16 字符，AOT 安全（`JwksJsonContext`）
- `IRateLimitPartitionResolver` + `TenantRateLimitPartitionResolver`（claim-based）+ `IpRateLimitPartitionResolver`（X-Forwarded-For aware）
- `KunRateLimiterExtensions`：固定窗口 100 req/min，可插拔分区解析器
- DI：`AddKunGateway` 配置 YARP + S2S issuer + transform
- `Program.cs` 组合根 + `appsettings.json` 骨架
- 单元测试 12/12
- M5 5.5 合约测试（Docker 依赖，延后）

全解决方案：0 错误，0 警告，140/140 测试通过 + 2 集成跳过

### Added — M6 交付（阶段六：示例应用）

**Kun.Sample.Catalog** (M6.1)

- 领域：`Product` AggregateRoot，`Create` / `ChangePrice` / `AdjustStock` 触发 `ProductCreatedDomainEvent` / `PriceChangedDomainEvent` / `StockChangedDomainEvent`
- 契约：`ProductPublishedIntegrationEvent`（稳定 ID `product.published.v1`）/ `InventoryChangedIntegrationEvent`（`inventory.changed.v1`）
- 应用层：`CreateProductCommand` + 验证器 + Handler；`AdjustStockCommand`；`GetProductByIdQuery`（Dapper 读端）；`ProductCreatedHandler`（领域事件 → `IIntegrationEventBus` 桥接）
- 基础设施：`CatalogDbContext`（继承 `KunDbContext`）/ `ProductConfiguration` / `NpgsqlReadDbConnectionFactory` / `MediatorDomainEventDispatcher`
- API：`Program.cs` 组合根；`EnsureCreated` 启动引导；`POST /products` / `GET /products/{id}` / `/health`

**Kun.Sample.Order** (M6.2, Saga 展示)

- 领域：`Order` AggregateRoot，`MarkReserved` / `Paid` / `Shipped` / `Completed` + `Cancel`；`OrderLine` owned value object；`OrderPlaced` / `OrderCancelled` 领域事件
- Saga：`OrderCreationSaga`（4 步，`DefaultStepTimeout=30s`）
  - `ReserveInventoryStep` → `ProcessPaymentStep` → `ShipOrderStep` → `NotifyCustomerStep`
  - 每步含 `ExecuteAsync` + 幂等 `CompensateAsync`
  - `ProcessPaymentStep` 在 `SimulateFailure=="payment"` 时抛异常（演示补偿）
  - `ShipOrderStep` 在 `SimulateFailure=="timeout"` 时 sleep 60s（演示超时）
- 契约：`OrderCompletedIntegrationEvent`（`order.completed.v1`）
- 应用层：`PlaceOrderCommand` / `GetOrderById` / `GetSagaStatus` 查询
- 基础设施：`OrderDbContext` 应用 `ApplyKunSagaConfiguration`；`EfOutboxMessageStore`
- API Endpoints：`POST /demo/happy-path` / `POST /demo/trigger-payment-failure` / `POST /demo/trigger-timeout` / `GET /demo/sagas/{id}`

**Kun.Sample.AppHost** (M6.3, .NET Aspire 9.0)

- 编排：PostgreSQL（+pgAdmin）/ RabbitMQ（+management plugin）/ Redis / Catalog / Order / Gateway
- `WaitFor` 依赖链：各服务等待 postgres + rabbitmq 就绪后启动
- Gateway 引用 catalog + order 用于 YARP 服务发现
- 单命令启动：`dotnet run --project samples/Kun.Sample.AppHost`

**Kun.Sample.Shared** (M6.4, IsAotCandidate=false)

- `OpenTelemetryExtensions.AddKunObservability(serviceName)`：
  - Tracing：ActivitySources `Kun.Mediator` / `Kun.EventBus.Outbox` / `Kun.Grpc` / `Kun.Saga` + AspNetCore + HttpClient + gRPC client
  - Metrics：AspNetCore + HttpClient
  - OTLP exporter（默认指向 Aspire Dashboard collector）
- 框架模块（`src/Kun.*`）保持无 OTel 包依赖；OTel 仅在样例组合根注入
- Gateway 未注入可观测性（AOT-candidate，OTel 包尚未 AOT 安全）
- `OpenTelemetry.Api` 升级至 1.11.x（修复 GHSA-8785-wc3w-h8q6）

### Changed（M2–M6 期间）

- `Directory.Packages.props`：新增 Dapper 2.1.35 / RabbitMQ.Client 7.x / OpenTelemetry 1.11.x / YARP 等包版本
- `Kun.AspNetCore` / `Kun.Grpc` csproj：`IsAotCandidate=true` 确认（库，非 Host）
- `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` csproj：`IsAotCandidate=false`（trim-safe but not AOT）
- `PublicAPI.Shipped.txt` / `PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt`：Kun.Dapper / Kun.EventBus / Kun.EntityFrameworkCore / Kun.Saga / Kun.Security / Kun.Gateway / Kun.Grpc 接入 RS0016 公开 API 追踪

### Deferred（M2–M6 已决定延后的项）

- Source Generators（Mediator / Validation / Saga）：按 ADR fallback 路径继续使用手工注册
- Testcontainers 集成测试（M2 2.4 / M3 3.4 / M5 5.5）：Docker 依赖，CI 环境运行，本地跳过
- `AddKunDapper` API rework：`ReadDbOptions.ConnectionString` 为 `required init`，消费方需在回调内设置（当前 API 略显冗余）
- `IReadDbConnectionFactory` 默认 Npgsql 实现：框架不内置，由消费方提供（参见样例 `NpgsqlReadDbConnectionFactory`）
- `MapQuery` nullable TResponse via JsonTypeInfo：类型系统限制，follow-up
- Gateway 可观测性：OTel 包达到 AOT parity 后追加
- NuGet 发布仪式（手动，TBD）

## [0.1.0-phase1] - 2026-04-23

Phase 1 首个可对［下游的智能体产品］集成发版。10 个新模块落地（Storage / Identity /
MultiTenancy / Audit / RateLimit / Caching / Observability / Security / Configuration /
Sandbox），全仓 AOT 一致性通过审计，Directory.Build.props 统一 AOT 策略，CI 新增
`aot-audit` 矩阵 job 与 `sample-aot-integration` job。

# 后端 SDK（.NET）

内核包 `Kun.Runtime` 提供插件上下文、服务注册、类型化事件、可逆副作用与装载器。平台组件通过同一套运行时提供有业务含义的服务。

## 安装

仓库内的组件和宿主使用同一解决方案的项目引用。外部宿主可从所选 [Kun Release](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/releases) 下载该版本的 `NuGet.config` 和 `release-packages.json`。正式版的内核包从 nuget.org 还原，平台包逐个映射到 CavaiLAB 的 GitHub Packages。beta 的两档包均从 GitHub Packages 还原。将 `KUN_PLATFORM_FEED_USER` 与 `KUN_PLATFORM_FEED_TOKEN` 设为有读包权限的凭据。

组件项目引用同一发布版本的 SDK 与源生成器。下面的 `KunReleaseVersion` 是消费项目自定义的 MSBuild 属性，填写所选 Release 的实际版本号。

```xml
<PackageReference Include="Kun.Plugin.Sdk" Version="$(KunReleaseVersion)" />
<PackageReference Include="Kun.Plugin.Sdk.Generators" Version="$(KunReleaseVersion)" PrivateAssets="all" />
```

## 编程模型

- **插件**：实现 `IKunPlugin` / `IKunPlugin<TConfig>`，在 `ApplyAsync` 里向上下文贡献内容；运行时先按清单的 `configSchema` 校验配置再反序列化。
- **服务**：`Provide(key, instance)` 填充服务键，`Inject<T>(key)` 取用；`ctx.Files()` 这类扩展方法由 Definition 包提供，等价于 `Inject`。装载器按 `inject → provides` 决定挂载顺序，依赖未就绪的插件保持 `Pending`。
- **事件**：事件在 Definition 包里定义并标注分发模式，见[事件与中间件](/sdk/dotnet/events.md)。
- **副作用皆可逆**：`Provide`、`On` 等注册都返回释放函数并压入插件的效果栈，`Effect(...)` 把第三方资源也纳入同一栈；卸载时按注册逆序释放。
- **scope**：`Scoped(scope)` 返回子上下文，之后的注册归属该 scope；见 [scope](/start/concepts/scope.md)。

## API 草图

节选自[组件模型规格](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md) §5.2 的 API 草图（以规格为准）：

```csharp
public interface IKunPlugin
{
    IReadOnlyList<ServiceKey> Inject { get; }
    ValueTask ApplyAsync(IPluginContext ctx, JsonElement config, CancellationToken ct);
}

public interface IPluginContext
{
    ScopeKey Scope { get; }
    IDisposable Provide<TService>(ServiceKey key, TService instance) where TService : class;
    TService Inject<TService>(ServiceKey key) where TService : class;
    void Effect(Func<ValueTask> disposeAsync);
    IDisposable On<TPayload, TResult>(KunEvent<TPayload, TResult> evt, DispatchMode mode, Delegate handler, int priority = 0);
    ValueTask<TResult> DispatchAsync<TPayload, TResult>(KunEvent<TPayload, TResult> evt, TPayload payload, CancellationToken ct);
    IPluginContext Scoped(ScopeKey scope);
}
```

组件入口用 `[KunPlugin("<component-id>")]` 标注，源生成器派生 `runtime.entry`、`inject[]`、`provides[]` 以及配置、权限、事件和工具表面。同程序集支持多个不同组件 ID，每个组件保持唯一清单；工具按清单 ID 选择对应元数据。已派生、手写字段和 S2 边界见[能力与唯一清单](/sdk/dotnet/capabilities.md)。`Provide` 的登记归属当前插件的 scope 与可撤销生命周期；跨进程集成事件由 [qian.events](/components/platform/qian.events.md) 桥接到 Kun 的 Mediator + Outbox。

## 示例

把文件存储后端包装为 `ctx.Files` Provider 的完整示例见规格 §5.7。已发布内核包的 XML 注释收录在 [Kun API 参考](/sdk/api/kun/index.md)。平台档包的 API 参考列在 [S1-DOCS-002 的交付范围](/sdk/api/index.md)。

# 能力与函数

## 能力目录

组件把自己的能力登记进**能力目录**（[qian.capabilities](/components/platform/qian.capabilities.md)），分四类：命令、查询、事件、实体。

- 组件在 `Apply` 中用 `ctx.ProvideCapability<TRequest, TResponse>()` 登记能力，绑定携带源生成的契约，请求与响应的 JSON Schema 由类型信息派生；目录只列这些绑定里、当前 scope 已挂载且 Ready 的能力。
- platform profile 宿主必须调用 `services.AddKunCapabilities()`，登记时就生成目录条目并预编译输入校验器（漏掉时退化为首次读目录或调用时才编译）。不合格的契约（输入含 `tenantId` 等租户字段、Schema 无法可靠校验）抛 `CapabilityContractException`，带组件 ID、能力短名与 JSON Pointer（如 `qian.sample.crm/customer.export#/inputSchema/properties/tenantId`），组件挂载失败；问题在登记时暴露，不会留到第一次调用。
- `GET /api/capabilities?kind=command|query|event|entity&q=` 按调用者权限与当前 scope 的 restrict 过滤，被过滤的项不出现；响应信封 `{ items, ttlMs, cacheScope: "private" }` 的冻结 Schema 是 `contracts/v0/capability-catalog.schema.json`。
- `POST /api/capabilities/{plugin}/{name}/invoke` 是通用执行入口，规则见下节。
- `GET /api/capabilities/openapi.json` 聚合全部已挂载组件的 OpenAPI 3.1（需认证，不等于公开 OpenAPI）；写类能力的路径列出 `Idempotency-Key` 参数、`Idempotent-Replayed` 响应头与两种 409（`CONFLICT`、`CAPABILITY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE`）。
- Agent 用的工具**定义**由能力目录机械生成，保证 schema 不漂移；**暴露**哪些、怎么描述，经 `agent.expose` 单独策划（[ADR-016 D16.10](/design/adr/adr-016-agent-boundary.md)）。

## 代码与唯一清单

每个 `[KunPlugin]` 组件对应一份 `.qian-plugin/plugin.json` 和一个入口。同一程序集可包含多个不同组件 ID；`qian-plugin check|sync` 按目标清单 ID 选择，不合并不同组件的依赖。多组件程序集的 `[Capability]` 必须填写 `ComponentId`。契约包装器、动态表面适配器及宿主子插件通过仓库分类门记录归属，不各造一份清单。

| 已派生 | 代码来源与落点 |
| ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 服务与具名贡献 | Inject / Provide、CommandPolicies 与按真实注册表符号绑定的 Contributes → inject / provides |
| 形态与入口 | KunPlugin → runtime.form / runtime.entry |
| 工具 | Capability 与源生成 JsonTypeInfo，或与实际绑定共用的静态 CapabilitySource → tools/\*.json |
| 配置契约 | KunConfigSchema 的完整代码声明 → runtime.configSchema 与对应 Schema 文件 |
| 权限与事件 | Permission / KunEvent → metadata/permissions.json、metadata/events.json；带清单侧的来源与派生指针，不放进 plugin.json |

id、版本、展示、策略、scope、包/镜像信息及表面路径仍手写；没有代码声明的权限文件与角色模板继续手写。动态 Inject、动态贡献名和未知上下文逃逸会报编译诊断，不生成空结果。需要不同构造模式的实现由固定薄入口明确依赖、委托目标与服务输出，真实装载负责验证提供项。

同程序集的多个 Provider 使用同一事件 Definition 时，由一个组件通过 MetadataTypes 拥有声明，其它组件以 SharedEvents 显式引用；生成的事件记录带 definitionComponent，保持名称、模式、载荷类型与来源同源。此机制只共享事件契约，不能共享权限，也不放宽未知上下文逃逸的诊断。

`sync` 沿既有表面目录写入，`check` 只读并报告文件与 JSON Pointer。清单保存权限、事件与配置文件的所属组件和内容哈希；手改这些文件后保留并报冲突，工具文件通过所属标记区分手写与派生。无组件注解、ID 不匹配、第二清单、手写覆盖、路径越界都有各自的 SDK 错误码及 `errors[]`。CI 自动发现所有代码入口并检查清单，同时拒绝漏分类的新实现。

R94 将 IKunPlugin 基类、客户端门面、生命周期钩子基类与 DI 注册代码生成推迟到 S2；S1 继续使用接口和 ctx.Inject。`[KunJob]` 属于 S1-SCH-001 的调度器交付，不在本次生成器补齐范围内。UI/低代码及 Wasm 表面按各自 S2 规划，代码热装卸尚未承诺。清单已经派生不代表真实安装验收完成，`x-skeleton` 仍按每个组件的安装门维护。

## 通用执行入口

`POST /api/capabilities/{plugin}/{name}/invoke` 先重做与目录相同的过滤（不可见与不存在一样 404），再按条目 `inputSchema` 校验请求体（不符返回 400 `INPUT_INVALID`，`errors[]` 带 JSON Pointer；请求体读不成确定的 JSON 值，如成员重名或有绝对值超过 decimal 范围约 7.9e28 的数，返回 400 `BAD_REQUEST`），然后走组件自己的命令管道，租户、授权与审计照常生效。

写类能力可以带幂等键，只读能力（`sideEffect: read`）忽略它、每次都执行：

| 头 | 方向 | 含义 |
| --------------------------- | -- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | 请求 | UUID 文本，可带引号；多值、空值、全零或非 UUID 返回 400 `BAD_REQUEST` |
| `Idempotent-Replayed: true` | 响应 | 这次是回放：响应体与首次成功响应逐字节相同，没有再执行 |

同一租户、同一主体、同一能力、同一键在 24 小时内的重复请求都不会再执行。409 分两种：

- `CONFLICT`：同键而输入不同，或同键请求仍在执行。改用新的键，或等前一个请求结束再重试。
- `CAPABILITY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE`：同键请求已经执行成功，但回执没有保存响应体，无法回放。只有 `dataClassification` 为 `public` 或 `internal` 的能力保存响应体：`pii`、`finance`、`secret` 不保存，未知分级也不保存；响应超过组件配置 `receiptMaxBytes`（默认 64 KiB）时同样不保存。应通过查询确认结果，不要换新键重试，换键会再执行一次。

`[Capability]` 的 `DataClassification` 默认 `internal`，也就是默认把响应体明文存进回执表，24 小时内同键请求原样回放。响应含个人信息、财务或机密数据的能力要显式标注，如 `DataClassification = "pii"`（`finance`、`secret` 同理）；参考应用响应含客户名称的 `customer.*` 能力都标为 `pii`。

执行失败不留回执，同一个键可以带正确的输入重试。服务端在执行后、写回执前崩溃时，5 分钟租约到期后的重试会再执行一次，所以写类能力仍要在 `inputSchema` 里带业务幂等键（`idempotencyKey`）。

## 函数

`function` 表面（Wasm 沙箱内运行的函数）是 S2 可选能力；Agent 生成的代码只落在 `function` 沙箱里（ADR-016 D16.11）。

详见 [PRD §7.2](/design/prd/07-s1-foundation.md)。

# 事件与中间件

事件在 Definition 包的**定义处**标注分发模式，`ctx.On` 调用点必须写同一模式：重复一次是为了让调用点可读，也让 CI 能做一致性校验。

| 模式 | 调用顺序 | 返回值 | 异常 | 典型用途 |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------- |
| `emit` 观察 | 按 priority 降序逐个 await | 无 | 记录日志、不传播，其余监听器继续 | 通知、审计、索引 |
| `waterfall` 环绕 | 按 priority 组成洋葱，调用 `next()` 才进入下一层 | 最外层的返回值 | 传播给发起方 | 鉴权、租户校验、输入改写、阻断 |
| `parallel` 扇出 | 全部并发 | 结果列表，顺序同监听器顺序 | 全部完成后抛聚合异常 | 多渠道通知、并行校验 |
| `serial` 按序 | 逐个 await | 结果列表 | 首个异常处中断 | 逐步迁移、有序收尾 |
| `bail` 首值 | 逐个 await | 首个非空返回值 | 传播给发起方 | 否决、解析器链、首个匹配的 Provider |

## waterfall 即中间件

运行时本身没有业务语义：租户、鉴权、审计等强制执行点都是 base 组合包里的 `waterfall` 监听器。下面的示意按规格 §5.2 的 API 写成，类型名为举例：

```csharp
// Definition 包：定义事件并标注分发模式
public static class FileEvents
{
    public static readonly KunEvent<UploadRequest, UploadResult> Uploading =
        KunEvent.Define<UploadRequest, UploadResult>("files.uploading", DispatchMode.Waterfall);
}

// 某个插件的 ApplyAsync 里：挂一层环绕监听器，调用 next() 才进入下一层
ctx.On(FileEvents.Uploading, DispatchMode.Waterfall,
    new Func<UploadRequest, Func<ValueTask<UploadResult>>, ValueTask<UploadResult>>(async (request, next) =>
    {
        if (request.Size > MaxUploadBytes)
            throw new UploadRejectedException("超过单文件上限");
        return await next();
    }),
    priority: 100);
```

- 分发的 scope 等于发起方的 `ctx.Scope`；全局监听器对所有 scope 可见，scope 内的监听器只对该 scope 可见。
- 事件名全局唯一，两个 Definition 定义同名事件即挂载失败。
- 组件 `hooks.json` 里的 command / http 监听器由 [qian.hooks](/components/platform/qian.hooks.md) 转成同模式的进程内监听器，priority 默认 `-100`。
- 跨进程的集成事件走 [qian.events](/components/platform/qian.events.md) 的 Outbox。

详见[组件模型规格](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md) §5.4。

# 前端 SDK

本页说明 Kun 旧应用外壳归档源码使用的 Qian 0.2.1 SDK。业务预发保留原有部署和数据。匠心工业智能体平台的 Web 与桌面端采用 DSH 外壳。

旧外壳是一棵由 `@cavailab/qian-runtime` 装载的插件树，与后端同一套语义：上下文、服务注册、类型化事件、可逆副作用、scope。

| 包 | 内容 |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `@cavailab/qian-runtime` | 运行时：上下文 `ctx`、`provide` / `inject`、事件、副作用、装载器 |
| `@cavailab/qian-plugin-sdk` | 插件开发包的前端部分：与外壳交互的桥接 API（随 qian.shell 提供，PRD §7.15） |
| `@cavailab/qian-sdk` | 注册表 API、`PlatformClient`、请求拦截器链（鉴权刷新、租户头）、i18n |

- **服务键**：TS 侧小驼峰（`files`），.NET 侧大驼峰（`Files`），两侧各自声明常量，文档生成器把它们对应到同一 seam。`ctx.files` 是代理属性，等价于 `ctx.inject("files")`。
- **远程模块**：外壳 [qian.shell](/components/platform/qian.shell.md) 是 MF2 宿主，按需加载插件的远程模块；`react`、`react-dom`、`@cavailab/qian-*`（含 `@cavailab/qian-plugin-sdk`）作为共享单例。
- **插槽**：导航、设置、用户菜单、命令、预览等插槽都带版本号与输入数据 Schema。

## API 草图

节选自[组件模型规格](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md) §5.3（以规格为准）：

```ts
export type ScopeKey = "global" | `${"tenant" | "app" | "agent-session"}:${string}`;
export type DispatchMode = "emit" | "waterfall" | "parallel" | "serial" | "bail";

export interface QianPlugin<C = unknown> {
  readonly name: string; // 组件 id
  readonly inject?: readonly ServiceKey[];
  apply(ctx: Context, config: C): void | Promise<void>;
}

export interface Context {
  readonly scope: ScopeKey;
  provide<T>(key: ServiceKey<T>, value: T): Disposer;
  inject<T>(key: ServiceKey<T>): T;
  on<P, R>(evt: QianEvent<P, R>, mode: DispatchMode, handler: HandlerFor<P, R>, priority?: number): Disposer;
  dispatch<P, R>(evt: QianEvent<P, R>, payload: P): Promise<R>;
  scoped(scope: ScopeKey): Context;
}
```

组件的界面怎么写，见前端框架 Qian 的组件文档（在归档仓库的标签里，本站只有一页[说明](/components/qian/index.md)）；API 参考（TypeDoc 生成）随 S1-DOCS-002 上线。

# AI SDK

「AI SDK」是对外统一的名称，覆盖三件事：调模型、让 Agent 用上你的组件、与 Agent 运行时对接。Qian **不写 Agent loop**、沙箱、记忆与技能引擎，这些由下游智能体平台提供（[ADR-016](/design/adr/adr-016-agent-boundary.md)）。

## 调模型与 Embedding

经[模型网关](/sdk/ai/gateway.md)的 OpenAI 兼容端点调用，用逻辑模型名（如 `chat-default`）而不是供应商的模型名；按租户的配额、限流与计量在平台侧完成，调用方不自己记账。S1 先接 LLM 与 Embedding。

## 让 Agent 用上你的组件

- **声明式表面**：skills、agents、commands、hooks、tools 写在组件文件夹里，装组件即生效，S1 就是一等公民（见[表面](/start/concepts/surface.md)、[文件格式](/cli/surfaces.md)）。
- **工具元数据**：每个工具声明 `sideEffect`、`policyHint`、`requiredScopes`、`requiredSecrets`（只写名字）、`schemaSha256` 与 `contractVersion`，与下游智能体平台契约对齐；写类工具必须幂等。
- **能力目录**：工具定义由[能力目录](/sdk/dotnet/capabilities.md)机械生成，暴露哪些、怎么描述单独策划。
- **MCP**：组件可以附带 `.mcp.json`；每租户的 MCP 能力门面在 S4，见 [MCP](/sdk/ai/mcp.md)。

## 与 Agent 运行时对接

见 [Agent 运行时对接](/sdk/ai/agent-runtime.md)；隔离执行 Agent 生成的代码见[沙箱](/sdk/ai/sandbox.md)（S4）。

# 模型网关

**阶段**：S1 可选（P1），由 [qian.model-gateway](/components/platform/qian.model-gateway.md) 交付；接线与运维见[模型网关接线](/ops/model-gateway.md)。

## 是什么

- 一个 OpenAI 兼容端点调所有模型：推理层 GPUStack 作为本地上游注册进 Higress，外部供应商同样注册为上游；Qian 不自写模型代理层，也不绕过 Higress 直连推理层（[ADR-015](/design/adr/adr-015-model-gateway.md)）。
- 调用方用**逻辑模型名**（如 `chat-default`），映射到具体供应商与模型的配置放在 Git 里。
- 按租户的限流与计量经 Higress 的 consumer 与统计插件完成；计量表从第一天带 `tenant_id + project_id` 双键。
- 租户级模型路由是「产品默认 + 租户覆盖」，租户的坏配置回退到默认（fail-open）；自带模型端点只能注册为 Higress 上游，应用不能直连。

## 发一条请求

```bash
curl "$MODEL_GATEWAY/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MODEL_GATEWAY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "chat-default", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "用一句话介绍 Qian"}]}'
```

`MODEL_GATEWAY` 与 `MODEL_GATEWAY_KEY` 由运维提供（见[模型网关接线](/ops/model-gateway.md)）。应用经租户 API Key 调用、计量进统一用量账本的方案待 S3 定（ADR-015 D15.9）；S1–S2 只保证契约形状与双键约定一致。

## 分阶段

| 阶段 | 内容 |
| ------ | ---------------------------- |
| S1（可选） | 上游注册、Provider Adapter、逻辑模型目录 |
| S2 | 模型目录与按用途路由 |
| S3 | 租户可见的模型门户、成本与配额预算告警 |
| S4 | Higress 托管每租户 MCP 逻辑门面 |

# Agent 运行时对接

Qian 不是 Agent 框架。分工（[ADR-016](/design/adr/adr-016-agent-boundary.md)）：

| 角色 | 负责 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Qian | 能力提供方 + 业务主数据权威：组件、能力目录、权限、审计 |
| 下游智能体平台 | Agent 运行时 + AI 资产控制面：Agent loop、沙箱、记忆、技能引擎 |
| Higress | 共用数据面：模型与 MCP 流量 |
| Kun | 共用的身份、审计、Outbox 基座 |

## 接入要点

- **身份**：服务间调用用 S2S JWT，claim 形状与下游智能体平台对齐（`iss / aud[] / sub / tenant_id / project_id? / roles[] / scope / session_id`，有效期不超过 300 秒，「加 scope 不加 claim」）。
- **调用路径**（S4）：Agent 不直连 Qian 服务的裸地址，一律经 Higress 的 MCP 路由；令牌绑定受众、禁止透传、最小 scope + 逐步提权；「知道 ID 不构成权限」。
- **工具**：写类工具必须幂等；工具元数据（副作用、策略提示、所需 scope 与密钥名）见 [AI SDK](/sdk/ai/index.md)。
- **生成**：Agent 生成应用 = 生成组件包，经 schema 校验、TCK、差异审阅与人工确认；生成的代码只落沙箱，并记录生成来源与审核人。

对接以下游智能体平台冻结的契约与代码为准，不依赖其设计态能力。

# MCP

| 能力 | 阶段 | 说明 |
| ------------------ | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 组件的 `.mcp.json` 表面 | S1 | 组件附带的 MCP 服务器随组件安装，进 `ctx.McpServers` 并受 scope 过滤；`headers` / `env` 里的密钥写成 `secretRef://`，明文密钥校验报错 |
| 文档检索 MCP | S1（可选） | 让编码代理检索本站内容 |
| 每租户 MCP 能力门面 | S4 | MCP 服务器按租户的逻辑门面托管在 Higress，而不是每个插件一个进程；工具定义由能力目录生成 |

- 协议以 MCP 2026-07-28 版为目标（无状态、`server/discover`、头部路由、可缓存列表），经 `server/discover` 兼容旧客户端（[ADR-016 D16.4](/design/adr/adr-016-agent-boundary.md)）。
- 网关按 `Mcp-Method` / `Mcp-Name` 头路由，敏感参数不进头部（[ADR-010](/design/adr/adr-010-gateway-layers.md)）。
- `.mcp.json` 的文件格式见[声明式表面的文件格式](/cli/surfaces.md)。

# 沙箱

**阶段**：S4，尚未开始。

- Qian 不写沙箱。S4 对接 CubeSandbox（E2B 兼容 API）隔离执行不可信或 Agent 生成的代码（[ADR-016 D16.2](/design/adr/adr-016-agent-boundary.md)）。
- 在此之前，第三方代码不进共享进程：按信任等级限定运行形态，函数类代码走 Wasm 沙箱（`function` 表面，S2 起），界面走浏览器隔离（[组件模型规格](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md) §11）。
- Agent 生成的代码只落在 `function` 沙箱里（ADR-016 D16.11）。

### Classes

[AuditChainEntry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditchainentry.md)

持久化的链节点；序号和前序都参与哈希验证。

[AuditChainVerification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditchainverification.md)

全链验证结果；BrokenAt 指出最早不一致的位置，不回显敏感记录。

[AuditDefinition](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditdefinition.md)

组件间的审计 seam，不是客户端可直接调用的审计写入 HTTP API。

[AuditErrors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditerrors.md)

审计组件的稳定错误码。

[AuditInputProjection](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditinputprojection.md)

由可信能力契约构造的输入审计策略；元数据不能来自调用请求。脱敏后才计算输入哈希。

[AuditProtocol](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditprotocol.md)

审计 v1 的确定性 JSON：键按 ordinal 排序，精确十进制数规整，数组顺序保留，重复键拒绝。

[AuditRecord](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/auditrecord.md)

进入审计链的不可变记录；输入只保留脱敏后的哈希，Payload 须由可信调用方按审计契约构造。

[NativeAuditErrors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-audit/nativeauditerrors.md)

原生审计 Provider 的安全装配错误，不包含连接凭据。

# Namespace Kun.Authorization

### Classes

[AuthorizationSubject](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/authorizationsubject.md)

统一授权主体；权限集合不从令牌直接推导。

[FieldDecision](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/fielddecision.md)

字段可读、可写与需要脱敏的集合。

[PermissionDecision](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/permissiondecision.md)

可解释判定；Allow=false 是缺省语义。

[PermissionRequest](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/permissionrequest.md)

权限点与可选资源实例；Permission 使用稳定的资源动作编码。

[RequiresPermissionAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/requirespermissionattribute.md)

HTTP/gRPC 端点的静态权限元数据。

### Interfaces

[IDataPermissionFilter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/idatapermissionfilter.md)

本地数据过滤端口，不依赖 EF 包或具体数据库。

[IFieldPolicy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/ifieldpolicy.md)

字段权限端口；输出给服务端投影与写入白名单。

[IPermissionChecker](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/ipermissionchecker.md)

权限判定端口；框架不提供 RBAC、ABAC 或持久化引擎。

[IPermissionEnforcementInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/ipermissionenforcementinterceptor.md)

标识在调用 gRPC 处理器前执行端点权限要求的拦截器。

[IPermissionEnforcementRequirement](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/ipermissionenforcementrequirement.md)

标识端点授权策略里执行某个权限点的要求。宿主的权限回调给端点加上这样的要求，构造端点时据此核对权限点确实接上了执行点；
自定义执行点让自己的授权要求实现本接口。

[IPermissionProtectedRequest](/sdk/api/kun/kun-authorization/ipermissionprotectedrequest.md)

命令在编译期声明全部所需权限，避免从用户提交的 JSON 改写权限点。

# Interface IKunCache

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Caching` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Caching`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Caching)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Caching.Abstractions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Caching.dll

Unified cache abstraction for Kun Framework consumers. Implementations
back to an in-process [`IMemoryCache`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.caching.memory.imemorycache)
or to a distributed [`IDistributedCache`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.caching.distributed.idistributedcache)
(Redis via StackExchange) — see
`Kun.Caching.Implementations.MemoryKunCache` and
`Kun.Caching.Implementations.RedisKunCache`.

```csharp
public interface IKunCache
```

## Remarks

The generic methods are annotated with
[`RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.codeanalysis.requiresunreferencedcodeattribute) and
[`RequiresDynamicCodeAttribute`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.codeanalysis.requiresdynamiccodeattribute) because the default
`System.Text.Json`-backed serializer walks the type argument
by reflection. AOT-strict consumers can replace the default
serializer with a source-generated implementation; see
[IKunCacheSerializer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncacheserializer.md).

## Methods

### GetBytesAsync(string, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Caching_Abstractions_IKunCache_GetBytesAsync_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

### GetOrSetAsync\<T>(string, Func\<CancellationToken, Task\<T>>, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Caching_Abstractions_IKunCache_GetOrSetAsync__1_System_String_System_Func_System_Threading_CancellationToken_System_Threading_Tasks_Task___0___System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Returns the cached value, invoking `factory` exactly
once under concurrent access on the same process when the key is
absent. The produced value is written to the cache under
`key` before being returned.

```csharp
[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Default serializer uses reflection. Pass a source-generated IKunCacheSerializer for AOT safety.")]
[RequiresDynamicCode("Default serializer uses reflection. Pass a source-generated IKunCacheSerializer for AOT safety.")]
Task<T> GetOrSetAsync<T>(string key, Func<CancellationToken, Task<T>> factory, TimeSpan? ttl = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`key` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

`factory` [Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)\<[CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken), [Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<T>>

`ttl` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<T>

#### Type Parameters

`T`

#### Remarks

Single-flight protection is local to the process — cross-process
stampedes can still occur. Use an external distributed lock for
that scenario.

## Properties

### DefaultTtl \{#Kun_Caching_Configuration_KunCachingOptions_DefaultTtl}

TTL applied to `SetAsync` / `GetOrSetAsync` calls that
omit an explicit `ttl`. [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) (default)
means entries never expire when no explicit TTL is given.

```csharp
public TimeSpan? DefaultTtl { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

### FallbackToMemoryOnRedisFailure \{#Kun_Caching_Configuration_KunCachingOptions_FallbackToMemoryOnRedisFailure}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), the Redis backend swallows
connection / socket exceptions and routes reads and writes to a
sidecar in-memory cache for the duration of the outage. The
exception is logged at `Warning` and never propagated.
Default is [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool); callers see the exception
and decide.

```csharp
public bool FallbackToMemoryOnRedisFailure { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

### KeyPrefix \{#Kun_Caching_Configuration_KunCachingOptions_KeyPrefix}

Prefix prepended to every key passed to the cache. Ideal for
namespacing per-service caches on a shared Redis. Empty / null
means no prefix (default).

```csharp
public string? KeyPrefix { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

### Classes

[MemoryKunCache](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-implementations/memorykuncache.md)

In-process [IKunCache](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncache.md) backed by
[`IMemoryCache`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.caching.memory.imemorycache). Stores values directly — no
serialization round-trip — so mutations on cached reference
types are visible to other consumers. Callers that care about
isolation should cache immutable records or value types.

[RedisKunCache](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-implementations/rediskuncache.md)

Distributed [IKunCache](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncache.md) backed by an
[`IDistributedCache`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.caching.distributed.idistributedcache) instance (typically
`Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.StackExchangeRedis`). Values are
serialized via the registered [IKunCacheSerializer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncacheserializer.md).

[SystemTextJsonCacheSerializer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-implementations/systemtextjsoncacheserializer.md)

Default [IKunCacheSerializer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-caching-abstractions/ikuncacheserializer.md) backed by
[`JsonSerializer`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.jsonserializer). Uses web-style options (camelCase,
case-insensitive reads) and respects the caller's
[`JsonSerializerOptions`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.jsonserializeroptions) when supplied.

## Remarks

When `KunCachingOptions.FallbackToMemoryOnRedisFailure = true`,
connection / socket failures are swallowed and the operation is
routed to an in-memory sidecar cache for the duration of the
outage. The fallback is per-process; other replicas will not see
writes made while Redis is unreachable.

### GetOrSetAsync\<T>(string, Func\<CancellationToken, Task\<T>>, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Caching_Implementations_RedisKunCache_GetOrSetAsync__1_System_String_System_Func_System_Threading_CancellationToken_System_Threading_Tasks_Task___0___System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

### Classes

[ApolloConfigurationDescription](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-apollo/apolloconfigurationdescription.md)

已装配的 Apollo 配置源与其脱敏的发布记录。

[ApolloConfigurationExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-apollo/apolloconfigurationextensions.md)

显式添加 Apollo；源顺序由宿主按 appsettings、Apollo、Secret、环境变量、命令行安排。

[ApolloConfigurationProvider](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-apollo/apolloconfigurationprovider.md)

通过公开协议获取服务级配置；无网络且无缓存时启动失败，不以空配置继续。

[ApolloConfigurationSource](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-apollo/apolloconfigurationsource.md)

Apollo 标准 IConfiguration 源。

[ApolloOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-apollo/apollooptions.md)

平台／服务级 Apollo 引导配置；不承载租户级配置或明文业务密钥。

[ApolloReleaseRecord](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-apollo/apolloreleaserecord.md)

一份快照的发布结果，仅含资源标识、变更数量、原因码与脱敏摘要。

[KunApolloConfigurationExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-apollo/kunapolloconfigurationextensions.md)

固定配置源顺序，复用 Kun 的协议、缓存、签名与重载实现。

[KunConfigurationOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-apollo/kunconfigurationoptions.md)

配置装配参数；引导值来自宿主源，Apollo 不能改变自己的访问地址或访问密钥引用。

# Namespace Kun.Configuration.Attributes

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Configuration` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Configuration`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Configuration)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[NonEmptyStringConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/nonemptystringconfigattribute.md)

Validates that the string value is non-null and non-whitespace.
Combine with [RequiredConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/requiredconfigattribute.md) when the key
must also be present in the configuration tree — by itself this
attribute accepts [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

[RequiredConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/requiredconfigattribute.md)

[`RequiredAttribute`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.componentmodel.dataannotations.requiredattribute) tuned for configuration errors —
rejects [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) values and produces an error
message that names the missing key rather than the generic
"field is required" text.

[UrlConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/urlconfigattribute.md)

Validates that the string value parses as an absolute URI via
[`TryCreate`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uri.trycreate). Accepts
[null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) — pair with
[RequiredConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/requiredconfigattribute.md) when the key is mandatory.

# Class NonEmptyStringConfigAttribute

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Configuration` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Configuration`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Configuration)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Configuration.Attributes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Configuration.dll

Validates that the string value is non-null and non-whitespace.
Combine with [RequiredConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/requiredconfigattribute.md) when the key
must also be present in the configuration tree — by itself this
attribute accepts [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property, AllowMultiple = false)]
public sealed class NonEmptyStringConfigAttribute : ValidationAttribute
```

# Class RequiredConfigAttribute

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Configuration` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Configuration`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Configuration)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Configuration.Attributes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Configuration.dll

[`RequiredAttribute`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.componentmodel.dataannotations.requiredattribute) tuned for configuration errors —
rejects [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) values and produces an error
message that names the missing key rather than the generic
"field is required" text.

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property, AllowMultiple = false)]
public sealed class RequiredConfigAttribute : RequiredAttribute
```

# Class UrlConfigAttribute

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Configuration` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Configuration`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Configuration)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Configuration.Attributes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Configuration.dll

Validates that the string value parses as an absolute URI via
[`TryCreate`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uri.trycreate). Accepts
[null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) — pair with
[RequiredConfigAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration-attributes/requiredconfigattribute.md) when the key is mandatory.

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property, AllowMultiple = false)]
public sealed class UrlConfigAttribute : ValidationAttribute
```

### AddKunOptions\<TOptions>(IServiceCollection, string) \{#Kun_Configuration_Extensions_KunConfigurationServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunOptions__1_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_String\_}

Registers `TOptions` bound to
`section`, validates DataAnnotations
attributes at host start, and fails fast with
section-qualified messages.

```csharp
[RequiresUnreferencedCode("DataAnnotations-based options validation walks properties by reflection.")]
[RequiresDynamicCode("DataAnnotations-based options validation walks properties by reflection.")]
[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("ConfigurationBinder", "SYSLIB1100", Justification = "Consumer opts into reflection-based binding by calling this annotated entry point.")]
[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("ConfigurationBinder", "SYSLIB1101", Justification = "Consumer opts into reflection-based binding by calling this annotated entry point.")]
[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("ConfigurationBinder", "SYSLIB1104", Justification = "Consumer opts into reflection-based binding by calling this annotated entry point.")]
public static OptionsBuilder<TOptions> AddKunOptions<TOptions>(this IServiceCollection services, string section) where TOptions : class
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

Service collection to register into.

`section` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Configuration section path (e.g. `"Authentik"`, `"Database:Primary"`).

#### Returns

[OptionsBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.options.optionsbuilder-1)\<TOptions>

The underlying [`OptionsBuilder`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.options.optionsbuilder-1) for further chaining.

#### Type Parameters

`TOptions`

Options type; must be a reference type. Annotated with
[`All`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.codeanalysis.dynamicallyaccessedmembertypes.all) so the
trimmer preserves the properties DataAnnotations walks.

DataAnnotations. Register one per options type via
`services.AddSingleton<IKunConfigurationValidator<T>, MyValidator>()`
and `AddKunOptions<T>` will merge the results with any
DataAnnotations-driven validation.

```csharp
public interface IKunConfigurationValidator<in TOptions> where TOptions : class
```

### Classes

[ConfigDefinition](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/configdefinition.md)

平台/服务级只读配置 seam；租户设置由 Tenancy 管理。

[ConfigErrors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/configerrors.md)

配置组件的稳定错误词汇。

[ConfigEvents](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/configevents.md)

配置组件的事件与审计词汇；只含稳定标识，不含任何配置值。

[ConfigReloadFailed](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/configreloadfailed.md)

重载失败告警（[ConfigEvents.ReloadFailedType](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/configevents.md#Kun_Configuration_ConfigEvents_ReloadFailedType)）：options 类型与名称、配置节、失败条数与错误码；
不含任何配置值，也不含校验消息原文（自定义校验器的消息可能带值）。

[ConfigRuntimeEvents](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/configruntimeevents.md)

Config seam 的进程内扩展事件（组件模型规格 §6.4）。

[FeatureFlagDraft](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/featureflagdraft.md)

草稿操作输入；目标环境、应用、namespace、操作员与秘密引用均由可信宿主固定。

[FeatureFlagDraftResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/featureflagdraftresult.md)

草稿写入回执，不含 Token 或规则内容。

[FeatureFlagManagement](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/featureflagmanagement.md)

可选平台管理组件的声明；只保存 Apollo 草稿，发布仍由 Portal 操作员完成。

[FeatureFlagPolicy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/featureflagpolicy.md)

固定灰度规则；没有表达式、外部地址或任意配置键。

[FeatureFlagRule](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/featureflagrule.md)

从快照读取的一份开关规则。

[FeatureFlagRules](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/featureflagrules.md)

解析并校验配置快照中的特性开关规则。

[OptionsReloadFailure](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/optionsreloadfailure.md)

一次被拒绝的候选配置，仅包含登记信息和失败条数。

[OptionsSchema](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/optionsschema.md)

由源生成 JSON 元数据导出的配置契约，不包含任何运行时配置值。

[SecretAccessEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/secretaccessevent.md)

一次解析审计，只含引用名、调用方、租户和结果，不含值。

[SecretDiagnostic](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/secretdiagnostic.md)

不含原值的配置扫描诊断。

[SecretErrors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/secreterrors.md)

秘密解析的统一错误，不把输入值或物理路径放进错误文案。

[SecretGrant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/secretgrant.md)

与 policy.permissions.secrets 条目对应的权限，不因声明本身而自动获批。

[SecretReference](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/secretreference.md)

公开的规范引用；Kubernetes 定位只在受信任存储绑定中使用。

[SecretSafety](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/secretsafety.md)

配置契约级敏感数据扫描，可供发布门禁与 Apollo 快照验证共用。

[SecretValue](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/secretvalue.md)

密钥的受控内存副本；默认打印和 JSON 序列化不暴露内容。

[SecretValueJsonConverter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/secretvaluejsonconverter.md)

禁止把已解析密钥当作普通 JSON 数据。

### Interfaces

[IConfigService](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/iconfigservice.md)

供受信任代码读取配置；不提供写入入口，也不自动公开为模型工具。

[IFeatureFlagDrafts](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/ifeatureflagdrafts.md)

平台专用草稿写入；实现每次重新检查已认证主体、确认、权限与审计。

[IFeatureFlags](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/ifeatureflags.md)

只读租户灰度求值；不读取权益，不改变租户 scope 的组件挂载。

[IKunConfigurationValidator\<TOptions>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/ikunconfigurationvalidator-1.md)

Reflection-free options validator — the AOT-safe alternative to
DataAnnotations. Register one per options type via
`services.AddSingleton<IKunConfigurationValidator<T>, MyValidator>()`
and `AddKunOptions<T>` will merge the results with any
DataAnnotations-driven validation.

[ISecretAccessObserver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/isecretaccessobserver.md)

可替换的审计接收端；写入失败不得返回密钥。

[ISecretResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/isecretresolver.md)

已绑定调用方权限的按需密钥解析端口。

[ISecretResolverFactory](/sdk/api/kun/kun-configuration/isecretresolverfactory.md)

宿主根据已审批策略创建解析器；平台调用方身份取自真实插件上下文。

# Class AggregateRoot\<TKey, TUserKey>

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Core.Domain](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

DDD 聚合根基类。

聚合根是领域一致性边界的持有者，所有外部修改必须通过聚合根的公开方法进行。
持久化细节（ORM 属性、表映射）一律不在此类出现——它们属于基础设施层的职责。

```csharp
public abstract class AggregateRoot<TKey, TUserKey> : Entity<TKey>, IEquatable<Entity<TKey>>, IAggregateRoot<TKey>, IAggregateRoot, ISoftDelete, IAuditedObject<TUserKey>, IAuditedObject where TKey : notnull
```

#### Type Parameters

`TKey`

主键类型。

`TUserKey`

审计用户 ID 类型，支持 [`Guid`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid)、[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/reference-types)、[long](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/integral-numeric-types)。

# Interface IDomainEventDispatcher

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Core.Domain](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

Dispatches domain events to their in-process handlers.

Called by the Unit of Work immediately before persistence commits, so handlers run inside
the same EF Core transaction that produced the aggregate changes. For cross-service events,
handlers translate the domain event into an [IIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iintegrationevent.md) and enqueue it
via the Outbox.

```csharp
public interface IDomainEventDispatcher
```

## Methods

### DispatchAsync(IReadOnlyCollection\<IDomainEvent>, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Core_Domain_IDomainEventDispatcher_DispatchAsync_System_Collections_Generic_IReadOnlyCollection_Kun_Core_Domain_IDomainEvent__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Dispatch the given domain events to all registered handlers, in insertion order.

```csharp
ValueTask DispatchAsync(IReadOnlyCollection<IDomainEvent> domainEvents, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`domainEvents` [IReadOnlyCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ireadonlycollection-1)\<[IDomainEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/idomainevent.md)>

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

#### Returns

[ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask)

本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[AggregateRoot\<TKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/aggregateroot-1.md)

便捷重载：审计用户 ID 默认为 [`Guid`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid)。

[AggregateRoot\<TKey, TUserKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/aggregateroot-2.md)

DDD 聚合根基类。

聚合根是领域一致性边界的持有者，所有外部修改必须通过聚合根的公开方法进行。
持久化细节（ORM 属性、表映射）一律不在此类出现——它们属于基础设施层的职责。

[Entity\<TKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/entity-1.md)

DDD 实体基类。实体的相等性由 [Entity\<TKey>.Id](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/entity-1.md#Kun_Core_Domain_Entity_1_Id) 决定，而非属性集合（这是实体与值对象的核心区别）。

[ValueObject](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/valueobject.md)

DDD 值对象基类。值对象没有独立标识，相等性由其所有组成属性决定。
值对象应当是不可变的——修改应返回新实例，而非改变现有实例。

### Interfaces

[IAggregateRoot\<TKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iaggregateroot-1.md)

带强类型 Key 的聚合根标记接口。

[IAggregateRoot](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iaggregateroot.md)

聚合根标记接口（非泛型）。用于框架内部通过 `ChangeTracker` 按类型筛选。

[IAuditedObject](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iauditedobject.md)

通用审计接口，记录创建/修改时间。

[IAuditedObject\<TUserKey>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iauditedobject-1.md)

带用户标识的审计接口。
`TUserKey` 可以是 [`Guid`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid)、[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/reference-types)、[long](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/integral-numeric-types) 等，
以兼容本地用户、外部 IdP 的 `sub`、数据库自增等不同场景。

[IDomainEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/idomainevent.md)

标记领域事件。领域事件由聚合根内部产生，表示业务上发生的重要事实。
领域事件仅在聚合根边界内同步分发；若需跨服务传递，请在事件处理器中
转换为 [IIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iintegrationevent.md)。

[IDomainEventDispatcher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/idomaineventdispatcher.md)

Dispatches domain events to their in-process handlers.

Called by the Unit of Work immediately before persistence commits, so handlers run inside
the same EF Core transaction that produced the aggregate changes. For cross-service events,
handlers translate the domain event into an [IIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iintegrationevent.md) and enqueue it
via the Outbox.

[IIntegrationEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/iintegrationevent.md)

集成事件标记接口。集成事件用于跨服务、跨进程的异步通知，
与领域事件不同，集成事件通过 Outbox + 消息总线传递，具备版本演进能力。

[IMultiTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md)

标记实体支持多租户隔离。由 `KunDbContext` 自动附加 `TenantId` 全局过滤器。

[ISoftDelete](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/isoftdelete.md)

标记实体支持软删除。由基础设施层在持久化时挂载全局查询过滤器。

# Interface ITenantContext

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

```csharp
public interface ITenantContext
```

# Interface ITenantProvisioner

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Core.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

租户生命周期钩子：开户（[ITenantProvisioner.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantProvisioner_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_)）与注销（[ITenantProvisioner.DeprovisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantProvisioner_DeprovisionAsync_System_Guid_System_Threading_CancellationToken_)）。

```csharp
public interface ITenantProvisioner
```

## Remarks

Shared 策略不需要具体实现 —— 新租户只是多一行 `TenantId` 的业务记录。消费者只需要注册
[NullTenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/nulltenantprovisioner.md)（或依赖框架提供的 Singleton 默认值）。

SchemaPerTenant 与 DatabasePerTenant 策略依赖本接口的非空实现：在租户开户时分别创建 schema
或独立数据库，并在该隔离容器内运行 EF Core migrations。实现必须是**幂等的** ——
使用 `CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS` / `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS` 语义；
重复调用不得产生副作用。

调用时机由业务方控制；框架不做自动编排。典型场景：租户 signup API 成功创建租户记录后，
同事务（或补偿事务）里调用 [ITenantProvisioner.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantProvisioner_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_)；租户注销走反向流程。

:::info 生成页
