:::

### Classes

[ResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/resultextensions.md)

Synchronous railway-oriented extensions for [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) and
[Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011.

[TaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/taskresultextensions.md)

Asynchronous railway-oriented extensions for [`Task`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)
receivers whose result type is [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) or
[Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011.

[ValueTaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/valuetaskresultextensions.md)

Asynchronous railway-oriented extensions for
[`ValueTask`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1) receivers whose result type is
[Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) or [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011;
mirror of [TaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/taskresultextensions.md) for hot paths that
avoid [`Task`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task) allocation (Mediator pipeline).

### Structs

[Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md)

无返回值的 Result。Handler 在不需要返回数据时使用。失败时携带 [Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md)：
一个登记在错误码目录里的错误码，加文案参数与出错位置。

[Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md)

带返回值的 Result。Handler 成功时携带 `T`，失败时携带 [Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md)。

## Remarks

Every method short-circuits on failure inputs: the supplied delegate is
**not** invoked and the original [Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md) is carried through
unchanged. See `docs/architecture/ADR-011-Result-async-extensions.md`
for normative semantics, naming rationale, and async counterparts on
`Task<Result>` / `ValueTask<Result>` sources.

receivers whose result type is [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) or

## Remarks

Each operation provides two delegate-shape overloads:

- a _sync-delegate_ variant (no [`CancellationToken`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken))
- an _async-delegate_ variant that accepts a [`CancellationToken`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken) and forwards it to the delegate.

Failure inputs short-circuit without invoking the delegate. Faulted or
cancelled source tasks surface through `await` per normal
.NET semantics — neither a [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) failure nor a wrapped
exception.

# Class ValueTaskResultExtensions

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Core` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Core`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Core)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Core.Results](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Core.dll

Asynchronous railway-oriented extensions for
[`ValueTask`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1) receivers whose result type is
[Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md) or [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md). Follows ADR-011;
mirror of [TaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/taskresultextensions.md) for hot paths that
avoid [`Task`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task) allocation (Mediator pipeline).

```csharp
public static class ValueTaskResultExtensions
```

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←

[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Return types and async-delegate return types are
[`ValueTask`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask) / [`ValueTask`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1) to keep
the fluent chain on the ValueTask rail without
`.AsTask()` boundary friction. Callers holding
[`Task`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1) sources should use
[TaskResultExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/taskresultextensions.md) instead.

## Properties

### GeneratesTemporaryValues \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_Conventions_KunGuidV7ValueGenerator_GeneratesTemporaryValues}

Gets a value indicating whether the values generated are temporary (i.e they should be replaced
by database generated values when the entity is saved) or are permanent (i.e. the generated values
should be saved to the database).

```csharp
public override bool GeneratesTemporaryValues { get; }
```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

#### Remarks

```
An example of temporary value generation is generating negative numbers for an integer primary key
that are then replaced by positive numbers generated by the database when the entity is saved. An
example of permanent value generation are client-generated values for a [`Guid`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid) primary
key which are saved to the database.

See [EF Core value generation](https://aka.ms/efcore-docs-value-generation) for more information and examples.
```

### AddKunTenantRls(IServiceCollection) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_DependencyInjection_KunEntityFrameworkCoreServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunTenantRls_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection\_}

兼容入口：注册 RLS 双拦截器；推荐使用泛型重载自动装配。Consumers must
also wire the interceptor into their DbContext options via DI resolution, e.g.

```csharp
services.AddDbContext<CatalogDbContext>((sp, options) =>
    options.UseNpgsql(cs)
           .UseKunSchema("catalog")
           .AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor>()));
```

Scoped lifetime — each request's [ITenantContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md)
is resolved per transaction. Not added automatically because the interceptor fires a
`set_config` round-trip on every transaction; services without RLS should not pay
that cost.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunTenantRls(this IServiceCollection services)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection to configure.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The same `services` for chaining.

### UseKunSchema(DbContextOptionsBuilder, string) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_Extensions_KunDbContextOptionsBuilderExtensions_UseKunSchema_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_DbContextOptionsBuilder_System_String\_}

Wires a service-scoped default schema through EF Core's migrations history table so
`__ef_migrations_history` co-locates with business tables under
`schema`. Use in tandem with `KunDbContext.DefaultSchema`
overriding the same value — the [SchemaConsistencyInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/schemaconsistencyinterceptor.md)
registered automatically by [KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md) raises a clear exception at the
first `SaveChangesAsync` if the two diverge.

```csharp
public static DbContextOptionsBuilder UseKunSchema(this DbContextOptionsBuilder builder, string schema)
```

#### Parameters

`builder` [DbContextOptionsBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder)

The options builder to configure. A relational provider
(e.g. `.UseNpgsql(...)`) must already be applied.

`schema` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Service-scoped schema name (e.g. `"catalog"`).

#### Returns

[DbContextOptionsBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder)

The same `builder` for chaining.

#### Exceptions

[ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception)

`builder` is null.

[ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception)

`schema` is null/empty.

[InvalidOperationException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception)

No relational provider has been configured
on `builder`.

### SavingChanges(DbContextEventData, InterceptionResult\<int>) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_Interceptors_AuditFieldsSaveChangesInterceptor_SavingChanges_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_DbContextEventData_Microsoft_EntityFrameworkCore_Diagnostics_InterceptionResult_System_Int32\_\_}

Called at the start of `DbContext.SaveChanges`.

```csharp
public override InterceptionResult<int> SavingChanges(DbContextEventData eventData, InterceptionResult<int> result)
```

#### Parameters

`eventData` [DbContextEventData](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.dbcontexteventdata)

Contextual information about the [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) being used.

`result` [InterceptionResult](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1)\<[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)>

Represents the current result if one exists.
This value will have [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) set to [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) if some previous
interceptor suppressed execution by calling [`SuppressWithResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.suppresswithresult).
This value is typically used as the return value for the implementation of this method.

#### Returns

[InterceptionResult](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1)\<[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)>

If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is false, the EF will continue as normal.
If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is true, then EF will suppress the operation it
was about to perform and use [`Result`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.result) instead.
An implementation of this method for any interceptor that is not attempting to change the result
is to return the `result` value passed in.

### Classes

[AuditFieldsSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/auditfieldssavechangesinterceptor.md)

在业务保存前填充审计字段，保留创建字段，拒绝无法转换的已认证主体。

[SchemaConsistencyInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/schemaconsistencyinterceptor.md)

Fails fast when a [KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md)'s `DefaultSchema` diverges from the EF Core
`MigrationsHistoryTable` schema. Throws at the first `SaveChangesAsync` so developers
catch mis-wired `UseKunSchema` calls before any business write lands in the wrong schema.

[TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/tenantrlsconnectioninterceptor.md)

Defence-in-depth interceptor that pushes the current [ITenantContext.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantContext_TenantId)
into the PostgreSQL session variable `app.current_tenant_id` on every
connection open, and clears it on connection close. Used in combination with
Row-Level Security policies on the database side — EF Core's global query
filter remains the first line of defence; this interceptor is the second.

[TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/tenantrlstransactioninterceptor.md)

Emits `set_config('app.current_tenant_id', @tenant, true)` at the start of every
EF Core transaction so PostgreSQL Row-Level Security policies can use
`current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')` to enforce tenant isolation even when a
caller bypasses the global query filter (e.g. `IgnoreQueryFilters()`, admin scenarios).

# Class SchemaConsistencyInterceptor

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.Interceptors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Fails fast when a [KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md)'s `DefaultSchema` diverges from the EF Core
`MigrationsHistoryTable` schema. Throws at the first `SaveChangesAsync` so developers
catch mis-wired `UseKunSchema` calls before any business write lands in the wrong schema.

```csharp
public sealed class SchemaConsistencyInterceptor : ISaveChangesInterceptor, IInterceptor
```

## Remarks

The check runs at most once per interceptor instance (gated by
[`CompareExchange`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.interlocked.compareexchange)). Per `kun-gap-closure-v1.md`
M5, the comparison cannot run at `OnModelCreating` time because the relational model is
not yet finalized — `SavingChangesAsync` is the earliest correct hook point.

[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Only activates when the underlying [`DbConnection`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.data.common.dbconnection) is an Npgsql
connection; for other providers (MySQL, SQL Server) the interceptor is a
no-op, because the `SET app.current_tenant_id = ...` syntax is
PostgreSQL-specific. The check is nominal (namespace-prefix on the connection
type) so this module can remain free of a direct Npgsql package dependency.

Tenant IDs are emitted in the canonical UUID format.

Registered as Scoped by [KunEntityFrameworkCoreServiceCollectionExtensions.AddKunEntityFrameworkCore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-dependencyinjection/kunentityframeworkcoreservicecollectionextensions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_DependencyInjection_KunEntityFrameworkCoreServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunEntityFrameworkCore_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_);
callers opt in by adding the interceptor to their `DbContextOptionsBuilder`:

```csharp
services.AddDbContext<MyDbContext>((sp, opts) =>
{
    opts.UseNpgsql(connectionString);
    opts.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsConnectionInterceptor>());
});
```

Emits `set_config('app.current_tenant_id', @tenant, true)` at the start of every
EF Core transaction so PostgreSQL Row-Level Security policies can use
`current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')` to enforce tenant isolation even when a
caller bypasses the global query filter (e.g. `IgnoreQueryFilters()`, admin scenarios).

## Remarks

Hooks `TransactionStartedAsync` / `TransactionStarted` rather than
`ConnectionOpenedAsync`: PgBouncer in transaction-pooling mode recycles the backend
connection at transaction boundaries, so setting a GUC outside an explicit transaction
would leak across tenants. Scoping to `SET LOCAL` (equivalently
`set_config(..., is_local=true)`) ties the setting to the current transaction.

Uses `set_config(...)` instead of `SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id = '...'` because
Postgres's `SET` utility statement does not accept parameter binding; the function form
does, keeping the tenant id out of the SQL text (defence against log leakage / injection).

No-op when [ITenantContext.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantContext_TenantId) is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null)
(background jobs / setup scripts). RLS policies must be written to accept
`current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true) IS NULL` as the unscoped path if those
flows need to read cross-tenant data; otherwise they must set the GUC manually.

[ITenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md) for the
[TenantIsolation.Database](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolation.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolation_Database) strategy. Runs EF Core
migrations against the tenant's dedicated database on [DatabasePerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/databasepertenantprovisioner-1.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_DatabasePerTenantProvisioner_1_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).

is an operations concern (needs admin credentials and often a separate control plane) —
the framework does not take that responsibility.


## Remarks

Assumes the tenant's database has already been **created** at the server
level by an operations workflow (Terraform, K8s Operator, cloud provider API). This
provisioner's job is to bring the schema up-to-date via
`Database.MigrateAsync()`. Databases cannot be reliably created in a portable way
across Postgres / MySQL / SQL Server from EF Core itself, so that step is delegated.

For scenarios where the app owns database creation, subclass this provisioner and
override [DatabasePerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/databasepertenantprovisioner-1.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_DatabasePerTenantProvisioner_1_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) to run your vendor-specific `CREATE DATABASE`
before calling `base.ProvisionAsync`.

# Interface IDbConnectionResolver

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Resolves the connection string for a given tenant. Used by the
[TenantIsolation.Database](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolation.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolation_Database) strategy
to dispatch DbContext construction to the tenant's dedicated database.

```csharp
public interface IDbConnectionResolver
```

## Remarks

Implementations must be thread-safe (called concurrently from scoped request handlers)
and idempotent. The default [OptionsBasedTenantConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/optionsbasedtenantconnectionresolver.md) reads
a static tenant→connection-string map from [TenantsConnectionOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md).
Larger deployments typically swap in a custom implementation backed by a secrets store
or a tenant-metadata service.

# Interface IKunMultiTenantDbContext

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Marker interface for `DbContext`s that want the
[KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenantmodelcachekeyfactory.md) to partition EF
Core's compiled-model cache per tenant. Implementers expose the
ambient tenant id so the factory can emit a distinct cache key for
each tenant, preventing EF from folding the query-filter constant
across tenants on the first model build.

```csharp
public interface IKunMultiTenantDbContext
```

## Remarks

`Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.KunDbContext` already exposes an
equivalent `TenantIdForModelCacheKey` property; custom
contexts that inherit from plain [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext)
should implement this interface to opt into per-tenant isolation.

## Properties

### TenantIdForModelCacheKey \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_IKunMultiTenantDbContext_TenantIdForModelCacheKey}

### Classes

[DatabasePerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/databasepertenantprovisioner-1.md)

[ITenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md) for the
[TenantIsolation.Database](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolation.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolation_Database) strategy. Runs EF Core
migrations against the tenant's dedicated database on [DatabasePerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/databasepertenantprovisioner-1.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_DatabasePerTenantProvisioner_1_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).
[DatabasePerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>.DeprovisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/databasepertenantprovisioner-1.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_DatabasePerTenantProvisioner_1_DeprovisionAsync_System_Guid_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) is a no-op by default because dropping a tenant database
is an operations concern (needs admin credentials and often a separate control plane) —
the framework does not take that responsibility.

[KunMultiTenancyModelBuilderExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancymodelbuilderextensions.md)

[`ModelBuilder`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.modelbuilder) extensions that attach the Kun multi-tenant
global query filter to every [IMultiTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md) entity.

[KunMultiTenancyOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md)

Configuration for `AddKunMultiTenancy`. Selects the isolation strategy and tunes
the few knobs the framework exposes across all three strategies.

[KunMultiTenancyServiceCollectionExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyservicecollectionextensions.md)

DI entry point for Kun's SaaS multi-tenancy strategy selection. Dispatches based on
[KunMultiTenancyOptions.Strategy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_Strategy).

[KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenantmodelcachekeyfactory.md)

[`IModelCacheKeyFactory`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.infrastructure.imodelcachekeyfactory) that emits a distinct compiled
model per tenant when the [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) implements
[IKunMultiTenantDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/ikunmultitenantdbcontext.md). Falls back to EF Core's
default key shape (context type + design-time flag) otherwise, so
consumers who forget to opt in get the same behaviour they had
before. The [TenantIsolation.Schema](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolation.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolation_Schema)
strategy relies on the same key: each tenant's schema-specific model is compiled separately,
and a [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) tenant (no scoped tenant) shares one model.

[KunTenantSaveChangesInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kuntenantsavechangesinterceptor.md)

EF Core [`SaveChangesInterceptor`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.savechangesinterceptor) that walks newly added
[IMultiTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md) entities and, when their
[IMultiTenant.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md#Kun_Core_Domain_IMultiTenant_TenantId) is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) or
empty, injects the ambient [ITenantContext.TenantId](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_ITenantContext_TenantId).
Explicit values must be non-empty UUIDs in lowercase D format.
Valid explicit values take precedence over the ambient tenant.

[OptionsBasedTenantConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/optionsbasedtenantconnectionresolver.md)

Default [IDbConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/idbconnectionresolver.md) backed by [TenantsConnectionOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md).
Reads the current snapshot on every call via [`IOptionsMonitor`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.options.ioptionsmonitor-1)
so on-the-fly config reloads reach new tenants without restarting the host.

[SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/schemapertenantprovisioner-1.md)

[ITenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md) implementation for the
[TenantIsolation.Schema](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolation.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolation_Schema) strategy. On
[SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>.ProvisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/schemapertenantprovisioner-1.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_SchemaPerTenantProvisioner_1_ProvisionAsync_Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantInfo_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) executes `CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "{schema}"`
and runs EF Core migrations under that schema; on [SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>.DeprovisionAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/schemapertenantprovisioner-1.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_SchemaPerTenantProvisioner_1_DeprovisionAsync_System_Guid_System_Threading_CancellationToken_)
drops the schema when [KunMultiTenancyOptions.AllowDestructiveDeprovision](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_AllowDestructiveDeprovision)
is enabled, else throws.

[TenantsConnectionOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md)

Static tenant → connection-string mapping consumed by
[OptionsBasedTenantConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/optionsbasedtenantconnectionresolver.md). Suitable for small deployments
where the full tenant list is known at configuration time (appsettings.json or
Kubernetes ConfigMap).

### Interfaces

# Interface ITenantDbContextFactory\<TContext>

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Builds a `TContext` instance bound to a specific tenant's schema
or database. Used by [SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/schemapertenantprovisioner-1.md) at tenant
provisioning time, when the ambient [ITenantContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md)
may not yet reference the new tenant.

```csharp
public interface ITenantDbContextFactory<TContext> where TContext : DbContext
```

#### Type Parameters

`TContext`

The concrete [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) subclass.

## Remarks

Consumers implement this interface once per DbContext type. A minimal implementation
wraps `DbContextOptionsBuilder.UseNpgsql(...).UseKunSchema(options.GetSchemaName(tenantId))` and returns
a freshly-constructed `TContext`.

For **runtime query access** (inside a request), prefer the standard
DI-injected `TContext` registered via
`AddDbContext<TContext>` with the schema derived by [KunMultiTenancyOptions.GetSchemaName](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_GetSchemaName_System_Guid_)
combined with [KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenantmodelcachekeyfactory.md). The factory is the explicit
escape hatch for administrative / provisioning flows that must target a specific tenant
regardless of the ambient context.

## Properties

### AllowDestructiveDeprovision \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_AllowDestructiveDeprovision}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), `SchemaPerTenantProvisioner.DeprovisionAsync` is
permitted to run `DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS "{schema}" CASCADE`. Default is
[false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) — deprovisioning is a data-loss operation and must be an
explicit opt-in. When left at the default, `DeprovisionAsync` throws
[`NotSupportedException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) with a remediation message.

```csharp
public bool AllowDestructiveDeprovision { get; set; }
```

### AddKunMultiTenancy\<TContext>(IServiceCollection, Action\<KunMultiTenancyOptions>) \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunMultiTenancy__1_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions\_\_}

Registers the multi-tenancy services for a specific DbContext type. Must be called
BEFORE the matching `AddDbContext<TContext>`, and the consumer is
responsible for registering their own [ITenantDbContextFactory\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/itenantdbcontextfactory-1.md)
when [KunMultiTenancyOptions.Strategy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_Strategy) is
[TenantIsolation.Schema](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolation.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolation_Schema).

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunMultiTenancy<TContext>(this IServiceCollection services, Action<KunMultiTenancyOptions> configure) where TContext : DbContext
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunMultiTenancyOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md)>

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

#### Type Parameters

`TContext`

#### Remarks

**Shared**: delegates to `AddKunTenantRls()` — no additional services
beyond the RLS interceptor and [NullTenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/nulltenantprovisioner.md) default.

**SchemaPerTenant**: registers [KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenantmodelcachekeyfactory.md),
the [TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-interceptors/tenantrlstransactioninterceptor.md) (defence-in-depth), a
Singleton [SchemaPerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/schemapertenantprovisioner-1.md) as the
[ITenantProvisioner](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantprovisioner.md) implementation, and binds
[KunMultiTenancyOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md). Consumers must also add the schema selection
and the model-cache factory to their DbContext options, e.g.:

```csharp
services.AddDbContext<CatalogDbContext>((sp, opts) =>
    opts.UseNpgsql(cs)
        .UseKunSchema(sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<KunMultiTenancyOptions>>().Value.GetSchemaName(
            sp.GetRequiredService<ITenantContext>().TenantId ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Tenant required.")))
        .ReplaceService<IModelCacheKeyFactory, KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory>()
        .AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<TenantRlsTransactionInterceptor>()));
```

**DatabasePerTenant**: registers a default
[OptionsBasedTenantConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/optionsbasedtenantconnectionresolver.md) reading from
[TenantsConnectionOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md) plus a Singleton
[DatabasePerTenantProvisioner\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/databasepertenantprovisioner-1.md). Consumers are still responsible
for registering their own [ITenantDbContextFactory\<TContext>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/itenantdbcontextfactory-1.md) that
resolves the tenant's connection string via [IDbConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/idbconnectionresolver.md) and
constructs a DbContext bound to that connection. Entries bound from configuration
([TenantsConnectionOptions.ConfiguredConnectionStrings](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_TenantsConnectionOptions_ConfiguredConnectionStrings)) are merged into
[TenantsConnectionOptions.ConnectionStrings](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_TenantsConnectionOptions_ConnectionStrings). Host start fails when a key is not
a non-empty UUID in lowercase D format, or when code and configuration disagree for a tenant.

**Strategy snapshotting**: the [KunMultiTenancyOptions.Strategy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_Strategy)
value set by `configure` is captured at registration time to decide
which services to register. A subsequent
`services.Configure<KunMultiTenancyOptions>` that mutates
[KunMultiTenancyOptions.Strategy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/kunmultitenancyoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_KunMultiTenancyOptions_Strategy) will NOT retro-actively change the DI
wiring — the options-read path would disagree with the registered graph. Set the
strategy exactly once, inside this call's `configure` delegate.

# Class KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

[`IModelCacheKeyFactory`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.infrastructure.imodelcachekeyfactory) that emits a distinct compiled
model per tenant when the [`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) implements
[IKunMultiTenantDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/ikunmultitenantdbcontext.md). Falls back to EF Core's
default key shape (context type + design-time flag) otherwise, so
consumers who forget to opt in get the same behaviour they had
before. The [TenantIsolation.Schema](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/tenantisolation.md#Kun_Core_MultiTenancy_TenantIsolation_Schema)
strategy relies on the same key: each tenant's schema-specific model is compiled separately,
and a [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) tenant (no scoped tenant) shares one model.


## Remarks

Register on the [`DbContextOptionsBuilder`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder):
`.ReplaceService<IModelCacheKeyFactory, KunMultiTenantModelCacheKeyFactory>()`.

Without this factory, EF Core keys compiled models only on
[`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) type. The first tenant's query filter is
then baked into the shared model — subsequent tenants would read
against the first tenant's filter constant, silently leaking data
across tenant boundaries.

# Class TenantsConnectionOptions

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EntityFrameworkCore.dll

Static tenant → connection-string mapping consumed by
[OptionsBasedTenantConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/optionsbasedtenantconnectionresolver.md). Suitable for small deployments
where the full tenant list is known at configuration time (appsettings.json or
Kubernetes ConfigMap).

```csharp
public sealed class TenantsConnectionOptions
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←
[TenantsConnectionOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md)

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),
[object.ToString()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.tostring),
[object.Equals(object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object\)),
[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

Bind the section with `Configure<TenantsConnectionOptions>(configuration.GetSection(TenantsConnectionOptions.SectionName))`.
Under `ConnectionStrings`, each key is a tenant ID as a non-empty UUID in lowercase D format.
The configuration binder cannot populate [`Guid`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid)-keyed dictionaries, so the section lands in
[TenantsConnectionOptions.ConfiguredConnectionStrings](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_TenantsConnectionOptions_ConfiguredConnectionStrings). `AddKunMultiTenancy<TContext>` with
`TenantIsolation.Database` merges those entries into [TenantsConnectionOptions.ConnectionStrings](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/tenantsconnectionoptions.md#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_MultiTenancy_TenantsConnectionOptions_ConnectionStrings). The host fails to start when a key is not
a canonical UUID or when code and configuration give one tenant different connection strings.

For scale, swap in a custom [IDbConnectionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore-multitenancy/idbconnectionresolver.md) implementation backed
by a secret manager + tenant-metadata service. See the P2-D Part 3 notes in
`docs/architecture/adr-p2d-multitenancy.md`.

Domain events that also implement [INotification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotification.md) are routed to all
registered [INotificationHandler\<TNotification>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotificationhandler-1.md)s via [IPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/ipublisher.md).
Events that do not implement [INotification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotification.md) are silently skipped.

[KunApplicationRoleInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kunapplicationroleinterceptor.md)

在线应用连接只能使用受 RLS 约束的 PostgreSQL 角色；迁移管理员通过独立连接执行 DDL。

[KunDataMisconfiguredException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundatamisconfiguredexception.md)

在构造上下文或启动宿主时拒绝不安全的数据层配置。

[KunDataModelExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundatamodelextensions.md)

安装不可由派生上下文遗漏的 Kun 模型约定。

[KunDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kundbcontext.md)

Base EF Core DbContext for Kun Framework services.

[KunSoftDeleteInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kunsoftdeleteinterceptor.md)

将直接删除改为软删除，填充删除主体与时间；必须在 Kun 审计字段拦截器之前运行。

[KunStrictDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kunstrictdbcontext.md)

带安全装配门禁的数据上下文。租户过滤与 Outbox 继承 Kun 的行为。

[NoOpDomainEventDispatcher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/noopdomaineventdispatcher.md)

Default no-op domain event dispatcher. Users replace this with a real implementation
(e.g. one backed by `Kun.Mediator.IPublisher`) by registering their own
[IDomainEventDispatcher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/idomaineventdispatcher.md) before calling `AddKunEntityFrameworkCore`.

[OutboxMessageConfiguration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/outboxmessageconfiguration.md)

EF Core mapping for [OutboxMessage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/outboxmessage.md).

### Interfaces

[IDataContextCatalog](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/idatacontextcatalog.md)

宿主经 AddKunData 登记的全部业务上下文；Outbox 投递等宿主级组件据此逐个处理各上下文的表。

[IDataService](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/idataservice.md)

同一上下文中的业务变更、领域通知与 Outbox 保存边界。

Atomic unit-of-work boundary for command handlers.

## Remarks

[IPublisher.Publish](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/ipublisher.md#Kun_Mediator_IPublisher_Publish__1___0_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) is a generic method keyed on the
concrete notification type at runtime. Because `Kun.EntityFrameworkCore` is not
AOT-compatible (its project file does not set `IsAotCompatible`), reflection is permitted here to
invoke `Publish` with the exact concrete type so the Mediator dispatcher can
resolve the correct [INotificationHandler\<TNotification>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotificationhandler-1.md) registrations.

要求 `UseKunSchema` 指定的 schema 以 `prefix` 开头，前缀之后仍须小写字母开头、只含小写字母、数字和下划线，总长不超过 63 个字符。
不调用时 [KunStrictDbContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-entityframeworkcore/kunstrictdbcontext.md) 只要求合法的小写标识符。前缀设定后不能改成别的，再次设定不同的前缀即拒绝。

```csharp
public static DbContextOptionsBuilder RequireKunSchemaPrefix(this DbContextOptionsBuilder options, string prefix)
```

#### Parameters

`options` [DbContextOptionsBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder)

数据上下文的配置。

`prefix` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

小写字母开头、只含小写字母、数字和下划线的前缀，最长 62 个字符。

#### Returns

[DbContextOptionsBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontextoptionsbuilder)

## Remarks

Applies automatic global query filters for [IMultiTenant](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/imultitenant.md) entities
(filters out rows whose `TenantId` does not match the current tenant scope)
and for [ISoftDelete](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-domain/isoftdelete.md) entities (excludes soft-deleted rows).
Ensures the Outbox is registered for atomic enqueue.

## Properties

### DefaultSchema \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_KunDbContext_DefaultSchema}

Default database schema for this context. When non-[null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null), applied via
[`HasDefaultSchema`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.relationalmodelbuilderextensions.hasdefaultschema)
before entity configurations run — tables and Outbox storage all land under this
schema by default. Callers should also configure `MigrationsHistoryTable` to the
same schema on the Npgsql options so migrations + business tables co-locate.

```csharp
protected virtual string? DefaultSchema { get; }
```

#### Property Value

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

#### Remarks

Overriding services' DbContexts (e.g. `CatalogDbContext`) should return a service-scoped
schema like `"catalog"` to enable single-database, multi-schema isolation
(SAD §5.1). Leaving this [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) preserves legacy `public`-schema
behavior.

### TenantIdForModelCacheKey \{#Kun_EntityFrameworkCore_KunDbContext_TenantIdForModelCacheKey}

Exposes the current tenant ID for use by a custom `IModelCacheKeyFactory`
so EF Core builds a distinct compiled model per tenant rather than sharing the
first-built model across all instances of the same DbContext type. Query filters also
read this member through the executing DbContext, rather than retaining another host's accessor.

```csharp
public string? TenantIdForModelCacheKey { get; }
```

If [`HasResult`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.hasresult) is true, then EF will suppress the operation it
was about to perform and use [`Result`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.diagnostics.interceptionresult-1.result) instead.
An implementation of this method for any interceptor that is not attempting to change the result
is to return the `result` value passed in.

## Methods

### AddKunErrors(IServiceCollection, Action\<ErrorCatalog>?) \{#Kun_Errors_AspNetCore_KunErrorsExtensions_AddKunErrors_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_Errors_ErrorCatalog\_\_}

注册错误码目录（含平台内置错误码）、[ErrorException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorexception.md) 的异常处理，
并把经 [`IProblemDetailsService`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.iproblemdetailsservice) 写出的一切 ProblemDetails 规范为 ErrorDetail 形状。
可重复调用：目录只建一次，`configure` 每次都作用于同一目录。

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunErrors(this IServiceCollection services, Action<ErrorCatalog>? configure = null)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

服务集合。

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<ErrorCatalog>?

登记组件自己的错误码。

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

### UseKunErrors(IApplicationBuilder) \{#Kun_Errors_AspNetCore_KunErrorsExtensions_UseKunErrors_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Builder_IApplicationBuilder\_}

在管道最前面启用异常处理与状态码兜底：未处理异常、空响应体的 4xx / 5xx（未认证、404、请求体无法解析等）
都写成 ErrorDetail。等价于 `UseExceptionHandler()` + `UseStatusCodePages()`。

```csharp
public static IApplicationBuilder UseKunErrors(this IApplicationBuilder app)
```

# Class Error

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Errors` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Errors`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Errors)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Errors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Errors.dll

一次出错：哪个错误码、文案参数、出错位置与允许值。进程内由 `Kun.Core.Results.Result` 携带或随
[ErrorException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorexception.md) 抛出；对外由 [ErrorCatalog.CreateDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorcatalog.md#Kun_Errors_ErrorCatalog_CreateDetail_Kun_Errors_Error_System_String_System_Globalization_CultureInfo_System_String_) 渲染为 [ErrorDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetail.md)。

```csharp
public sealed class Error
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←
[Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md)

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),

[object.Equals(object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object\)),
[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

字段错误有多个时放进 [Error.Errors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md#Kun_Errors_Error_Errors)，此时顶层 [Error.Pointer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md#Kun_Errors_Error_Pointer) / [Error.Allowed](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md#Kun_Errors_Error_Allowed) 留空，
由渲染取第一项；只有一个出错位置的业务错误直接设 [Error.Pointer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md#Kun_Errors_Error_Pointer)。

# Class ErrorCatalog

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Errors` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Errors`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Errors)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Errors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Errors.dll

错误码目录：全局唯一的错误码登记处，渲染 [ErrorDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetail.md)，并导出
contracts/v0/error-catalog.schema.json 格式的 JSON（错误码与多语言文案）。

```csharp
public sealed class ErrorCatalog
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←
[ErrorCatalog](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorcatalog.md)

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),
[object.ToString()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.tostring),
[object.Equals(object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object\)),
[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

同一错误码只能有一份定义：再次登记完全相同的定义按引用计数共享，定义不同即失败。
[ErrorCatalog.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorcatalog.md#Kun_Errors_ErrorCatalog_Register_Kun_Errors_ErrorCode_) 返回的释放函数撤销本次登记，供插件卸载时逆序撤销（ctx.Effect）。线程安全。

### CreateDetail(Error, string, CultureInfo?, string?) \{#Kun_Errors_ErrorCatalog_CreateDetail_Kun_Errors_Error_System_String_System_Globalization_CultureInfo_System_String\_}


#### Parameters

#### Returns

[ErrorDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetail.md)

#### Exceptions

一个登记在错误码目录里的稳定错误码：类别、状态码、归属组件与多语言文案。
组件在自己的 Definition 包里以 `static readonly` 字段定义，挂载时登记到 [ErrorCatalog](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorcatalog.md)。

## Remarks

文案以 BCP 47 语言标签为键，`zh-CN` 必填；文案模板里的 `{name}` 是占位符，
各语言的占位符集合必须相同，出错方按名字提供参数（[Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md)）。

## Fields

`Business = 1`

业务错误：请求合法且已授权，业务规则拒绝。状态码只用 409（状态冲突）或 422（规则不满足）。

`Field = 2`

字段级错误码：只出现在 `errors[]` 里，不能作为响应的顶层 `code`。

`Protocol = 0`

协议错误：请求未进入业务语义即被拒——解析、契约校验、认证、鉴权、寻址、限流、服务端故障。
状态码不用 409 / 422。

### Namespaces

[Kun.Errors.AspNetCore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors-aspnetcore/index.md)

### Classes

[AllowedValues](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/allowedvalues.md)

构造 `allowed`（允许的取值，1–100 个 JSON 值）。

[Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md)

一次出错：哪个错误码、文案参数、出错位置与允许值。进程内由 `Kun.Core.Results.Result` 携带或随
[ErrorException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorexception.md) 抛出；对外由 [ErrorCatalog.CreateDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorcatalog.md#Kun_Errors_ErrorCatalog_CreateDetail_Kun_Errors_Error_System_String_System_Globalization_CultureInfo_System_String_) 渲染为 [ErrorDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetail.md)。

[ErrorCatalog](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorcatalog.md)

错误码目录：全局唯一的错误码登记处，渲染 [ErrorDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetail.md)，并导出
contracts/v0/error-catalog.schema.json 格式的 JSON（错误码与多语言文案）。

[ErrorCode](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorcode.md)

一个登记在错误码目录里的稳定错误码：类别、状态码、归属组件与多语言文案。
组件在自己的 Definition 包里以 `static readonly` 字段定义，挂载时登记到 [ErrorCatalog](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorcatalog.md)。

[ErrorDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetail.md)

错误响应体（contracts/v0/error-detail.schema.json）：RFC 9457 problem+json 的 Kun 配置文件。
由 [ErrorCatalog.CreateDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorcatalog.md#Kun_Errors_ErrorCatalog_CreateDetail_Kun_Errors_Error_System_String_System_Globalization_CultureInfo_System_String_) 生成；序列化用 [ErrorDetailJson](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetailjson.md)。
v0 已冻结，只接受向后兼容增量；冻结标记是 Schema 元数据，不属于错误响应体。

[ErrorDetailJson](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetailjson.md)

[ErrorDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetail.md) 的 JSON 序列化（源生成，AOT 可用；空成员不输出；中文不转义）。

[ErrorException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorexception.md)

携带 [ErrorException.Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorexception.md#Kun_Errors_ErrorException_Error) 的异常，Kun 只有这一个带错误码的异常：业务代码直接抛出，或由
`Result<T>.EnsureSuccess()` 在失败时抛出；HTTP 宿主由 Kun.Errors.AspNetCore 写成 problem+json，
gRPC 宿主由 Kun.Grpc 的拦截器转成对应的状态码。

[ErrorPointer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorpointer.md)

构造 `pointer`：RFC 6901 JSON Pointer 的 URI 片段形式，可带文档前缀。
请求输入写 `#/items/0/qty`；文件写 `.qian-plugin/plugin.json#/runtime/nuget/0`。

[FieldError](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/fielderror.md)

`errors[]` 中的一项：字段级或业务错误码 + 出错位置。

[FieldErrorDetail](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/fielderrordetail.md)

[ErrorDetail.Errors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errordetail.md#Kun_Errors_ErrorDetail_Errors) 中的一项。

[PlatformErrors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md)

平台内置错误码（归属 `qian.runtime`），冻结在 contracts/v0/error-codes.json。
协议错误覆盖宿主框架会产生的全部状态码；业务错误只有两个通用兜底，具体业务错误码由各组件在 Definition 包登记。

平台内置错误码（归属 `qian.runtime`），冻结在 contracts/v0/error-codes.json。
协议错误覆盖宿主框架会产生的全部状态码；业务错误只有两个通用兜底，具体业务错误码由各组件在 Definition 包登记。

```csharp
public static class PlatformErrors
```

### ForStatus(int) \{#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_ForStatus_System_Int32\_}

某个 HTTP 状态码的兜底错误码：用于宿主框架自己产生、没有带错误码的错误响应。
没有专门错误码的 4xx 落到 [PlatformErrors.BadRequest](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_BadRequest)、5xx 落到 [PlatformErrors.Internal](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_Internal)，响应状态码保持原值。

## Methods

### TryAcquireAsync(string, TimeSpan, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_EventBus_Background_IOutboxLockProvider_TryAcquireAsync_System_String_System_TimeSpan_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Tries to acquire a distributed lock with the given `lockName`.

```csharp
ValueTask<IAsyncDisposable?> TryAcquireAsync(string lockName, TimeSpan ttl, CancellationToken ct = default)
```

#### Parameters

`lockName` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

A well-known name that all competing pods use (e.g. `"outbox-publisher"`).

`ttl` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)

How long the lock is held before it auto-expires.

`ct` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask-1)\<[IAsyncDisposable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iasyncdisposable)?>

An [`IAsyncDisposable`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iasyncdisposable) that releases the lock on disposal, or
[null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when the lock is already held by another instance.

### Register\<TEvent>(string) \{#Kun_EventBus_DependencyInjection_KunEventBusBuilder_Register__1_System_String\_}

```csharp
public IEventTypeRegistrar Register<TEvent>(string eventType) where TEvent : class
```

#### Parameters

`eventType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

#### Returns

IEventTypeRegistrar

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

#### Remarks

Serialization falls back to reflection-based `System.Text.Json` defaults. AOT-targeting
consumers should prefer the
[IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0__) overload instead to thread a
source-generated [`JsonTypeInfo`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.metadata.jsontypeinfo-1) through the outbox.

### Register\<TEvent>(string, JsonTypeInfo\<TEvent>) \{#Kun_EventBus_DependencyInjection_KunEventBusBuilder_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0\_\_}

Registers a mapping between `eventType` token and
`TEvent`, plus the source-generated
[`JsonTypeInfo`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.metadata.jsontypeinfo-1) used to serialize outbox payloads without runtime reflection.

```csharp
public IEventTypeRegistrar Register<TEvent>(string eventType, JsonTypeInfo<TEvent> typeInfo) where TEvent : class
```

#### Parameters

`eventType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Stable event-id token (e.g. `order.placed.v1`).

`typeInfo` [JsonTypeInfo](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.metadata.jsontypeinfo-1)\<TEvent>

JsonTypeInfo for `TEvent`, typically obtained from a
`[JsonSerializable(typeof(TEvent))]`-decorated [`JsonSerializerContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.jsonserializercontext).

#### Returns

IEventTypeRegistrar

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

### Register\<TEvent>() \{#Kun_EventBus_DependencyInjection_KunEventBusBuilder_Register__1}

Registers `TEvent` using the token declared on its
[IntegrationEventIdAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/integrationeventidattribute.md). Throws
[`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception) when the attribute is absent.

```csharp
[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Reads [IntegrationEventId] via reflection on typeof(TEvent). Under trimming, IntegrationEventIdAttribute instances must be preserved. Use Register<TEvent>(string) to avoid reflection entirely.")]
public IEventTypeRegistrar Register<TEvent>() where TEvent : class
```

#### Returns

IEventTypeRegistrar

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

#### Remarks

Reads the attribute reflectively once at DI-registration time; the resulting
registry is the same O(1) [IEventTypeRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md) used at steady state.
AOT-strict callers can stick with [IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_) or
[IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0__) to avoid the reflection entirely.

### Classes

[InMemoryProcessedMessageStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-idempotency/inmemoryprocessedmessagestore.md)

In-memory implementation of [IProcessedMessageStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-idempotency/iprocessedmessagestore.md) backed by a
[`ConcurrentDictionary`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.concurrent.concurrentdictionary-2). Intended for testing and
single-instance scenarios only — state is lost on restart and is not shared
across multiple processes.

[RedisProcessedMessageStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-idempotency/redisprocessedmessagestore.md)

Redis-backed implementation of [IProcessedMessageStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-idempotency/iprocessedmessagestore.md) using
`SET … NX EX` for atomic first-write semantics. Suitable for distributed,
multi-instance deployments.

### Interfaces

[IProcessedMessageStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-idempotency/iprocessedmessagestore.md)

Tracks message IDs that have already been successfully processed by a given consumer,
enabling idempotent at-least-once delivery. Implementations are broker-agnostic
(Redis, in-memory, SQL).

single-instance scenarios only — state is lost on restart and is not shared
across multiple processes.

```csharp
public sealed class InMemoryProcessedMessageStore : IProcessedMessageStore
```

Assembly: Kun.EventBus.dll

Tracks message IDs that have already been successfully processed by a given consumer,
enabling idempotent at-least-once delivery. Implementations are broker-agnostic
(Redis, in-memory, SQL).

```csharp
public interface IProcessedMessageStore
```

# Namespace Kun.EventBus.Outbox

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EventBus.Abstractions` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[IntegrationEventBuffer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/integrationeventbuffer.md)

In-memory accumulator for outbox messages within a single unit-of-work scope.

[OutboxMessage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/outboxmessage.md)

Persisted Outbox message row. Created when an integration event is enqueued inside a
`SaveChangesAsync` transaction; published asynchronously by the background publisher.

### Interfaces

[IIntegrationEventOutbox](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/iintegrationeventoutbox.md)

Appends outbox messages to the current unit-of-work boundary.

[IOutboxBufferBinding](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/ioutboxbufferbinding.md)

替换 Kun 默认累加器的 Outbox 写入端（如事件组件的信封写入端）声明自己写入的缓冲器；
数据会话只接受写入当前 scope 缓冲器的实现，保证事件随同一次保存落库。

[IOutboxWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/ioutboxwriter.md)

Writer primitive for enqueuing integration events from non-aggregate collaborators
(e.g. audit interceptors, storage-event adapters) inside the current DbContext
`SaveChangesAsync` transaction, preserving outbox atomicity.

### Enums

[OutboxStatus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/outboxstatus.md)

Lifecycle state of a persisted Outbox message.

# Interface IOutboxWriter

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EventBus.Abstractions` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EventBus.Outbox](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EventBus.Abstractions.dll

Writer primitive for enqueuing integration events from non-aggregate collaborators
(e.g. audit interceptors, storage-event adapters) inside the current DbContext
`SaveChangesAsync` transaction, preserving outbox atomicity.

```csharp
public interface IOutboxWriter
```

## Remarks

The DI container resolves [IOutboxWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/ioutboxwriter.md) to the same scoped instance as
[IIntegrationEventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventbus.md) — both interfaces name the same accumulator. Prefer
[IOutboxWriter](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/ioutboxwriter.md) when the caller is an infrastructure collaborator (interceptor,
adapter) rather than a domain aggregate or command handler; the narrower contract
communicates intent and decouples from the full bus surface.

## Methods

### Enqueue\<TEvent>(TEvent) \{#Kun_EventBus_Outbox_IOutboxWriter_Enqueue__1___0\_}

Enqueues an integration event for atomic commit with the pending DbContext change set.
Produces the same [OutboxMessage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/outboxmessage.md) shape as
[IIntegrationEventBus.Publish](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventbus.md#Kun_EventBus_IIntegrationEventBus_Publish__1___0_): stable event id via
[IEventTypeRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md), current tenant and trace context captured.

```csharp
void Enqueue<TEvent>(TEvent @event) where TEvent : class
```

#### Parameters

`event` TEvent

The event instance to enqueue. Must not be [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

The integration event type. Must be registered via [IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md).

Namespace: [Kun.EventBus.Outbox](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EventBus.Abstractions.dll

Persisted Outbox message row. Created when an integration event is enqueued inside a
`SaveChangesAsync` transaction; published asynchronously by the background publisher.

```csharp
public sealed class OutboxMessage
```

# Namespace Kun.EventBus.RabbitMQ

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EventBus.RabbitMQ` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EventBus.RabbitMQ`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EventBus.RabbitMQ)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[KunEventsRabbitMqExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-rabbitmq/kuneventsrabbitmqextensions.md)

Registers the RabbitMQ envelope publisher and subscribers.

[KunEventsSubscriberBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-rabbitmq/kuneventssubscriberbuilder.md)

订阅登记（PRD 7.10 的 `Subscribe<TEvent, THandler>()`）：每次登记把一个 Kun handler 挂到一个订阅上。
同一订阅可以覆盖多个事件，但一个事件在同一订阅里只有一个 handler；广播订阅共用实例队列，同一事件在一个服务里只能有一个广播订阅。

[KunEventsSubscriberOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-rabbitmq/kuneventssubscriberoptions.md)

消费端的宿主级设置。重试语义与 Outbox 投递侧不同：这里的 [KunEventsSubscriberOptions.MaxRetries](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-rabbitmq/kuneventssubscriberoptions.md#Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_KunEventsSubscriberOptions_MaxRetries) 是首投之外的重试次数，
默认首投 1 次 + 重试 5 次，第 6 次仍失败即进死信队列。

### AddKunEventsBroker(IServiceCollection, Func\<IServiceProvider, string>, string?) \{#Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_KunEventsRabbitMqExtensions_AddKunEventsBroker_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Func_System_IServiceProvider_System_String__System_String\_}

登记 RabbitMQ 发布端。AMQP URI 在首次连接时经 `resolveAmqpUri` 读取，值不进入组件清单；
`brokerReference` 是组件配置 `broker` 应匹配的 secretRef。

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunEventsBroker(this IServiceCollection services, Func<IServiceProvider, string> resolveAmqpUri, string? brokerReference = null)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

`resolveAmqpUri` [Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)\<[IServiceProvider](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iserviceprovider), [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>

### AddKunEventsSubscriber(IServiceCollection, string, Action\<KunEventsSubscriberBuilder>, Action\<KunEventsSubscriberOptions>?) \{#Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_KunEventsRabbitMqExtensions_AddKunEventsSubscriber_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_String_System_Action_Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_KunEventsSubscriberBuilder__System_Action_Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_KunEventsSubscriberOptions\_\_}

登记消费端（S1-EVT-002）：`service` 是订阅方服务名，`subscribe` 里逐个 `Subscribe<TEvent, THandler>()`。
消费连接与发布端分开（ClientProvidedName 为 qian.events.subscriber），AMQP 地址复用 [KunEventsRabbitMqExtensions.AddKunEventsBroker](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-rabbitmq/kuneventsrabbitmqextensions.md#Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_KunEventsRabbitMqExtensions_AddKunEventsBroker_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Func_System_IServiceProvider_System_String__System_String_) 登记的引用；
幂等记录默认写 Redis（宿主登记 IConnectionMultiplexer，或以 Kun 的 UseRedisIdempotency 登记 IProcessedMessageStore）。
可以多次调用以追加订阅，服务名必须相同；缺少 broker、幂等存储或事件登记时宿主拒绝启动。

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunEventsSubscriber(this IServiceCollection services, string service, Action<KunEventsSubscriberBuilder> subscribe, Action<KunEventsSubscriberOptions>? configure = null)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

`service` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

`subscribe` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunEventsSubscriberBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-rabbitmq/kuneventssubscriberbuilder.md)>

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunEventsSubscriberOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-rabbitmq/kuneventssubscriberoptions.md)>?

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

## Methods

### Subscribe\<TEvent, THandler>(string, EventSubscriptionMode, bool) \{#Kun_EventBus_RabbitMQ_KunEventsSubscriberBuilder_Subscribe__2_System_String_Kun_EventBus_EventSubscriptionMode_System_Boolean\_}

把 `THandler` 登记为订阅 `subscription` 里 `TEvent` 的处理器，并以 scoped 登记该 handler 类型。
事件类型须已在 `AddKunEventBus` 以源生成 JsonTypeInfo 登记；宿主启动时核对，不满足即拒绝启动。

```csharp
public KunEventsSubscriberBuilder Subscribe<TEvent, THandler>(string subscription, EventSubscriptionMode mode = EventSubscriptionMode.Competing, bool acceptPlatformEvents = false) where TEvent : class where THandler : class, IIntegrationEventHandler<TEvent>
```

#### Parameters

`subscription` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

订阅名，小写短横线标识，决定竞争队列 `q.<service>.<subscription>`、死信队列与幂等记录的消费者名。

`mode` EventSubscriptionMode

竞争消费或广播。

`acceptPlatformEvents` [bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

是否派发 tenant_id 为 null 的平台级事件；默认拒绝，派发时不开租户作用域。

#### Returns

[KunEventsSubscriberBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-rabbitmq/kuneventssubscriberbuilder.md)

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

`THandler`

# Enum EventSubscriptionMode

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EventBus.Abstractions` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EventBus.Abstractions.dll

订阅模式（PRD 7.10、ADR-008 D8.9）。

```csharp
public enum EventSubscriptionMode
```

## Fields

`Broadcast = 1`

广播：每个实例一个 `q.<service>.<instance>`，每个在线实例各处理一次；实例下线后队列删除。

`Competing = 0`

竞争消费：同一服务的全部实例共享 `q.<service>.<subscription>`，每条消息只由其中一个实例处理。

### GetAll() \{#Kun_EventBus_EventTypeRegistry_GetAll}

Enumerates every `(eventId, clrType)` pair in the registry, ordered by
`eventId` (ordinal, case-sensitive) for stable output. Intended primarily for
tooling — JSON-Schema export, registry dumps, diagnostic inspection. Consumers on the
hot path should continue to use [IEventTypeRegistry.Resolve](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistry_Resolve_System_String_) or
[IEventTypeRegistry.GetEventType](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistry_GetEventType_System_Type_).

## Methods

### Register\<TEvent>(string) \{#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String\_}

Registers a mapping between `eventType` token and `TEvent`.

```csharp
IEventTypeRegistrar Register<TEvent>(string eventType) where TEvent : class
```

#### Parameters

`eventType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

#### Returns

[IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md)

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

#### Remarks

Serialization falls back to reflection-based `System.Text.Json` defaults. AOT-targeting
consumers should prefer the
[IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0__) overload instead to thread a
source-generated [`JsonTypeInfo`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.metadata.jsontypeinfo-1) through the outbox.

### Register\<TEvent>(string, JsonTypeInfo\<TEvent>) \{#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0\_\_}

Registers a mapping between `eventType` token and
`TEvent`, plus the source-generated
[`JsonTypeInfo`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.metadata.jsontypeinfo-1) used to serialize outbox payloads without runtime reflection.

```csharp
IEventTypeRegistrar Register<TEvent>(string eventType, JsonTypeInfo<TEvent> typeInfo) where TEvent : class
```

#### Parameters

`eventType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Stable event-id token (e.g. `order.placed.v1`).

`typeInfo` [JsonTypeInfo](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.metadata.jsontypeinfo-1)\<TEvent>

JsonTypeInfo for `TEvent`, typically obtained from a
`[JsonSerializable(typeof(TEvent))]`-decorated [`JsonSerializerContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.jsonserializercontext).

#### Returns

[IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md)

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

### Register\<TEvent>() \{#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1}

Registers `TEvent` using the token declared on its
[IntegrationEventIdAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/integrationeventidattribute.md). Throws
[`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception) when the attribute is absent.

```csharp
[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Reads [IntegrationEventId] via reflection on typeof(TEvent). Under trimming, IntegrationEventIdAttribute instances must be preserved. Use Register<TEvent>(string) to avoid reflection entirely.")]
IEventTypeRegistrar Register<TEvent>() where TEvent : class
```

#### Returns

[IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md)

#### Type Parameters

`TEvent`

#### Remarks

Reads the attribute reflectively once at DI-registration time; the resulting
registry is the same O(1) [IEventTypeRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md) used at steady state.
AOT-strict callers can stick with [IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_) or
[IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_System_Text_Json_Serialization_Metadata_JsonTypeInfo___0__) to avoid the reflection entirely.

### Classes

[EventActor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/eventactor.md)

触发事件的主体；取值与 S2S principal_kind、审计 actor_type 一致。

[EventEnvelopeScope](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/eventenvelopescope.md)

当前异步流的事件来源。集成事件只能在命令 handler 的同一作用域内发出（ADR-008 D8.2）：
SDK 命令管道在执行 handler 与保存期间打开它，Outbox 写入端缺少来源时拒绝发布。
定时作业、生命周期控制器等不经命令管道的平台发布方显式以服务主体打开。

[EventOrigin](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/eventorigin.md)

集成事件的来源：谁、以哪个组件的名义、因哪一次调用发布。信封的 producer、actor 与因果链取自这里。

[EventSubscriptionDescriptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/eventsubscriptiondescriptor.md)

订阅目录中的一项，与 [IntegrationEventDescriptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/integrationeventdescriptor.md) 按事件 ID 对齐，是事件目录「订阅者」的来源。

[EventTypeRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/eventtyperegistry.md)

Immutable, O(1) event-type registry backed by [`FrozenDictionary`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.frozen.frozendictionary-2).

[EventsDefinition](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/eventsdefinition.md)

事件 seam 的稳定服务键；业务组件只依赖 Definition。

[EventsErrors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/eventserrors.md)

事件组件的稳定错误码定义。

[IntegrationEventDescriptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/integrationeventdescriptor.md)

事件目录中的一项：稳定 ID、subject、payload 版本与由 JsonTypeInfo 导出的 payload Schema。

[IntegrationEventIdAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/integrationeventidattribute.md)

Declares the stable event-type identifier (token) for an integration event CLR type.
Use with [IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1) so the token lives next
to the type definition rather than being repeated in DI wiring.

[IntegrationEventSchemas](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/integrationeventschemas.md)

由登记时的源生成 JsonTypeInfo 导出 payload 的 JSON Schema（2020-12），与 Outbox 实际写出的 JSON 同一份契约；
不用反射序列化补位：没有 JsonTypeInfo 的事件不能发布，也不进目录。

[IntegrationEventTypes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/integrationeventtypes.md)

稳定事件 ID（`[IntegrationEventId]` 的值）与信封 subject 的换算规则。

[KunEventDelivery](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/kuneventdelivery.md)

订阅器正在派发的一次投递：已解析、已与 AMQP 属性核对过的 v1 信封，以及订阅与重试计数。
订阅器为每条消息新建一个依赖注入作用域，handler 可在构造函数里注入本类型读取 producer、actor 与因果链；
幂等键、发生时间与租户一律以这里的信封为准，不读载荷里的同名字段（S1-DEC-020）。
只能在订阅器派发的作用域内解析，其他位置解析即抛 EVENTS_MISCONFIGURED。

[KunEventEnvelope](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/kuneventenvelope.md)

跨进程集成事件信封 v1，与 contracts/v0/event-envelope.schema.json 同形：Outbox 行与 RabbitMQ 消息体都是这份 JSON。
payload 由事件目录里该 [KunEventEnvelope.Type](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/kuneventenvelope.md#Kun_EventBus_KunEventEnvelope_Type) 的 Schema 约束，信封不约束其内容；进程内运行时事件不用本信封。

[KunEventTopology](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/kuneventtopology.md)

RabbitMQ 拓扑命名（PRD 7.10）：topic exchange `qian.events`，路由键为信封 subject；
竞争消费用每服务一个 quorum 队列 `q.<service>.<subscription>`，广播用每实例一个自动删除队列 `q.<service>.<instance>`。
消费端另有每订阅一个死信队列 `q.<service>.<subscription>-dlq` 与按次数、间隔命名的重试队列 `<主队列>-retry-<n>-<毫秒>`；
这两种后缀保留给消费端，订阅名与实例名不能以它们结尾。

[KunEventsException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/kuneventsexception.md)

事件装配、发布或消费被拒绝；携带可渲染为 ErrorDetail 的错误。

[KunEventsExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/kuneventsextensions.md)

Registers the event envelope writer and event catalog.

[MessageContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/messagecontext.md)

Metadata accompanying an integration event during handler dispatch.

### Interfaces

[IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md)

Fluent builder for populating the [IEventTypeRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md).

[IEventTypeRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistry.md)

Maps stable event-type tokens to their CLR types at runtime.

[IEventsService](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventsservice.md)

事件 Provider 的只读视图。发布不经过这里：命令 handler 通过同一数据会话的 Outbox 写入端发布，
信封由 Provider 在入队时按 [EventEnvelopeScope](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/eventenvelopescope.md) 生成。

[IIntegrationEventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventbus.md)

High-level façade for publishing integration events via the Outbox pattern.

[IIntegrationEventHandler\<TEvent>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventhandler-1.md)

Handles a strongly-typed integration event received from the broker.

[IIntegrationEventPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/iintegrationeventpublisher.md)

Broker-specific transport that publishes a single [OutboxMessage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/outboxmessage.md) to the message bus.
Implementations live in broker adapters (e.g. `Kun.EventBus.RabbitMQ`).

[IOutboxPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ioutboxpublisher.md)

### Enums

事件主体类型；agent 为 S4 Agent 触发器预留，S1 已可写入信封。

订阅模式（PRD 7.10、ADR-008 D8.9）。
