本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EventBus.Abstractions` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EventBus.Abstractions.dll

Declares the stable event-type identifier (token) for an integration event CLR type.
Use with [IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1) so the token lives next
to the type definition rather than being repeated in DI wiring.

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class|AttributeTargets.Struct, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = false)]
public sealed class IntegrationEventIdAttribute : Attribute
```

## Remarks

The token shape follows the framework convention
`{bounded-context}.{event-name}.v{version}`, e.g. `order.placed.v1`.
Applying this attribute does _not_ auto-register the type — registration
is still explicit via [IEventTypeRegistrar](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md). AOT-strict consumers that
must avoid reflection at startup can keep using
[IEventTypeRegistrar.Register](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/ieventtyperegistrar.md#Kun_EventBus_IEventTypeRegistrar_Register__1_System_String_).

# Class KunEventDelivery

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EventBus.Abstractions` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EventBus.Abstractions.dll

订阅器正在派发的一次投递：已解析、已与 AMQP 属性核对过的 v1 信封，以及订阅与重试计数。
订阅器为每条消息新建一个依赖注入作用域，handler 可在构造函数里注入本类型读取 producer、actor 与因果链；
幂等键、发生时间与租户一律以这里的信封为准，不读载荷里的同名字段（S1-DEC-020）。
只能在订阅器派发的作用域内解析，其他位置解析即抛 EVENTS_MISCONFIGURED。

```csharp
public sealed class KunEventDelivery
```

# Class KunEventEnvelope

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EventBus.Abstractions` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EventBus.Abstractions.dll

跨进程集成事件信封 v1，与 contracts/v0/event-envelope.schema.json 同形：Outbox 行与 RabbitMQ 消息体都是这份 JSON。
payload 由事件目录里该 [KunEventEnvelope.Type](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/kuneventenvelope.md#Kun_EventBus_KunEventEnvelope_Type) 的 Schema 约束，信封不约束其内容；进程内运行时事件不用本信封。

```csharp
[JsonUnmappedMemberHandling(JsonUnmappedMemberHandling.Disallow)]
public sealed class KunEventEnvelope
```

# Class KunEventTopology

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.EventBus.Abstractions` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.EventBus.Abstractions)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.EventBus](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.EventBus.Abstractions.dll

RabbitMQ 拓扑命名（PRD 7.10）：topic exchange `qian.events`，路由键为信封 subject；
竞争消费用每服务一个 quorum 队列 `q.<service>.<subscription>`，广播用每实例一个自动删除队列 `q.<service>.<instance>`。
消费端另有每订阅一个死信队列 `q.<service>.<subscription>-dlq` 与按次数、间隔命名的重试队列 `<主队列>-retry-<n>-<毫秒>`；
这两种后缀保留给消费端，订阅名与实例名不能以它们结尾。

```csharp
public static class KunEventTopology
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←
[KunEventTopology](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus/kuneventtopology.md)

### AddKunGateway(IServiceCollection, GatewayConfiguration?, string?, IConfiguration?) \{#Kun_Gateway_DependencyInjection_KunGatewayServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunGateway_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_Kun_Gateway_GatewayConfiguration_System_String_Microsoft_Extensions_Configuration_IConfiguration\_}

Registers core Kun Gateway services:

- [GatewayConfiguration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/gatewayconfiguration.md) as supplied by the host.
- [S2sTokenIssuer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md) as a singleton.
- Default [TenantRateLimitPartitionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting-resolvers/tenantratelimitpartitionresolver.md) (override by registering your own before calling this).
- YARP reverse proxy with the [Kun.Gateway.Transforms.S2sAuthTransform](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/index.md#Kun_Gateway_Transforms_S2sAuthTransform) applied to all routes.

When `reverseProxyConfig` is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null), a startup validation
service checks that an `IProxyConfigProvider` has been registered and throws a
descriptive [`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception) on host start if one is missing.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunGateway(this IServiceCollection services, GatewayConfiguration? configuration = null, string? sessionAuthenticationScheme = null, IConfiguration? reverseProxyConfig = null)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection.

`configuration` GatewayConfiguration?

Gateway identity, routes, key files and host settings. When omitted, the standalone host reads the Gateway section from its final configuration.

`sessionAuthenticationScheme` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

Cookie scheme for a declaratively routed gateway.

`reverseProxyConfig` [IConfiguration](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.configuration.iconfiguration)?

Optional YARP configuration section (e.g. `Configuration.GetSection("ReverseProxy")`)
to bind Routes/Clusters. When null, callers must register their own
`IProxyConfigProvider`.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The same [`IServiceCollection`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection) for chaining.

## Methods

### MapKunJwks(IEndpointRouteBuilder, Func\<HttpContext, bool>?) \{#Kun_Gateway_Endpoints_JwksEndpoint_MapKunJwks_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Routing_IEndpointRouteBuilder_System_Func_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Http_HttpContext_System_Boolean\_\_}

Maps `/.well-known/jwks.json` — returns the gateway's RSA public key as a JSON Web Key Set.
The `kid` is derived from the SHA-256 hash of the RSA modulus for stable key identification.
Response is cached by [JwksResponseBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-jwks/jwksresponsebuilder.md) and only rebuilt when the
underlying public-key file is modified.

```csharp
public static IEndpointConventionBuilder MapKunJwks(this IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints, Func<HttpContext, bool>? additionalGate = null)
```

#### Parameters

`endpoints` [IEndpointRouteBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.routing.iendpointroutebuilder)

The endpoint route builder.

`additionalGate` [Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)\<[HttpContext](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.httpcontext), [bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)>?

Optional predicate evaluated on each request. Return [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) to respond 404.
Typical use is a production-only allow-list (e.g. loopback only when this route is
supposed to be reachable only via mesh-internal hops). When [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null),
no additional gating is applied.

#### Returns

[IEndpointConventionBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.builder.iendpointconventionbuilder)

The [`IEndpointConventionBuilder`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.builder.iendpointconventionbuilder) for the mapped route.

# Interface IS2sPrincipalResolver

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Gateway` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Gateway`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Gateway)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Gateway.Identity](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-identity/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Gateway.dll

Optional enrichment hook invoked by [S2sTokenIssuer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md) after the external IdP
principal authenticates and before the internal S2S token is minted. Lets consumers add,
remove, or rewrite claims — typically for tenant lookup, role projection, or attaching
service-scoped metadata that the IdP does not own.

```csharp
public interface IS2sPrincipalResolver
```

## Remarks

The resolver runs on the Gateway's request path, so its implementation should be cheap:
prefer cache-backed lookups over per-request database calls. Failures should surface as
exceptions rather than empty principals. The issuer rejects unauthenticated/empty principals
and missing canonical identity fields; session and authorization revisions must come from an authoritative source.

## Methods

### ResolveAsync(ClaimsPrincipal, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Gateway_Identity_IS2sPrincipalResolver_ResolveAsync_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Returns the principal that [S2sTokenIssuer.IssueFor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueFor_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_) should
translate into the internal S2S token. Implementations may return
`externalPrincipal` unchanged (no-op) or a new
[`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal) with enriched claims.

```csharp
Task<ClaimsPrincipal> ResolveAsync(ClaimsPrincipal externalPrincipal, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
```

#### Parameters

`externalPrincipal` [ClaimsPrincipal](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)

The authenticated principal from the IdP JWT.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token for the enrichment call.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[ClaimsPrincipal](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)>

The principal to mint the token for.

### Classes

[JwksResponseBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-jwks/jwksresponsebuilder.md)

Caches the JWKS response keyed on (public-key path + file last-write time).
Re-reads the PEM, rebuilds the [`JsonWebKey`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.identitymodel.tokens.jsonwebkey), and materialises a new
[JwksResponse](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-endpoints/jwksresponse.md) only when the underlying file has been modified —
amortises the per-request cost of every JWKS fetch across downstream services
to a single [`GetLastWriteTimeUtc`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.file.getlastwritetimeutc) stat after the first warm-up.

always-on public `/.well-known/jwks.json` route.

## Remarks

Registered as a DI singleton by `AddKunGateway`. The cache is shared between
the public `MapKunJwks` route and the gated `MapKunInternalJwks` route
so both serve the same byte-identical document and both pay the key-rebuild
cost at most once per key-rotation event.

Thread-safe via a single lock around the cached tuple. The lock scope is tiny
(read the mtime, compare, maybe rebuild) and the rebuild path only fires when
an operator rotates the key — expected to be infrequent relative to request
volume, so lock contention is a non-issue in practice.

# Class KunInternalJwksEndpoint

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Gateway` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Gateway`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Gateway)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

Assembly: Kun.Gateway.dll

Extension methods for mapping the **internal-network** JWKS endpoint, separate from the
always-on public `/.well-known/jwks.json` route.

```csharp
public static class KunInternalJwksEndpoint
```

[object.Equals(object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object\)),
[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

The public endpoint (see `JwksEndpoint.MapKunJwks`) is required for any consumer — inside
or outside the cluster — to validate S2S tokens, and stays unconditionally enabled. The internal
endpoint at `/internal/.well-known/jwks.json` is an opt-in convenience for downstream
services that talk to the gateway through a NetworkPolicy-isolated interface and want a stable
well-known path that does NOT share lifecycle with the public route (e.g. for separate
rate-limiting or egress controls).

Gating policy: the internal route is reachable only when either (a) the host runs in the
`Development` environment, or (b) [GatewayConfiguration.ExposeInternalJwks](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/gatewayconfiguration.md#Kun_Gateway_GatewayConfiguration_ExposeInternalJwks) is
explicitly set to [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool). Any other environment returns 404, so forgetting to
set the flag in production fails closed.

Tunable parameters for `AddKunSlidingWindowRateLimiter`. Sliding-window divides
each window into segments and shifts one segment at a time, yielding smoother behavior
than a fixed window at the cost of proportionally higher CPU/memory.

[KunTokenBucketOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/kuntokenbucketoptions.md)

Tunable parameters for `AddKunTokenBucketRateLimiter`. Token-bucket smooths bursty
traffic by accumulating tokens at a steady rate up to a cap; each request consumes one
token and is rejected (or queued) when the bucket is empty.

### AddKunSlidingWindowRateLimiter(IServiceCollection, Action\<KunSlidingWindowOptions>?, Action\<RateLimiterOptions>?) \{#Kun_Gateway_RateLimiting_KunRateLimiterExtensions_AddKunSlidingWindowRateLimiter_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_Gateway_RateLimiting_KunSlidingWindowOptions__System_Action_Microsoft_AspNetCore_RateLimiting_RateLimiterOptions\_\_}

Registers a sliding-window rate limiter policy partitioned by the resolved
[IRateLimitPartitionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/iratelimitpartitionresolver.md) key. Call
`app.MapXxx().RequireRateLimiting(KunRateLimiterExtensions.SlidingWindowPolicyName)`
on endpoints that should enforce it. Defaults: 100 permits per 1-minute window with
6 segments. Defence-in-depth sibling to the fixed-window path; both may coexist.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunSlidingWindowRateLimiter(this IServiceCollection services, Action<KunSlidingWindowOptions>? configureKun = null, Action<RateLimiterOptions>? configureHost = null)
```

`configureHost` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[RateLimiterOptions](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.ratelimiting.ratelimiteroptions)>?

### AddKunTokenBucketRateLimiter(IServiceCollection, Action\<KunTokenBucketOptions>?, Action\<RateLimiterOptions>?) \{#Kun_Gateway_RateLimiting_KunRateLimiterExtensions_AddKunTokenBucketRateLimiter_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_Gateway_RateLimiting_KunTokenBucketOptions__System_Action_Microsoft_AspNetCore_RateLimiting_RateLimiterOptions\_\_}

Registers a token-bucket rate limiter policy partitioned by the resolved
[IRateLimitPartitionResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-ratelimiting/iratelimitpartitionresolver.md) key. Defaults: 100-token burst budget,
refilled at 20 tokens / 10 seconds (≈120 tokens/minute steady state).
Absorbs bursty traffic better than fixed-window; use for APIs where clients
naturally come in bursts (webhook fanout, batch imports).


### ExposeInternalJwks \{#Kun_Gateway_GatewayConfiguration_ExposeInternalJwks}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), the gateway exposes the internal JWKS endpoint
`/internal/.well-known/jwks.json` in non-Development environments. Defaults to
[false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) so the internal endpoint returns 404 in production unless the
operator deliberately opts in. The public endpoint `/.well-known/jwks.json`
remains always-on; this option only gates the internal-network variant.

```csharp
[JsonIgnore]
public bool ExposeInternalJwks { get; init; }
```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

#### Remarks

Keep [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) in internet-facing Kubernetes deployments and rely on
NetworkPolicy / service-mesh egress rules to isolate the internal route. Flip to
[true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) only when JWKS fetching from internal pods must bypass the
public path (e.g. rate-limiting sidecars that reshape external traffic).

Trace context travels in headers, not additional JWT payload fields.

# Class S2sTokenIssuer

:::info 生成页

Namespace: [Kun.Gateway](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Gateway.dll

Issues the closed, short-lived S2S claim contract with RS256 and the shared rotating JWKS ring.
An authenticated principal/resolver must provide explicit user/service identity, tenant context and user session/revision fields.
Trace context travels in headers, not additional JWT payload fields.

```csharp
public sealed class S2sTokenIssuer : IDisposable
```

### S2sTokenIssuer(IOptions\<GatewayConfiguration>, IHostEnvironment, IS2sPrincipalResolver, IHttpContextAccessor?) \{#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer__ctor_Microsoft_Extensions_Options_IOptions_Kun_Gateway_GatewayConfiguration__Microsoft_Extensions_Hosting_IHostEnvironment_Kun_Gateway_Identity_IS2sPrincipalResolver_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Http_IHttpContextAccessor\_}

Initializes the issuer with an explicit principal resolver. Prefer this ctor —
the 3-arg overload is kept for binary compatibility but is deprecated.


Principal resolver (use [NoOpS2sPrincipalResolver.Instance](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-identity/noops2sprincipalresolver.md#Kun_Gateway_Identity_NoOpS2sPrincipalResolver_Instance) for the identity transform).

`httpContextAccessor` [IHttpContextAccessor](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.ihttpcontextaccessor)?

Retained for constructor compatibility. Trace context is now propagated through HTTP headers.

### IssueFor(ClaimsPrincipal) \{#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueFor_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal\_}

Issues an internal S2S JWT for the given external `externalPrincipal`.
The configured [IS2sPrincipalResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-identity/is2sprincipalresolver.md) runs first to produce the effective
principal, then the canonical identity/scope/session fields are validated and projected.
Missing required identity fields fail closed; arbitrary claims are not forwarded.

```csharp
public string IssueFor(ClaimsPrincipal externalPrincipal)
```

#### Parameters

`externalPrincipal` [ClaimsPrincipal](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)

The authenticated principal from the external IdP JWT.

#### Returns

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

A signed RS256 JWT string.

#### Remarks

Synchronous convenience wrapper over [S2sTokenIssuer.IssueForAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueForAsync_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).
Prefer the async form on the Gateway request path — it avoids the
`GetAwaiter().GetResult()` hop and lets resolvers that perform real I/O work
without starving the thread pool.

### IssueForAsync(ClaimsPrincipal, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueForAsync_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Async variant of [S2sTokenIssuer.IssueFor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway/s2stokenissuer.md#Kun_Gateway_S2sTokenIssuer_IssueFor_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_). Awaits the configured
[IS2sPrincipalResolver](/sdk/api/kun/kun-gateway-identity/is2sprincipalresolver.md) without blocking, then mints the token.

```csharp
public Task<string> IssueForAsync(ClaimsPrincipal externalPrincipal, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`externalPrincipal` [ClaimsPrincipal](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)

The authenticated principal from the external IdP JWT.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token passed to the resolver.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>

A signed RS256 JWT string.

## Methods

### AddKunGrpc(IServiceCollection, Action\<GrpcServiceOptions>?) \{#Kun_Grpc_DependencyInjection_KunGrpcServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunGrpc_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Grpc_AspNetCore_Server_GrpcServiceOptions\_\_}

Registers Kun gRPC services and interceptors:

- [Kun.Grpc.Interceptors.KunTracingInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-grpc-interceptors/index.md#Kun_Grpc_Interceptors_KunTracingInterceptor) — starts an `Activity` per RPC call.
- [Kun.Grpc.Interceptors.KunServerAuthInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-grpc-interceptors/index.md#Kun_Grpc_Interceptors_KunServerAuthInterceptor) — requires an authenticated subject.
- [TenantGrpcServerInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-grpc-interceptors/tenantgrpcserverinterceptor.md) — establishes an authenticated tenant or platform scope.
- [Kun.Grpc.Interceptors.RequiredPermissionInterceptorGuard](/sdk/api/kun/kun-grpc-interceptors/index.md#Kun_Grpc_Interceptors_RequiredPermissionInterceptorGuard) — verifies the permission interceptor registration.
- [Kun.Grpc.Interceptors.KunResultToRpcInterceptor](/sdk/api/kun/kun-grpc-interceptors/index.md#Kun_Grpc_Interceptors_KunResultToRpcInterceptor) — maps `ErrorException` to `RpcException`.

Optionally call `AddKunSecurity()` separately to wire up `JwtCurrentUser`.

```csharp
public static IGrpcServerBuilder AddKunGrpc(this IServiceCollection services, Action<GrpcServiceOptions>? configure = null)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection.

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<GrpcServiceOptions>?

Optional callback to further configure `GrpcServiceOptions`.

#### Returns

IGrpcServerBuilder

The `IGrpcServerBuilder` for further gRPC configuration.

### AsyncClientStreamingCall\<TRequest, TResponse>(ClientInterceptorContext\<TRequest, TResponse>, AsyncClientStreamingCallContinuation\<TRequest, TResponse>) \{#Kun_Grpc_Interceptors_TenantGrpcClientInterceptor_AsyncClientStreamingCall__2_Grpc_Core_Interceptors_ClientInterceptorContext___0___1__Grpc_Core_Interceptors_Interceptor_AsyncClientStreamingCallContinuation___0___1\_\_}

Intercepts an asynchronous invocation of a client streaming call.

```csharp
public override AsyncClientStreamingCall<TRequest, TResponse> AsyncClientStreamingCall<TRequest, TResponse>(ClientInterceptorContext<TRequest, TResponse> context, Interceptor.AsyncClientStreamingCallContinuation<TRequest, TResponse> continuation) where TRequest : class where TResponse : class
```

#### Parameters

`context` ClientInterceptorContext\<TRequest, TResponse>

The `ClientInterceptorContext`
associated with the current invocation.

`continuation` Interceptor.AsyncClientStreamingCallContinuation\<TRequest, TResponse>

The callback that continues the invocation process.
This can be invoked zero or more times by the interceptor.
The interceptor can invoke the continuation passing the given
context argument, or substitute as it sees fit.

#### Returns

AsyncClientStreamingCall\<TRequest, TResponse>

An instance of `AsyncClientStreamingCall`
representing an asynchronous client-streaming invocation.
The interceptor can simply return the return value of the
continuation delegate passed to it intact, or construct its
own substitute as it sees fit.

#### Type Parameters

`TRequest`

`TResponse`

### ClientStreamingServerHandler\<TRequest, TResponse>(IAsyncStreamReader\<TRequest>, ServerCallContext, ClientStreamingServerMethod\<TRequest, TResponse>) \{#Kun_Grpc_Interceptors_TenantGrpcServerInterceptor_ClientStreamingServerHandler__2_Grpc_Core_IAsyncStreamReader___0__Grpc_Core_ServerCallContext_Grpc_Core_ClientStreamingServerMethod___0___1\_\_}

Server-side handler for intercepting client streaming call.

```csharp
public override Task<TResponse> ClientStreamingServerHandler<TRequest, TResponse>(IAsyncStreamReader<TRequest> requestStream, ServerCallContext context, ClientStreamingServerMethod<TRequest, TResponse> continuation) where TRequest : class where TResponse : class
```

#### Parameters

`requestStream` IAsyncStreamReader\<TRequest>

The request stream of the incoming invocation.

`context` ServerCallContext

An instance of `ServerCallContext` representing
the context of the invocation.

`continuation` ClientStreamingServerMethod\<TRequest, TResponse>

A delegate that asynchronously proceeds with the invocation, calling
the next interceptor in the chain, or the service request handler,
in case of the last interceptor and return the response value of
the RPC. The interceptor can choose to call it zero or more times
at its discretion.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<TResponse>

A future representing the response value of the RPC. The interceptor
can simply return the return value from the continuation intact,
or an arbitrary response value as it sees fit. The interceptor has
the ability to wrap or substitute the request stream when calling
the continuation.

#### Type Parameters

`TRequest`

Request message type for this method.

`TResponse`

Response message type for this method.

# Class ChallengeHelper

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity.AspNetCore` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity.AspNetCore`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Identity.AspNetCore)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Identity.AspNetCore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Identity.AspNetCore.dll

Builds the `/authorize` redirect URL for an OIDC provider
registered via `AddKunIdentity(id => id.AddOidcClient(...))`.
Generates the one-shot PKCE `code_verifier` /
`code_challenge` pair, a `state`, and a `nonce`,
stashes the verifier + state + nonce + returnUrl in a short-lived
cookie so the callback handler can replay them, and returns the
URL the caller should redirect the user to.

```csharp
public sealed class ChallengeHelper
```

### Serialize() \{#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengePayload_Serialize}

```csharp
public string Serialize()
```

#### Returns

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

#### Remarks

Pipe-separated format keeps the encoding reflection-free and
auditable at a glance. Each field is assumed to be url-safe
(base64url for the random components, a local URL for
[ChallengePayload.ReturnUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengepayload.md#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengePayload_ReturnUrl)); consumers must validate
[ChallengePayload.ReturnUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengepayload.md#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengePayload_ReturnUrl) against their own open-redirect policy.

### Classes

[ChallengeHelper](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengehelper.md)

Builds the `/authorize` redirect URL for an OIDC provider
registered via `AddKunIdentity(id => id.AddOidcClient(...))`.
Generates the one-shot PKCE `code_verifier` /
`code_challenge` pair, a `state`, and a `nonce`,
stashes the verifier + state + nonce + returnUrl in a short-lived
cookie so the callback handler can replay them, and returns the
URL the caller should redirect the user to.

[ChallengePayload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengepayload.md)

Payload written to the one-shot challenge cookie by
[ChallengeHelper.BuildLoginUrlAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengehelper.md#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengeHelper_BuildLoginUrlAsync_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Http_HttpContext_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken_). Consumer
callback handlers read it via [ChallengeHelper.ConsumeAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/challengehelper.md#Kun_Identity_AspNetCore_ChallengeHelper_ConsumeAsync_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Http_HttpContext_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).

[KunCookieAuthApplicationBuilderExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/kuncookieauthapplicationbuilderextensions.md)

`IApplicationBuilder` extensions for the Kun cookie middleware.

[KunCookieAuthMiddleware](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/kuncookieauthmiddleware.md)

Middleware that hydrates `HttpContext.User` from a
[ISessionStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/isessionstore.md) entry keyed by the session cookie.
Requests without a valid session flow through anonymously; the
middleware never writes a 401 itself — downstream authorization
policies are responsible for that.

[KunCurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/kuncurrentuser.md)

Request-scoped [IAuthenticatedUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/iauthenticateduser.md) (and
[ICurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-security/icurrentuser.md)) resolver. Reads claims off
`HttpContext.User` — which `UseKunCookieAuth` populates
from `ISessionStore` earlier in the pipeline. Anonymous when
no [`IHttpContextAccessor`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.ihttpcontextaccessor) is available or the
authentication middleware has not run.

[KunIdentityAspNetCoreServiceCollectionExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/kunidentityaspnetcoreservicecollectionextensions.md)

Registers the browser identity helpers without replacing the host's authentication scheme.

[OidcLoginService](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/oidcloginservice.md)

Completes the protected browser transaction before creating a local session.

[OidcLogoutEndpoint](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/oidclogoutendpoint.md)

Back-channel logout mapping; authentication comes from the signed provider token, not a browser cookie.

[OidcLogoutService](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/oidclogoutservice.md)

Validates provider logout instructions before atomically revoking local sessions.

[SignInHelper](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-aspnetcore/signinhelper.md)

Turns a successful OIDC code-exchange into a signed-in browser
session: writes the [SessionData](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/sessiondata.md) into the configured
[ISessionStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/isessionstore.md) and emits the opaque session cookie on
the current response.

#### Remarks

The id-token is validated — not merely parsed — before any
claim is trusted. An id-token that fails validation throws
[`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception); callers decide
whether to surface a 400 or a 401.

Assembly: Kun.Identity.AspNetCore.dll

当前浏览器会话的访问令牌。到期前用 refresh token 换新：同一进程内同一会话只发一次刷新请求，跨副本用 Kun 会话注册表的一次性标记互斥
（发行方开启了 refresh 轮换与复用检测，并发复用会吊销整族）；刷新结果只续写仍然存活的会话，已登出的会话不会因刷新复活；刷新失败即结束会话。

### Classes

[KunCookieAuthOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md)

Options for the cookie session layer wired by
`AddKunIdentity(id => id.AddCookieSession(...))`. The defaults
encode the zero-trust baseline `Kun.Gateway` already applies to
outbound cookies.

[KunCookieSessionBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md)

Configuration surface exposed by
`KunIdentityBuilder.AddCookieSession(opts => ...)`. Inherits
every [KunCookieAuthOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md) field (so callers write
`opts.CookieName = "kun.sid"; opts.SessionTtl = ...;` as
expected) and adds the backend-selection methods
[KunCookieSessionBuilder.UseInMemoryStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder_UseInMemoryStore) and [KunCookieSessionBuilder.UseRedisStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder_UseRedisStore).
Exactly one backend call should be made — multiple calls take
last-wins semantics because each call replaces the
[ISessionStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/isessionstore.md) registration on the underlying service
collection.

[KunIdentityBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunidentitybuilder.md)

Fluent builder surfaced by `AddKunIdentity`.

[KunJwtBearerOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunjwtbeareroptions.md)

Validation parameters for external Bearer JWTs issued by an OIDC
provider (Authentik, Keycloak, Auth0, Azure AD, …). Feeds
`KunJwtValidator`.

[KunOidcClientOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunoidcclientoptions.md)

Per-provider configuration for `KunOidcClient`.

[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

This options type lives in `Kun.Identity` (not
`Kun.Identity.AspNetCore`) so non-ASP.NET-Core hosts — worker
services that replay a signed-in request, integration tests that
synthesize a session — can configure it without pulling the ASP.NET
Core dependency. [KunCookieAuthOptions.SameSite](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieAuthOptions_SameSite) and [KunCookieAuthOptions.Secure](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieAuthOptions_Secure)
use Kun-owned enums ([KunSameSiteMode](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunsamesitemode.md),
[KunCookieSecurePolicy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesecurepolicy.md)); the middleware in
`Kun.Identity.AspNetCore` maps them to the equivalent ASP.NET
Core values at registration time.

## Methods

### AddCookieSession(Action\<KunCookieSessionBuilder>) \{#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunIdentityBuilder_AddCookieSession_System_Action_Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder\_\_}

Registers the cookie-session pipeline described in
`ADR-010`: a `KunCookieAuthOptions` options entry, a
default [`TimeProvider`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timeprovider), and the
`ISessionStore` backend the caller selects via
`opts.UseInMemoryStore()` or `opts.UseRedisStore()`.

```csharp
public KunIdentityBuilder AddCookieSession(Action<KunCookieSessionBuilder> configure)
```

#### Parameters

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunCookieSessionBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesessionbuilder.md)>

#### Returns

[KunIdentityBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunidentitybuilder.md)

#### Remarks

The `UseKunCookieAuth()` middleware,
`SignInHelper`, `ChallengeHelper`, and
`KunCurrentUser` DI entries live in the companion package
`Kun.Identity.AspNetCore`; callers wiring a browser-flow
service must reference that package in addition to calling
[KunIdentityBuilder.AddCookieSession](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kunidentitybuilder.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunIdentityBuilder_AddCookieSession_System_Action_Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSessionBuilder__).

If neither `UseInMemoryStore` nor `UseRedisStore` is
called within the lambda, resolving `ISessionStore` from
DI will throw — the registration is intentionally not defaulted
because an unintended in-memory store in production would be a
subtle data-loss / cross-replica-drift bug.

# Enum KunSameSiteMode

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Identity)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Identity.Configuration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Identity.dll

`SameSite` policy for [KunCookieAuthOptions.SameSite](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookieauthoptions.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieAuthOptions_SameSite).
Mirrors ASP.NET Core's `SameSiteMode` shape without taking a
dependency on that package from the core abstractions.

```csharp
public enum KunSameSiteMode
```

## Fields

`Lax = 1`

`SameSite=Lax`. Cookie is sent on top-level navigation but not
on cross-site subrequests. Recommended default for OIDC code flow.

`None = 0`

`SameSite=None`. Cookie is sent on cross-site requests; must
be paired with [KunCookieSecurePolicy.Always](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity-configuration/kuncookiesecurepolicy.md#Kun_Identity_Configuration_KunCookieSecurePolicy_Always).

`Strict = 2`

`SameSite=Strict`. Cookie is only sent on same-site requests —
blocks even top-level redirects from the IdP callback, so usually
only appropriate for post-login navigation cookies.

`Unspecified = -1`

No `SameSite` attribute emitted (browser default).

## Methods

### ValidateAsync(string, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Identity_Implementations_KunJwtValidator_ValidateAsync_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Validates `token`. Keys are resolved from the
configured JWKS URI with automatic rotation, or from statically
registered `IssuerSigningKeys` when set. Expiry, issuer,
audience, and lifetime are all checked; tokens failing any
check return [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

```csharp
public Task<ClaimsPrincipal?> ValidateAsync(string token, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

# Interface IAuthenticatedUser

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Identity)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Identity](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Identity.dll

Browser-flow extension of [ICurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-security/icurrentuser.md). Adds the
multi-tenant identifier, profile claims, and direct access to the
ambient [`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal) that the
`Kun.Identity.AspNetCore` cookie middleware populates.

```csharp
public interface IAuthenticatedUser : ICurrentUser
```

#### Implements

ICurrentUser

## Remarks

Services that resolve the user from an S2S JWT should keep
injecting [ICurrentUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-security/icurrentuser.md). Endpoints that serve the
browser (cookie + OIDC code flow) can inject
[IAuthenticatedUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/iauthenticateduser.md) to reach the cookie-only fields
without casting.

The DI registration provided by `Kun.Identity.AspNetCore`
binds both interfaces to the same request-scoped instance, so the
choice of injected interface is purely about the fields the caller
needs.

See `docs/architecture/when-to-use-currentuser.md` for the
full decision table across consumer scenarios and the anti-patterns
that should never show up in a PR (no `ICurrentUserEx`, no
per-service subinterface, no [`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)
injection as a first-class service).

# Interface IJwtValidator

:::info 生成页

Namespace: [Kun.Identity](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Identity.dll

Validates a Bearer JWT against the configured issuer / audience /
signing keys and returns the resulting [`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)
on success. Returns [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when validation fails —
callers decide whether to surface a 401 or fall through.

```csharp
public interface IJwtValidator
```

## Methods

### ValidateAsync(string, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Identity_IJwtValidator_ValidateAsync_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Validates `token`. Keys are resolved from the
configured JWKS URI with automatic rotation, or from statically
registered `IssuerSigningKeys` when set. Expiry, issuer,
audience, and lifetime are all checked; tokens failing any
check return [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

```csharp
Task<ClaimsPrincipal?> ValidateAsync(string token, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Authorization code and the original browser transaction's PKCE verifier and nonce.

Subset of an OpenID Connect discovery document surfaced by [IOidcClient.DiscoverAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/ioidcclient.md#Kun_Identity_IOidcClient_DiscoverAsync_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).

Result of an OIDC authorization-code exchange.

below is what that id resolves to.

### Interfaces

[IAuthenticatedUser](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/iauthenticateduser.md)

ambient [`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal) that the

Validates a Bearer JWT against the configured issuer / audience /
signing keys and returns the resulting [`ClaimsPrincipal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.security.claims.claimsprincipal)
on success. Returns [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when validation fails —
callers decide whether to surface a 401 or fall through.

[IOidcClient](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/ioidcclient.md)

OpenID Connect client for discovery, PKCE code exchange, token refresh,
client credentials and signed back-channel logout validation.

[ISessionRegistry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/isessionregistry.md)

Atomic session lifecycle operations. Renewing a revoked session must never recreate it.

[ISessionStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/isessionstore.md)

Backend for cookie-based session data. Implementations ship in
`Kun.Identity.Implementations.Session` (in-memory for tests /
single-process dev; Redis-backed via `Kun.Caching` for
production). Implementations must be safe for concurrent use from
multiple request threads.

# Interface ISessionStore

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Identity` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Identity`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Identity)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Identity](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Identity.dll

Backend for cookie-based session data. Implementations ship in
`Kun.Identity.Implementations.Session` (in-memory for tests /
single-process dev; Redis-backed via `Kun.Caching` for
production). Implementations must be safe for concurrent use from
multiple request threads.

```csharp
public interface ISessionStore
```

## Constructors

### SessionData(string, string?, string?, string?, IReadOnlyList\<string>, string, string?, DateTimeOffset) \{#Kun_Identity_SessionData__ctor_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_Collections_Generic_IReadOnlyList_System_String__System_String_System_String_System_DateTimeOffset\_}

Serialized payload held by [ISessionStore](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/isessionstore.md) implementations.
The session cookie carries only an opaque session id; the record
below is what that id resolves to.

```csharp
public SessionData(string UserId, string? TenantId, string? Email, string? Name, IReadOnlyList<string> Roles, string AccessToken, string? RefreshToken, DateTimeOffset ExpiresAt)
```

#### Parameters

`UserId` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Stable user identifier. Mirrors the `sub` claim from the OIDC
id-token / access-token. Required — sessions without a user are not
authenticated.

`TenantId` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

Active tenant identifier resolved from the `tenant_id` claim, or
[null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when the consumer is single-tenant.

`Email` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

Email claim, when present on the id-token.

`Name` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

Display name claim, when present on the id-token.

`Roles` [IReadOnlyList](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ireadonlylist-1)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>

Flattened role list from `roles` / `groups` claim. Empty
when no role claim was issued.

`AccessToken` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

OIDC access token. Persisted so downstream API calls made on the
user's behalf (e.g. userinfo refresh) can reuse it without
re-running the code-exchange flow.

`RefreshToken` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

OIDC refresh token when the IdP issued one. Stored server-side only
— never round-tripped through the cookie.

`ExpiresAt` [DateTimeOffset](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.datetimeoffset)

Absolute instant at which [SessionData.AccessToken](/sdk/api/kun/kun-identity/sessiondata.md#Kun_Identity_SessionData_AccessToken) stops being
valid. When this is sooner than the session TTL, background refresh
is responsible for rotating the access token; session expiry itself
is driven by the cookie / store TTL set at sign-in.

本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Mediator` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Mediator`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Mediator)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[LoggingBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/loggingbehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior that logs the request name on entry and the elapsed time on exit.
Logs at [`Debug`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.logging.loglevel.debug) for normal completion and
[`Warning`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.logging.loglevel.warning) when the handler throws.

[PerformanceBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/performancebehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior that logs a warning when the handler pipeline exceeds a duration
threshold. The threshold is currently hardcoded to 500 ms; a configurable version
backed by `IOptions<PerformanceBehaviorOptions>` is a planned follow-up.

[PerformanceBehaviorOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/performancebehavioroptions.md)

慢命令告警的可配置阈值。

[PermissionBehaviorExtensions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/permissionbehaviorextensions.md)

为静态声明权限的命令装配判定行为，缺失引擎时拒绝执行。

[PermissionBehaviorOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/permissionbehavioroptions.md)

权限行为取权限判定器与当前主体的方式；缺省都从请求作用域的服务里取，取不到即拒绝。

[TracingBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/tracingbehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior that starts an [`Activity`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.activity) for each dispatched request
using the `"Kun.Mediator"` [`ActivitySource`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.activitysource). Compatible with
OpenTelemetry — attach a listener via `AddSource("Kun.Mediator")` in the
OpenTelemetry builder.

## Methods

### AddPermissionBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>(KunMediatorBuilder, Func\<Error, TResponse>) \{#Kun_Mediator_Behaviors_PermissionBehaviorExtensions_AddPermissionBehavior__2_Kun_Mediator_KunMediatorBuilder_System_Func_Kun_Errors_Error___1\_\_}

拒绝响应由调用方的 Result 工厂提供，不以异常表达正常权限失败；未认证给 [PlatformErrors.Unauthenticated](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_Unauthenticated)，
其余拒绝（引擎或权限声明缺失、主体类型无效、判定不允许）一律给 [PlatformErrors.AuthzDenied](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_AuthzDenied)。
权限判定器与当前主体从请求作用域的服务里取。

```csharp
public static KunMediatorBuilder AddPermissionBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>(this KunMediatorBuilder builder, Func<Error, TResponse> denied) where TRequest : IRequest<TResponse>, IPermissionProtectedRequest
```

#### Parameters

`builder` [KunMediatorBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediatorbuilder.md)

`denied` [Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)\<Error, TResponse>

#### Returns

[KunMediatorBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediatorbuilder.md)

#### Type Parameters

`TRequest`

`TResponse`

### AddPermissionBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>(KunMediatorBuilder, Func\<Error, TResponse>, Action\<PermissionBehaviorOptions>) \{#Kun_Mediator_Behaviors_PermissionBehaviorExtensions_AddPermissionBehavior__2_Kun_Mediator_KunMediatorBuilder_System_Func_Kun_Errors_Error___1__System_Action_Kun_Mediator_Behaviors_PermissionBehaviorOptions\_\_}

同 [PermissionBehaviorExtensions.AddPermissionBehavior](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/permissionbehaviorextensions.md#Kun_Mediator_Behaviors_PermissionBehaviorExtensions_AddPermissionBehavior__2_Kun_Mediator_KunMediatorBuilder_System_Func_Kun_Errors_Error___1__)，
另由 `configure` 改写这一个请求取权限判定器与当前主体的方式（[PermissionBehaviorOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/permissionbehavioroptions.md)），
比如在特定流程里包一层判定器。判定算法与拒绝映射不变。


`TResponse`

### AddKunMediator(IServiceCollection, Action\<KunMediatorBuilder>) \{#Kun_Mediator_DependencyInjection_KunMediatorServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunMediator_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_Mediator_KunMediatorBuilder\_\_}

Adds [KunMediator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediator.md) and all handlers/behaviors configured via
`configure` to the service collection.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunMediator(this IServiceCollection services, Action<KunMediatorBuilder> configure)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection.

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunMediatorBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediatorbuilder.md)>

A delegate that configures the [KunMediatorBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediatorbuilder.md) with request handlers,
pipeline behaviors, and notification handlers.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The same [`IServiceCollection`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection) for chaining.

#### Remarks

May be called more than once on the same service collection: the first call creates the
[KunMediatorBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediatorbuilder.md) and registers [KunMediator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediator.md), [ISender](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/isender.md) and
[IPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/ipublisher.md); later calls configure the same builder, so registrations from several
modules stack into one mediator. Registering a second handler for a request that already has one throws.
A collection whose descriptors were copied from another one gets its own builder.

### Namespaces

[Kun.Mediator.Behaviors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-behaviors/index.md)

[Kun.Mediator.DependencyInjection](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator-dependencyinjection/index.md)

### Classes

[KunMediator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediator.md)

Reflection-free CQRS dispatcher. Handler lookup is O(1) via a pre-built
[`FrozenDictionary`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.frozen.frozendictionary-2). All handler types are explicitly
registered at startup through [KunMediatorBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediatorbuilder.md), so no runtime
scanning or generic type construction is needed — this class is fully AOT-safe.

[KunMediatorBuilder](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediatorbuilder.md)

Fluent builder used to register request handlers, pipeline behaviors, and notification
handlers with [KunMediator](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/kunmediator.md). All registrations are performed via
compile-time-closed generics — no runtime reflection or `MakeGenericType` occurs.

### Interfaces

[INotification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotification.md)

Marker interface for cross-cutting notifications broadcast to many handlers.

[INotificationHandler\<TNotification>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotificationhandler-1.md)

Handler for a specific [INotification](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/inotification.md).

[IPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/ipipelinebehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior wrapping a [IRequestHandler\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-cqrs/irequesthandler-2.md).
Behaviors form a nested "onion": outer behaviors see both the pre- and post-handler phases
of all inner behaviors.

[IPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/ipublisher.md)

Publishes a notification to all registered handlers.

[IScopedPublisher](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/iscopedpublisher.md)

由事务宿主显式指定作用域，保证通知处理器复用同一 DbContext 与 Outbox 缓冲。

[ISender](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/isender.md)

Dispatches a single request to its registered handler.

### Delegates

[RequestHandlerDelegate\<TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-mediator/requesthandlerdelegate-1.md)

Delegate passed to a pipeline behavior representing the next step in the chain.

### BeginScope(JsonElement, Guid) \{#Kun_MultiTenancy_Abstractions_ITenantContextPropagator_BeginScope_System_Text_Json_JsonElement_System_Guid\_}

消费已认证来源的 JSON；authorizedTenantId 必须来自令牌或受保护调度记录，不能取自同一输入。
例外是集成事件消费端（R122）：没有独立于消息的令牌，carrier 为信封原文，authorizedTenantId 为已与 AMQP 头核对一致的信封租户，
这里只做缺失、重复、不一致与租户冲突的 fail-closed 判定，不提供独立授权；信任根是 broker 的连接认证与发布端 Outbox 写入端。

Namespace: [Kun.MultiTenancy](/sdk/api/kun/kun-multitenancy/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.MultiTenancy.dll

[ITenantContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-multitenancy/itenantcontext.md) implementation backed by an
[`AsyncLocal`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.asynclocal-1) so the tenant id flows with the async
call graph across thread hops, task schedulers, and concurrent
parallel tasks. Pair with `TenantContextMiddleware` (or a
background-worker scope that opens a tenant scope explicitly) to
populate the value.

```csharp
public sealed class AsyncLocalTenantContext : ITenantContext
```

### BeginScope(JsonElement, Guid) \{#Kun_MultiTenancy_TenantContextPropagator_BeginScope_System_Text_Json_JsonElement_System_Guid\_}

消费已认证来源的 JSON；authorizedTenantId 必须来自令牌或受保护调度记录，不能取自同一输入。
例外是集成事件消费端（R122）：没有独立于消息的令牌，carrier 为信封原文，authorizedTenantId 为已与 AMQP 头核对一致的信封租户，
这里只做缺失、重复、不一致与租户冲突的 fail-closed 判定，不提供独立授权；信任根是 broker 的连接认证与发布端 Outbox 写入端。

```csharp
public IDisposable BeginScope(JsonElement carrier, Guid authorizedTenantId)
```

#### Parameters

`carrier` [JsonElement](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.jsonelement)

`authorizedTenantId` [Guid](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.guid)

#### Returns

[IDisposable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.idisposable)

## Properties

### EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage \{#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), installs a
`BaseProcessor<Activity>` that mirrors whitelisted
OpenTelemetry baggage entries (see
`Kun.Observability.Enrichment.KunBaggageKeys`) onto span
tags for activities emitted by Kun-owned
[`ActivitySource`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.activitysource)s. Default
[false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) (opt-in per
`docs/architecture/ADR-013-Kun.Observability-enricher.md`
§Default posture). Has no effect when
[KunObservabilityOptions.TracingEnabled](/sdk/api/kun/kun-observability-abstractions/kunobservabilityoptions.md#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_TracingEnabled) is [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

```csharp
public bool EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

### EnrichLogsFromBaggage \{#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_EnrichLogsFromBaggage}

When [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), installs a
`BaseProcessor<LogRecord>` that mirrors whitelisted
OpenTelemetry baggage entries (from the ambient
[`Current`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.activity.current)) onto log
record attributes. The log statement's own attributes win
on conflict — the enricher only adds missing keys. Default
[false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) (opt-in, mirrors
[KunObservabilityOptions.EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-observability-abstractions/kunobservabilityoptions.md#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_EnrichActivitiesFromBaggage) posture per
ADR-013 §F1 resolution). Has no effect when
[KunObservabilityOptions.LoggingEnabled](/sdk/api/kun/kun-observability-abstractions/kunobservabilityoptions.md#Kun_Observability_Abstractions_KunObservabilityOptions_LoggingEnabled) is [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

```csharp
public bool EnrichLogsFromBaggage { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

### CapabilityContractException(string, string, string, string, Exception?) \{#Kun_Plugin_Sdk_CapabilityContractException__ctor_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_String_System_Exception\_}

创建一次登记拒绝。

```csharp
public CapabilityContractException(string componentId, string name, string location, string rule, Exception? innerException = null)
```

#### Parameters

`componentId` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

拥有该能力的组件。

`name` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

组件内能力短名。

`location` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

出错位置：以能力 ID 为文件的 JSON Pointer，如 `qian.sample.crm/customer.create#/inputSchema/properties/tenantId`。

`rule` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

违反的规则：`tool-invalid`、`entry-invalid`、`tenant-field`、`unsupported-key`、`unsupported-number`、`unresolved-reference`、`schema-invalid`，
其余无法生成条目的情况为 `contract-invalid`。

`innerException` [Exception](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.exception)?

底层失败；只用于诊断，不进入消息。

# Namespace Kun.Plugin.Sdk

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Plugin.Sdk` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Plugin.Sdk`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Plugin.Sdk)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[CapabilityAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/capabilityattribute.md)

声明命令或查询的契约；源生成器验证并生成强类型能力定义。

[CapabilityBindingRegistration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/capabilitybindingregistration.md)

SDK 层的可逆能力注册，不依赖 platform 的 Capabilities Provider。

[CapabilityContract](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/capabilitycontract.md)

代码生成的能力声明；只有元数据，不承担请求认证、授权或安装状态判定。

[CapabilityContractException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/capabilitycontractexception.md)

能力契约在登记阶段被拒绝：带组件 ID、能力短名、出错位置与规则。同样的值写入 [`Data`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.exception.data)（含原因码 `INPUT_INVALID`），
供 scope 装载失败与管理面诊断读取；消息不含 Schema 或配置原文。

[CapabilitySourceAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/capabilitysourceattribute.md)

引用与真实执行绑定共用的静态能力契约；不得通过实例化插件或处理器取得。

[CommandEvents](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/commandevents.md)

SDK 生产执行端拥有的事件 Definition，供基础组件注册强制监听器。

[CommandInvocation](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/commandinvocation.md)

一次已经绑定业务事务的调用；输入和身份不得从日志字符串化展开。

[CommandPolicies](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/commandpolicies.md)

基础 Provider 的监听登记入口；执行器同时核验服务、实际进入与卸载取消。

[ComponentCodeMetadata](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/componentcodemetadata.md)

代码派生的组件字段；手写版本、展示、策略和路径仍由唯一 plugin.json 保存。

[ComponentMetadataDeclarations](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/componentmetadatadeclarations.md)

生成代码使用的声明校验；只读取静态声明，不执行插件。

[ComponentOwnerAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/componentownerattribute.md)

在多组件程序集内为权限或事件声明指定唯一归属。

[ContributesAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/contributesattribute.md)

声明具名扩展点贡献；服务键由指定类型的公开静态只读 ServiceKey 字段取得。

[DelegatePluginAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/delegatepluginattribute.md)

稳定组件入口委托给已分类的实现构件；必须同时独立声明其完整服务输出。

[JobBindingRegistration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/jobbindingregistration.md)

local 作业的可逆注册；独立宿主与平台目录消费同一能力绑定。

[JobContract](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/jobcontract.md)

绑定真实能力的不可变作业目录项；能力本身仍负责执行策略。

[JsonSchemaReferences](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/jsonschemareferences.md)

源生成与实际 HTTP 描述共用的 JSON Schema 引用处理。

[KunCodeMetadataAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/kuncodemetadataattribute.md)

编译程序集暴露的生成元数据入口；只用于可信项目的构建期工具。

[KunConfigSchemaAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/kunconfigschemaattribute.md)

组件配置的代码声明；工具派生为清单所指的 configSchema 文件。

[KunJobAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/kunjobattribute.md)

将已有能力请求声明为可持久调度的 local 作业；code 在组件内唯一。

[KunPluginAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/kunpluginattribute.md)

声明组件的稳定 ID；同程序集允许多个不同 ID 的入口。

[ManifestErrors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/manifesterrors.md)

可信组件清单构建的错误目录；不改变市场准入或运行权限。

[ProvidesAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/providesattribute.md)

委托入口的单项服务输出；直接 Apply 仍由语义分析派生，不使用此声明覆盖分析。

[SensitiveAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/sensitiveattribute.md)

将输入属性标为敏感；生成契约在实际 JSON 字段上添加 sensitive，而非把原值写入审计。

[SharedEventsAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-plugin-sdk/sharedeventsattribute.md)

引用另一个组件拥有的共享事件契约；不共享权限或其它元数据。

### Classes

[KunRateLimitOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/kunratelimitoptions.md)

Root configuration for `AddKunRateLimit`. Callers register one
or more named windows — typically `"api"` for bulk read / write
traffic and `"auth"` for stricter login paths — and optionally
supply a custom [KunRateLimitOptions.OnRejected](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/kunratelimitoptions.md#Kun_RateLimit_Abstractions_KunRateLimitOptions_OnRejected) hook that runs after the
default 429 response is written.

### OnRejected \{#Kun_RateLimit_Abstractions_KunRateLimitOptions_OnRejected}

Optional hook invoked after the default 429 / `Retry-After`
response is written. Ideal for structured logging or metrics
emission; do **not** mutate the response from here — the
response has already been committed.

```csharp
public Func<OnRejectedContext, CancellationToken, ValueTask>? OnRejected { get; set; }
```

#### Property Value

[Func](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-3)\<[OnRejectedContext](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.ratelimiting.onrejectedcontext), [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken), [ValueTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.valuetask)>?

### AddKunRateLimit(IServiceCollection, Action\<KunRateLimitOptions>) \{#Kun_RateLimit_Extensions_KunRateLimitServiceCollectionExtensions_AddKunRateLimit_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IServiceCollection_System_Action_Kun_RateLimit_Abstractions_KunRateLimitOptions\_\_}

Registers [`RateLimiterOptions`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.ratelimiting.ratelimiteroptions) built from the supplied
[KunRateLimitOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/kunratelimitoptions.md). Each named window becomes a
fixed-window partition policy buckets on the configured
[RateLimitPartitionKey](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/ratelimitpartitionkey.md). Rejected requests receive a
[`Status429TooManyRequests`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.statuscodes.status429toomanyrequests) response with a
`Retry-After` header; the optional
[KunRateLimitOptions.OnRejected](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/kunratelimitoptions.md#Kun_RateLimit_Abstractions_KunRateLimitOptions_OnRejected) hook runs after the
default response is written.

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddKunRateLimit(this IServiceCollection services, Action<KunRateLimitOptions> configure)
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The service collection.

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunRateLimitOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit-abstractions/kunratelimitoptions.md)>

Options callback; must register at least one window.

#### Returns

[IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection)

The same `services` for chaining.

## Methods

### HitAsync(string, TimeSpan, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_RateLimit_IRedisRateLimitStore_HitAsync_System_String_System_TimeSpan_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Atomically increments the count for `partitionKey` within a
rolling window of `window`, applying TTL on the first write so
stale partitions self-expire. Returns the post-increment count and the time until
the window resets.

```csharp
Task<RateLimitHitResult> HitAsync(string partitionKey, TimeSpan window, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`partitionKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Caller's partition key (tenant, IP, sub, etc.).

`window` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)

Window length; controls Redis EXPIRE TTL on first hit.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[RateLimitHitResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit/ratelimithitresult.md)>

`Count`: current number of hits within the active window (>= 1).
`ResetsIn`: time until the window resets. Never negative.

### HitAsync(string, TimeSpan, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_RateLimit_RedisFixedWindowRateLimitStore_HitAsync_System_String_System_TimeSpan_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Atomically increments the count for `partitionKey` within a
rolling window of `window`, applying TTL on the first write so
stale partitions self-expire. Returns the post-increment count and the time until
the window resets.

```csharp
public Task<RateLimitHitResult> HitAsync(string partitionKey, TimeSpan window, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`partitionKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

`window` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)

Window length; controls Redis EXPIRE TTL on first hit.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[RateLimitHitResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-ratelimit/ratelimithitresult.md)>

进程内扩展事件的分发模式。

```csharp
public enum DispatchMode
```

## Fields

`Bail = 4`

依次执行，首个非空结果中断。

`Emit = 0`

依次通知，记录并隔离监听器异常。

`Parallel = 2`

并发执行，等待全部完成并聚合失败。

`Serial = 3`

依次执行，首个失败中断。

`Waterfall = 1`

通过 next 委托的环绕中间件。

# Namespace Kun.Runtime

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Runtime` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Runtime`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Runtime)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[KunEvent\<TPayload, TResult>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/kunevent-2.md)

Definition 定义的事件。TResult 是整个分发的结果；扇出与按序模式用 IReadOnlyList\<T>。

[KunEvent](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/kunevent.md)

事件定义工厂。

[KunEventAttribute](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/kuneventattribute.md)

标注事件字段或属性的分发模式；文档生成器校验它与事件值及注册调用一致，不影响运行时求值。

[ParallelDispatchException\<TResult>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/paralleldispatchexception-1.md)

所有并行监听器结束后报告失败；Partial 仅含成功结果，顺序与监听器一致。

[PluginDefinition](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/plugindefinition.md)

装载输入；Provides 来自清单，不通过试运行 Apply 推测。

[PluginEntry](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/pluginentry.md)

已由清单与配置装配器解析的插件条目。

[PluginLoader](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/pluginloader.md)

按服务依赖装载插件。代码实例由宿主提供，不加载动态程序集、不读数据库。

[Registration](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/registration.md)

目录与执行共用的注册描述；Name 为空表示键本身，具名 seam 使用独立名称。

[ServiceNotReadyException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/servicenotreadyexception.md)

当前服务尚不可见。不存在与被过滤的服务返回相同错误。

### Structs

[ScopeKey](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/scopekey.md)

两层扁平作用域：[ScopeKey.Global](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/scopekey.md#Kun_Runtime_ScopeKey_Global)，或「种类 + 非空 id」；作用域之间没有继承关系。
运行时只查语法（种类是小写字母开头、由小写字母数字与连字符组成的名字），种类有哪些由平台档定。

[ServiceKey](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/servicekey.md)

Definition 拥有的服务键；具名注册可用 Key:name 声明就绪依赖。

### Interfaces

[IKunPlugin\<TConfig>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/ikunplugin-1.md)

类型化配置接口；Schema 校验由清单装配器在调用前完成。

[IKunPlugin](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/ikunplugin.md)

插件的最小接口。

[IPluginContext](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/iplugincontext.md)

插件的服务、效果与作用域入口。

[IRegistrationHandle\<TService>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/iregistrationhandle-1.md)

Provide 返回的注册句柄：Dispose 撤销注册，可重复调用；Replace 原子替换同一注册的实例。

### Enums

[DispatchMode](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/dispatchmode.md)

进程内扩展事件的分发模式。

[PluginState](/sdk/api/kun/kun-runtime/pluginstate.md)

某次 Apply 的状态；失败保留原异常供管理面查询。

```csharp
public interface IRegistrationHandle<TService> : IDisposable where TService : class
```

#### Type Parameters

#### Implements

## Methods

### Replace(TService) \{#Kun_Runtime_IRegistrationHandle_1_Replace__0\_}

在原注册位原子替换实例：解析方只会看到旧实例或新实例，不会看到注册缺失；scope、注册顺序与独占性不变。
替换等价于在同一临界区内撤销后再登记，以 inject 依赖该键的条目同样回到 Pending 并重新 Apply。
句柄已撤销或上下文已卸载时抛出 ObjectDisposedException。

```csharp
void Replace(TService instance)
```

#### Parameters

`instance` TService

某次 Apply 的状态；失败保留原异常供管理面查询。

```csharp
public enum PluginState
```

## Fields

`Applying = 1`

正在执行 Apply，注册尚未对其它插件公开。

`Failed = 3`

Apply 失败且已尝试撤销全部效果。

`Pending = 0`

等待全部必需服务。

`Ready = 2`

Apply 成功且依赖保持就绪。

## Methods

### AddKunServiceAuthentication(AuthenticationBuilder, Action\<KunServiceAuthenticationOptions>) \{#Kun_Security_Authentication_KunServiceAuthenticationExtensions_AddKunServiceAuthentication_Microsoft_AspNetCore_Authentication_AuthenticationBuilder_System_Action_Kun_Security_Authentication_KunServiceAuthenticationOptions\_\_}

Adds JWT Bearer authentication for gateway-issued S2S tokens. It validates the signature
(asymmetric RS256 or ES256 only; HS256 is rejected, consistent with the zero-trust policy),
the issuer, the audience and the lifetime with a 30-second clock skew. The issuer and the
audience must be one of the configured values.

```csharp
public static AuthenticationBuilder AddKunServiceAuthentication(this AuthenticationBuilder builder, Action<KunServiceAuthenticationOptions> configure)
```

#### Parameters

`builder` [AuthenticationBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.authentication.authenticationbuilder)

The authentication builder.

`configure` [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action-1)\<[KunServiceAuthenticationOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-authentication/kunserviceauthenticationoptions.md)>

Delegate to configure [KunServiceAuthenticationOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-authentication/kunserviceauthenticationoptions.md).

#### Returns

[AuthenticationBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.authentication.authenticationbuilder)

The authentication builder for chaining.

#### Remarks

For the full S2S contract check (closed claim set, exactly this service as the audience,
identity, roles, scope and the 300-second lifetime limit), register `AddKunIdentityS2s`
from Kun.Identity.Client, or call [PrincipalClaims.ReadS2s](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-authentication/principalclaims.md#Kun_Security_Authentication_PrincipalClaims_ReadS2s_System_Security_Claims_ClaimsPrincipal_System_Text_Json_JsonElement_System_DateTimeOffset_Kun_Security_Principal__) from the scheme's
`OnTokenValidated` event and then compare the expected issuer and audience.

### AddKunServiceAuth(IHttpClientBuilder) \{#Kun_Security_Extensions_HttpClientBuilderExtensions_AddKunServiceAuth_Microsoft_Extensions_DependencyInjection_IHttpClientBuilder\_}

Chains [PropagateS2sTokenHandler](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-http/propagates2stokenhandler.md) onto the HTTP client pipeline,
so the S2S JWT from the current incoming request is forwarded to downstream services.

```csharp
[Obsolete("Issue a new S2S token for the downstream audience.", DiagnosticId = "KUNS2S001")]
public static IHttpClientBuilder AddKunServiceAuth(this IHttpClientBuilder builder)
```

### Classes

[PropagateS2sTokenHandler](/sdk/api/kun/kun-security-http/propagates2stokenhandler.md)

A [`DelegatingHandler`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.net.http.delegatinghandler) that copies the `Authorization` header
from the current incoming HTTP request to all outgoing requests made by the
[`HttpClient`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.net.http.httpclient) it is attached to.
This propagates the S2S JWT transparently across service boundaries.

Loads a JSON Web Key Set from a local file and caches it in memory.
The cache is invalidated when the file's last-write time changes, enabling
key rotation without service restart.

### GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Creates a presigned POST upload descriptor. The signed policy embeds
[UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) when set, so the backing store (not the
framework) rejects oversized uploads before any bytes are persisted. Allowed
content types are encoded into the policy when
[UploadConstraints.AllowedContentTypes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_AllowedContentTypes) is supplied.

```csharp
public Task<PresignedPostUpload> GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string objectKey, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Target object key.

`constraints` UploadConstraints?

Optional upload constraints. When `null`, no size/type
limits are baked into the policy.

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Lifetime of the signed policy.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedPostUpload>

#### Remarks

Not supported on the local-filesystem implementation: signing a POST policy is an
S3-specific construct with no meaningful analogue for a developer-local store.
Callers that need dev-time presigned uploads should use
[LocalFileSystemStorage.GetPresignedUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-local/localfilesystemstorage.md#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_);
callers that need MaxBytes-in-signature enforcement must swap to `Kun.Storage.S3`
against an S3-compatible endpoint (e.g. MinIO for dev).

### GetPresignedUploadAsync(string, string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Local_LocalFileSystemStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Produces a time-limited URL the caller can `PUT` content to. The returned
record carries the exact HTTP headers the caller must send so server-side
constraint enforcement works.

```csharp
public Task<PresignedUploadUrl> GetPresignedUploadAsync(string objectKey, string contentType, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Storage object key.

`contentType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Declared content type for the upload.

`constraints` UploadConstraints?

Size / content-type policy enforced by the URL signature.

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Validity window.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedUploadUrl>

#### Remarks

The PUT URL returned here cannot embed [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) in
the signature; consumers that need size enforcement at the S3 layer should use
[IFileStorage.GetPresignedPostUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) instead — its signed POST policy bakes
`content-length-range` into the signature so S3 rejects oversized bodies with
HTTP 400 before any bytes are persisted.
