# Class OssFileStorage

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Storage.Oss` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Storage.Oss`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Storage.Oss)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Storage.Oss](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-oss/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Storage.Oss.dll

Alibaba Cloud OSS implementation of [IFileStorage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md) using the native
`Aliyun.OSS.SDK.NetCore` client.

```csharp
public sealed class OssFileStorage : IFileStorage
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←
[OssFileStorage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-oss/ossfilestorage.md)

#### Implements

IFileStorage

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),
[object.ToString()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.tostring),
[object.Equals(object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object\)),
[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

**Why native and not the S3-compatible path:** OSS exposes an S3-compatible surface, but
its presigned URLs are validated with OSS's own signature algorithm — not AWS SigV4. An AWS
SDK client pointed at an OSS endpoint emits SigV4-signed URLs that OSS rejects, so presigned
upload/download (the core of this contract) does not work over `Kun.Storage.S3`. This
type therefore wraps the native SDK and is the supported way to target OSS.

**Security guarantee (M1):** [OssFileStorage.GetPresignedDownloadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-oss/ossfilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_Oss_OssFileStorage_GetPresignedDownloadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) ALWAYS sets
`response-content-disposition=attachment` on the signed URL when the stored object's
content type is one of [ActiveWebContentTypes.Value](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/activewebcontenttypes.md#Kun_Storage_ActiveWebContentTypes_Value), regardless of
[DownloadOptions.ForceDownload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/downloadoptions.md#Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_ForceDownload).

**Async posture:** the Aliyun SDK exposes only synchronous and APM (Begin/End) operations,
no TAP. Network calls are offloaded with [`Run`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task.run--1)
so callers keep an async surface; the token cancels queueing, not an in-flight OSS request.
Presigned-URL generation is pure local signing (no I/O) and completes synchronously.

### GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Oss_OssFileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Creates a presigned POST upload descriptor. The signed policy embeds
[UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) when set, so the backing store (not the
framework) rejects oversized uploads before any bytes are persisted. Allowed
content types are encoded into the policy when
[UploadConstraints.AllowedContentTypes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_AllowedContentTypes) is supplied.


`constraints` UploadConstraints?

Optional upload constraints. When `null`, no size/type
limits are baked into the policy.

Lifetime of the signed policy.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

### GetPresignedUploadAsync(string, string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Oss_OssFileStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Produces a time-limited URL the caller can `PUT` content to. The returned
record carries the exact HTTP headers the caller must send so server-side
constraint enforcement works.

```csharp
public Task<PresignedUploadUrl> GetPresignedUploadAsync(string objectKey, string contentType, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Storage object key.

`contentType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Declared content type for the upload.

`constraints` UploadConstraints?

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedUploadUrl>

#### Remarks

The PUT URL returned here cannot embed [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) in
the signature; consumers that need size enforcement at the S3 layer should use
[IFileStorage.GetPresignedPostUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) instead — its signed POST policy bakes
`content-length-range` into the signature so S3 rejects oversized bodies with
HTTP 400 before any bytes are persisted.

### OpenReadAsync(string, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_Oss_OssFileStorage_OpenReadAsync_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}


#### Remarks

Optional capability. Backends that only expose presigned URLs leave the default,
which throws [`NotSupportedException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) — callers should treat that as
"server-side read unavailable" and degrade (e.g. metadata-only diff). Overriding
implementations SHOULD throw [`FileNotFoundException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.filenotfoundexception) when the object is missing.

# Class S3FileStorage

:::info 生成页

```csharp
public sealed class S3FileStorage : IFileStorage
```

[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),

[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

This type's critical security guarantee: [S3FileStorage.GetPresignedDownloadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage-s3/s3filestorage.md#Kun_Storage_S3_S3FileStorage_GetPresignedDownloadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) ALWAYS
sets `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="…"` on the signed URL when the
stored object's content type is one of the four active web content types enumerated in
[ActiveWebContentTypes.Value](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/activewebcontenttypes.md#Kun_Storage_ActiveWebContentTypes_Value) — `text/html`, `image/svg+xml`,
`application/xhtml+xml`, `application/xml`. This holds regardless of whether
the caller sets [DownloadOptions.ForceDownload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/downloadoptions.md#Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_ForceDownload).

### GetPresignedDownloadAsync(string, DownloadOptions?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_S3_S3FileStorage_GetPresignedDownloadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Produces a time-limited URL the caller can use to download the object directly
from the backing store. The URL MUST include `Content-Disposition: attachment`
when the stored content type is an active web content type (see remarks on
[IFileStorage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md)).

```csharp
public Task<PresignedDownloadUrl> GetPresignedDownloadAsync(string objectKey, DownloadOptions? options = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Storage object key.

`options` DownloadOptions?

Optional download behavior (download-name override, custom response headers).

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Validity window for the presigned URL.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedDownloadUrl>

### GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_S3_S3FileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Creates a presigned POST upload descriptor. The signed policy embeds
[UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) when set, so the backing store (not the
framework) rejects oversized uploads before any bytes are persisted. Allowed
content types are encoded into the policy when
[UploadConstraints.AllowedContentTypes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_AllowedContentTypes) is supplied.

```csharp
public Task<PresignedPostUpload> GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string objectKey, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Target object key.

`constraints` UploadConstraints?

Optional upload constraints. When `null`, no size/type
limits are baked into the policy.

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Lifetime of the signed policy.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedPostUpload>

### GetPresignedUploadAsync(string, string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_S3_S3FileStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Produces a time-limited URL the caller can `PUT` content to. The returned
record carries the exact HTTP headers the caller must send so server-side
constraint enforcement works.

```csharp
public Task<PresignedUploadUrl> GetPresignedUploadAsync(string objectKey, string contentType, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Storage object key.

`contentType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Declared content type for the upload.

`constraints` UploadConstraints?

Size / content-type policy enforced by the URL signature.

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Validity window.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<PresignedUploadUrl>

#### Remarks

The PUT URL returned here cannot embed [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) in
the signature; consumers that need size enforcement at the S3 layer should use
[IFileStorage.GetPresignedPostUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) instead — its signed POST policy bakes
`content-length-range` into the signature so S3 rejects oversized bodies with
HTTP 400 before any bytes are persisted.

### OpenReadAsync(string, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_S3_S3FileStorage_OpenReadAsync_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Opens a readable stream over the object's content for server-side reads (e.g.
computing a content diff). The caller MUST dispose the returned stream.

```csharp
public Task<Stream> OpenReadAsync(string objectKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Storage object key.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[Stream](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.stream)>

#### Remarks

Optional capability. Backends that only expose presigned URLs leave the default,
which throws [`NotSupportedException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) — callers should treat that as
"server-side read unavailable" and degrade (e.g. metadata-only diff). Overriding
implementations SHOULD throw [`FileNotFoundException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.filenotfoundexception) when the object is missing.

### UploadAsync(string, Stream, string, UploadConstraints?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_S3_S3FileStorage_UploadAsync_System_String_System_IO_Stream_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

#### Returns

# Class ActiveWebContentTypes

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Storage.Abstractions` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Storage.Abstractions`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Storage.Abstractions)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Storage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Storage.Abstractions.dll

The canonical set of MIME types that browsers render as active web content —
i.e. payloads that could execute script or navigate against the serving origin
if opened inline. An [IFileStorage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md) implementation MUST force
`Content-Disposition: attachment` on presigned download URLs whose
[ObjectMetadata.ContentType](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/objectmetadata.md#Kun_Storage_ObjectMetadata_ContentType) is contained in this set, regardless
of whether the caller requested [DownloadOptions.ForceDownload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/downloadoptions.md#Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_ForceDownload).

```csharp
public static class ActiveWebContentTypes
```

## Remarks

The four entries are fixed by M1 of the Sprint-1 gap-closure plan:
`text/html`, `image/svg+xml`, `application/xhtml+xml`, `application/xml`.
Comparison is case-insensitive.

# Interface IFileStorage

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Storage.Abstractions` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Storage.Abstractions`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Storage.Abstractions)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Storage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Storage.Abstractions.dll

Transport-agnostic object-storage abstraction used by Kun services to upload,
download, and manage blob artifacts (attachments, user uploads, exported files).
Implementations map the seven operations to a backing store (local filesystem,
Amazon S3, MinIO, Azure Blob, GCS).

```csharp
public interface IFileStorage
```

## Remarks

Object keys are relative, forward-slash-delimited paths (e.g. `tenants/42/avatar.png`).
They do not include a leading slash and do not identify the bucket / root — the
implementation resolves those from its configured options.

Implementations MUST force `Content-Disposition: attachment` on presigned
download URLs whose stored content type is in
[ActiveWebContentTypes.Value](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/activewebcontenttypes.md#Kun_Storage_ActiveWebContentTypes_Value), even if
[DownloadOptions.ForceDownload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/downloadoptions.md#Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_ForceDownload) is `false`. This defends against
cross-origin script execution when a tenant-uploaded HTML/SVG/XML blob is opened
inline by a browser.

### GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Creates a presigned POST upload descriptor. The signed policy embeds
[UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) when set, so the backing store (not the
framework) rejects oversized uploads before any bytes are persisted. Allowed
content types are encoded into the policy when
[UploadConstraints.AllowedContentTypes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_AllowedContentTypes) is supplied.

```csharp
Task<PresignedPostUpload> GetPresignedPostUploadAsync(string objectKey, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Target object key.

`constraints` [UploadConstraints](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md)?

Optional upload constraints. When `null`, no size/type
limits are baked into the policy.

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Lifetime of the signed policy.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[PresignedPostUpload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/presignedpostupload.md)>

### GetPresignedUploadAsync(string, string, UploadConstraints?, TimeSpan?, CancellationToken) \{#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken\_}

Produces a time-limited URL the caller can `PUT` content to. The returned
record carries the exact HTTP headers the caller must send so server-side
constraint enforcement works.

```csharp
Task<PresignedUploadUrl> GetPresignedUploadAsync(string objectKey, string contentType, UploadConstraints? constraints = null, TimeSpan? expiresIn = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

#### Parameters

`objectKey` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Storage object key.

`contentType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

Declared content type for the upload.

`constraints` [UploadConstraints](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md)?

Size / content-type policy enforced by the URL signature.

`expiresIn` [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)?

Validity window.

`cancellationToken` [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancellation token.

#### Returns

[Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)\<[PresignedUploadUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/presigneduploadurl.md)>

#### Remarks

The PUT URL returned here cannot embed [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes) in
the signature; consumers that need size enforcement at the S3 layer should use
[IFileStorage.GetPresignedPostUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedPostUploadAsync_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) instead — its signed POST policy bakes
`content-length-range` into the signature so S3 rejects oversized bodies with
HTTP 400 before any bytes are persisted.

#### Remarks

Optional capability. Backends that only expose presigned URLs leave the default,
which throws [`NotSupportedException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) — callers should treat that as
"server-side read unavailable" and degrade (e.g. metadata-only diff). Overriding
implementations SHOULD throw [`FileNotFoundException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.filenotfoundexception) when the object is missing.

### Classes

[ActiveWebContentTypes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/activewebcontenttypes.md)

The canonical set of MIME types that browsers render as active web content —
i.e. payloads that could execute script or navigate against the serving origin
if opened inline. An [IFileStorage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md) implementation MUST force
`Content-Disposition: attachment` on presigned download URLs whose
[ObjectMetadata.ContentType](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/objectmetadata.md#Kun_Storage_ObjectMetadata_ContentType) is contained in this set, regardless
of whether the caller requested [DownloadOptions.ForceDownload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/downloadoptions.md#Kun_Storage_DownloadOptions_ForceDownload).

[DownloadOptions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/downloadoptions.md)

Per-call download behavior hints.

[ListObjectsResult](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/listobjectsresult.md)

A page of objects returned by [IFileStorage.ListAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_ListAsync_System_String_System_Int32_System_String_System_Threading_CancellationToken_).

[ObjectMetadata](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/objectmetadata.md)

Metadata describing a stored object.

[PresignedDownloadUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/presigneddownloadurl.md)

Presigned GET URL that lets a client download the object directly from the store.

[PresignedPostUpload](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/presignedpostupload.md)

Presigned POST descriptor for direct browser/client uploads. Unlike the PUT-based
[PresignedUploadUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/presigneduploadurl.md), the signed policy baked into the form fields
enforces [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes): S3 itself rejects oversized bodies
with HTTP 400 before any bytes land in the bucket.

[PresignedUploadUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/presigneduploadurl.md)

Presigned PUT URL that a client can use to upload directly to the store.

[UploadConstraints](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md)

Upload policy applied by [IFileStorage.UploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_UploadAsync_System_String_System_IO_Stream_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) and encoded into
[IFileStorage.GetPresignedUploadAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md#Kun_Storage_IFileStorage_GetPresignedUploadAsync_System_String_System_String_Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_System_Nullable_System_TimeSpan__System_Threading_CancellationToken_) signatures.

### Interfaces

[IFileStorage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/ifilestorage.md)

Transport-agnostic object-storage abstraction used by Kun services to upload,
download, and manage blob artifacts (attachments, user uploads, exported files).
Implementations map the seven operations to a backing store (local filesystem,
Amazon S3, MinIO, Azure Blob, GCS).

Presigned POST descriptor for direct browser/client uploads. Unlike the PUT-based
[PresignedUploadUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/presigneduploadurl.md), the signed policy baked into the form fields
enforces [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes): S3 itself rejects oversized bodies
with HTTP 400 before any bytes land in the bucket.

Presigned POST descriptor for direct browser/client uploads. Unlike the PUT-based
[PresignedUploadUrl](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/presigneduploadurl.md), the signed policy baked into the form fields
enforces [UploadConstraints.MaxBytes](/sdk/api/kun/kun-storage/uploadconstraints.md#Kun_Storage_UploadConstraints_MaxBytes): S3 itself rejects oversized bodies
with HTTP 400 before any bytes land in the bucket.

```csharp
public PresignedPostUpload(Uri Url, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> FormFields, DateTimeOffset ExpiresAt)
```

#### Parameters

`Url` Uri

Endpoint to POST a multipart/form-data body to.

`FormFields` [IReadOnlyDictionary](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ireadonlydictionary-2)\<[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string), [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)>

Form fields that MUST appear verbatim in the multipart body
before the `file` field (policy, x-amz-signature, x-amz-credential, x-amz-date,
x-amz-algorithm, key, Content-Type, etc.). Order matters — callers should iterate the
dictionary and append each key/value in order, then append the file bytes last.

`ExpiresAt` [DateTimeOffset](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.datetimeoffset)

Absolute expiry (UTC) of the signed policy.

# Class AuthentikFixture

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Testing.Containers` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Testing.Containers`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Testing.Containers)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

真实 Authentik（server + worker + 专属 PostgreSQL），作为 OIDC 连接器的上游身份源（S1-IDP-007 验收 1）。
启动后用引导令牌经 REST API 开 OAuth2 客户端与用户；[AuthentikFixture.SignInAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/authentikfixture.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_AuthentikFixture_SignInAsync_System_Uri_Kun_Testing_Containers_AuthentikFixture_User_System_Uri_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) 像浏览器一样走 Authentik 的登录流程（flow executor），
返回 Authentik 回跳到依赖方回调地址的完整 URL。口令与令牌每次运行随机生成。

# Namespace Kun.Testing.Containers

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Testing.Containers` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Testing.Containers`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Testing.Containers)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

### Classes

[ApolloFixture](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/apollofixture.md)

Apollo 配置服务的协议替身（PRD §14.2：集成测试层的 Apollo 用 mock server）。
容器内运行 `ApolloMock/apollo_mock.py`：实现客户端用到的 `/configs`、`/configfiles/json`、
`/notifications/v2` 长轮询、Meta Server 与访问密钥签名；测试经本类的方法发布或撤下配置。
覆盖范围见脚本文件头注释与 tests/README.md。

[ApolloRelease](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/apollorelease.md)

一次发布的结果。

[AuthentikFixture](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/authentikfixture.md)

真实 Authentik（server + worker + 专属 PostgreSQL），作为 OIDC 连接器的上游身份源（S1-IDP-007 验收 1）。
启动后用引导令牌经 REST API 开 OAuth2 客户端与用户；[AuthentikFixture.SignInAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/authentikfixture.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_AuthentikFixture_SignInAsync_System_Uri_Kun_Testing_Containers_AuthentikFixture_User_System_Uri_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) 像浏览器一样走 Authentik 的登录流程（flow executor），
返回 Authentik 回跳到依赖方回调地址的完整 URL。口令与令牌每次运行随机生成。

[ContainerFixture\<TContainer>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/containerfixture-1.md)

单个容器 fixture 的公共骨架：启动容器（瞬时失败时有界重试）、按 [DockerRequirement](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/dockerrequirement.md) 处理 Docker 缺失、随 fixture 一起释放。
直接用作 xUnit 的 class / collection / assembly fixture。

[ContainerImages](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/containerimages.md)

集成测试使用的镜像。版本与部署基线一致：PostgreSQL 16、Redis 7（ADR-017 D17.2）；
RabbitMQ 取当前 4.x 稳定线（PRD §14.6）。每个镜像都可用环境变量覆盖，便于与 staging 对齐或换内网镜像源。

[DexFixture](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/dexfixture.md)

独立实现的外部 OIDC 发行方（CNCF Dex），用来验证依赖方能对接 Kun 身份服务之外的任意发行方。内存存储、本地密码库里一个用户、一个启用 PKCE 的公开客户端，
跳过授权确认页。Dex 的 issuer 必须在启动前写进配置，所以宿主端口与 RP 回调端口都在启动前选定；口令每次运行随机生成，配置里只有 bcrypt 哈希。

[DockerRequirement](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/dockerrequirement.md)

没有 Docker 时集成测试怎么办：本机跳过；CI 上直接失败，因为 PR 级门禁要求集成测试必须真跑（PRD §14.4 C10）。

[InfrastructureFixture](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/infrastructurefixture.md)

一次拉起全部四个依赖（PostgreSQL / Redis / RabbitMQ / Apollo 替身），并行启动。
平台插件的集成测试通常同时需要它们，作为 collection 或 assembly fixture 使用，整组测试共享一套容器。

[K3sFixture](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/k3sfixture.md)

K3s 单节点集群（特权容器）。[K3sFixture.Kubeconfig](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/k3sfixture.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_K3sFixture_Kubeconfig) 里的 API Server 已映射到宿主端口；容器内自带 kubectl（含 kustomize），
可用 [K3sFixture.KubectlAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/k3sfixture.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_K3sFixture_KubectlAsync_System_Threading_CancellationToken_System_String___) 代替 Argo 应用部署仓库里的片段。

[AuthentikFixture.OAuthClient](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/authentikfixture-oauthclient.md)

为一个依赖方开出的 OAuth2 客户端。

[PgBouncerPostgresFixture](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/pgbouncerpostgresfixture.md)

Spins up a Postgres 16 container fronted by `edoburu/pgbouncer` in
`POOL_MODE=transaction`. Exposes both direct and bouncer-fronted connection strings so
tests can assert that `SET LOCAL` / `set_config(..., true)` semantics survive
PgBouncer's backend-connection recycling between transactions.

[PostgresFixture](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/postgresfixture.md)

PostgreSQL 16 容器。提供两条连接串：
[PostgresFixture.ConnectionString](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/postgresfixture.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_PostgresFixture_ConnectionString) 是超级用户，用于建表、迁移与造数；
[PostgresFixture.AppConnectionString](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/postgresfixture.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_PostgresFixture_AppConnectionString) 是 `NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS` 的应用角色，验证 RLS 的测试必须用它——
超级用户与 `BYPASSRLS` 角色会绕过 `FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY`，策略对它们不可见（ADR-004）。

[RabbitMqFixture](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/rabbitmqfixture.md)

RabbitMQ 容器。韧性测试可经 [ContainerFixture\<TContainer>.Container](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/containerfixture-1.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_ContainerFixture_1_Container) 停启 broker。

[RedisFixture](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/redisfixture.md)

Redis 7 容器。

[S3CompatibleServer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/s3compatibleserver.md)

存储集成测试用的 S3 兼容服务容器：RustFS（Apache-2.0）。

[AuthentikFixture.User](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/authentikfixture-user.md)

Authentik 里的一个本地用户。

平台插件的集成测试通常同时需要它们，作为 collection 或 assembly fixture 使用，整组测试共享一套容器。

### StartAttempts \{#Kun_Testing_Containers_K3sFixture_StartAttempts}

容器（含 [ContainerFixture\<TContainer>.OnStartingAsync](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/containerfixture-1.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_ContainerFixture_1_OnStartingAsync_System_Threading_CancellationToken_) 启动的依赖容器）在就绪之前自行退出时，整个启动最多尝试的次数，默认 1（不重试）。
环境类瞬时失败另按 [ContainerFixture\<TContainer>.TransientAttempts](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/containerfixture-1.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_ContainerFixture_1_TransientAttempts) 重试，不受此值影响。

```csharp
protected override int StartAttempts { get; }
```

#### Property Value

[int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)

#### Remarks

K3s 启动时短暂占满全部 CPU；宿主繁忙时 API Server 的启动后钩子可能超时、进程退出（退出码 2），此时重建容器，最多三次。

# Class PgBouncerPostgresFixture

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Testing.Containers` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Testing.Containers`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Testing.Containers)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Testing.Containers](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Testing.Containers.dll

Spins up a Postgres 16 container fronted by `edoburu/pgbouncer` in
`POOL_MODE=transaction`. Exposes both direct and bouncer-fronted connection strings so
tests can assert that `SET LOCAL` / `set_config(..., true)` semantics survive
PgBouncer's backend-connection recycling between transactions.

```csharp
public sealed class PgBouncerPostgresFixture : IAsyncLifetime, IAsyncDisposable
```

#### Inheritance

Shared between P1-4 (`TenantRlsInterceptorPgBouncerTests`, M2) and the later P1-5
PgBouncer compatibility suite. Skips automatically when Docker is not available.

# Class PostgresFixture

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Testing.Containers` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Testing.Containers`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Testing.Containers)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Testing.Containers](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Testing.Containers.dll

PostgreSQL 16 容器。提供两条连接串：
[PostgresFixture.ConnectionString](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/postgresfixture.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_PostgresFixture_ConnectionString) 是超级用户，用于建表、迁移与造数；
[PostgresFixture.AppConnectionString](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/postgresfixture.md#Kun_Testing_Containers_PostgresFixture_AppConnectionString) 是 `NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS` 的应用角色，验证 RLS 的测试必须用它——
超级用户与 `BYPASSRLS` 角色会绕过 `FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY`，策略对它们不可见（ADR-004）。

```csharp
public sealed class PostgresFixture : ContainerFixture<PostgreSqlContainer>, IAsyncLifetime, IAsyncDisposable
```

# Class S3CompatibleServer

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Testing.Containers` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Testing.Containers`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Testing.Containers)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Testing.Containers](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Testing.Containers.dll

存储集成测试用的 S3 兼容服务容器：RustFS（Apache-2.0）。

```csharp
public sealed class S3CompatibleServer : IAsyncDisposable
```

#### Inheritance

[object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ←
[S3CompatibleServer](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-containers/s3compatibleserver.md)

#### Implements

[IAsyncDisposable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iasyncdisposable)

#### Inherited Members

[object.GetType()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gettype),
[object.ToString()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.tostring),
[object.Equals(object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object\)),
[object.Equals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.equals#system-object-equals\(system-object-system-object\)),
[object.ReferenceEquals(object?, object?)](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.referenceequals),
[object.GetHashCode()](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object.gethashcode)

## Remarks

镜像钉到版本与摘要。RustFS 项目自己在 GHCR 与 Docker Hub 发布同一个摘要，两处都能匿名拉取，
这里用 GHCR。原来用的 `minio/minio` 已经从 Docker Hub 删除，Quay 上的同名镜像要登录才能拉。

存储测试用到的 S3 能力它都支持并照规范校验：SigV4 头签名（含带尾部校验和的 aws-chunked 流式上传）、
预签名 PUT 与 GET（AWSSDK 对自定义端点生成的是 SigV2 查询签名；含 `response-content-disposition`
覆盖）、对象的 Content-Type 与 Content-Disposition、ListObjectsV2，以及浏览器表单上传（POST Object）
的 SigV4 签名策略与 `content-length-range` 条件：超限时返回 400（EntityTooLarge），对象不落盘。

# Namespace Kun.Testing.EntityFrameworkCore.Outbox

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Testing.EntityFrameworkCore` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Testing.EntityFrameworkCore`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Testing.EntityFrameworkCore)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。

### Classes

[OutboxAssertions](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing-entityframeworkcore-outbox/outboxassertions.md)

Fluent assertion extensions for EF-persisted [OutboxMessage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/outboxmessage.md)
state. Helpers come in two overload families:
one on [`IEnumerable`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ienumerable-1) of [OutboxMessage](/sdk/api/kun/kun-eventbus-outbox/outboxmessage.md) for
tests that already hold a pre-queried snapshot, and one on
[`DbContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.entityframeworkcore.dbcontext) for the one-liner case. On mismatch, helpers
throw [KunAssertionException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-testing/kunassertionexception.md) with a precise message that
includes the helper name, expected `eventTypeId`, observed count,
and the distinct event-type IDs actually present (so the failure
message tells the consumer what WAS staged, not just what wasn't).
See ADR-015 §F3.

# Namespace Kun.Validation.Behaviors

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Validation` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Validation`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Validation)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

### Classes

[ValidationPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/validationpipelinebehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior that runs every registered [IValidator\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation/ivalidator-1.md) against the
incoming request and throws [ErrorException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorexception.md) if any report errors. The carried
[Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md) has code [PlatformErrors.InputInvalid](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_InputInvalid) (400) and lists the field errors
(at most 100) in [Error.Errors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md#Kun_Errors_Error_Errors); Kun.Errors.AspNetCore writes it as an ErrorDetail.

For Result-based semantics (returning a failed `Result` carrying the same error instead of
throwing), register [ValidationResultPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TValue>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/validationresultpipelinebehavior-2.md) instead.

[ValidationResultPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TValue>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/validationresultpipelinebehavior-2.md)

Pipeline behavior that runs every registered [IValidator\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation/ivalidator-1.md)
against the incoming request and returns a failed [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md)
carrying [PlatformErrors.InputInvalid](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_InputInvalid) with the field errors (at most 100)
instead of throwing when any report errors. Companion to the
exception-throwing [ValidationPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/validationpipelinebehavior-2.md)
for handlers that deliberately compose via [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md)
and want validation failures to surface through the normal
railway pipeline (see `docs/architecture/ADR-011-Result-async-extensions.md`
and `docs/architecture/ADR-014-Validation-Result-behavior.md`).

[ValidationResultPipelineBehavior\<TRequest>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/validationresultpipelinebehavior-1.md)

Non-generic variant of
[ValidationResultPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TValue>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/validationresultpipelinebehavior-2.md) for
handlers whose response is the non-generic [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md)
(void commands with no return value). Returns a failed [Result](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result.md)
carrying [PlatformErrors.InputInvalid](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_InputInvalid) with the field errors
instead of throwing when validators report errors. Closes ADR-014
§F1 follow-up.

# Class ValidationPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Validation` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Validation`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Validation)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Validation.Behaviors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Validation.dll

Pipeline behavior that runs every registered [IValidator\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation/ivalidator-1.md) against the
incoming request and throws [ErrorException](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/errorexception.md) if any report errors. The carried
[Error](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md) has code [PlatformErrors.InputInvalid](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_InputInvalid) (400) and lists the field errors
(at most 100) in [Error.Errors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/error.md#Kun_Errors_Error_Errors); Kun.Errors.AspNetCore writes it as an ErrorDetail.

For Result-based semantics (returning a failed `Result` carrying the same error instead of
throwing), register [ValidationResultPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TValue>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/validationresultpipelinebehavior-2.md) instead.

```csharp
public sealed class ValidationPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse> : IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse> where TRequest : IRequest<TResponse>
```

# Class ValidationResultPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TValue>

:::info 生成页
本页由 DocFX 从 nuget.org 上 `Kun.Validation` 2026.11.24 的 XML 注释生成，源码在 kun 仓库 [`src/Kun.Validation`](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/tree/v2026.11.24/src/Kun.Validation)（`v2026.11.24`）。Kun 文档与代码不一致处以代码为准（[ADR-001 D1.8](/design/adr/adr-001-kun-relationship.md)）；平台集成方式见[内核与平台组件](/sdk/kun/with-qian.md)。
:::

Namespace: [Kun.Validation.Behaviors](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/index.md)\
Assembly: Kun.Validation.dll

Pipeline behavior that runs every registered [IValidator\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation/ivalidator-1.md)
against the incoming request and returns a failed [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md)
carrying [PlatformErrors.InputInvalid](/sdk/api/kun/kun-errors/platformerrors.md#Kun_Errors_PlatformErrors_InputInvalid) with the field errors (at most 100)
instead of throwing when any report errors. Companion to the
exception-throwing [ValidationPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/validationpipelinebehavior-2.md)
for handlers that deliberately compose via [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md)
and want validation failures to surface through the normal
railway pipeline (see `docs/architecture/ADR-011-Result-async-extensions.md`
and `docs/architecture/ADR-014-Validation-Result-behavior.md`).

```csharp
public sealed class ValidationResultPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TValue> : IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, Result<TValue>> where TRequest : IRequest<Result<TValue>>
```

#### Type Parameters

`TRequest`

The request type being validated.

`TValue`

The success value carried by the handler's [Result\<T>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-core-results/result-1.md).

Register per request type via

do **not** register alongside [ValidationPipelineBehavior\<TRequest, TResponse>](/sdk/api/kun/kun-validation-behaviors/validationpipelinebehavior-2.md)
for the same request — pick one.

# qian 命令

> 本页由构建脚本同步自 [组件模型规格 §9](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md)（仓库 `docs/prd/specs/component-model.md`），不另写；请修改规格源文件。

## 9.1 命令与参数

全局参数：`--profile <name>`（默认 `.qian/config.yml` 的 `defaultProfile`）、`--cwd <dir>`、`--json`、`--verbose`、`--yes`。实现：单一 Node / TypeScript 实现、发布到 npm，前置 Node ≥ 22；`dotnet qian` 薄包装（只负责定位并调用 Node 版 CLI、缺 Node 时给出安装提示）为 S1 可选 P2（ADR-020 §7 第 3 条，→ §13）；命令、参数与行为不依赖实现语言。遥测默认不采集，S2 提供 opt-in `qian telemetry on`（ADR-020 §7 第 7 条，→ §13）。

| 命令 | 参数 | 作用 |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `qian init --template <stack>` | `<stack>`：`dotnet-webapi`（standalone profile 的 ASP.NET Core 项目）、`dotnet-platform`（platform 宿主）、`ts-shell`（前端框架外壳）、`skill-only`（只含 `skills/` 的组件仓库）、`component-dotnet` / `component-ts`（带代码组件骨架）；`--id`、`--name` | 生成 `.qian/config.yml`、`profiles/<p>/qian.profile.yml`、`.qian-plugin/plugin.json`、`README.md` / `AGENTS.md` 骨架、TCK 配置 |
| `qian add <ref>…` | `<ref>` = `<name>[@<version>]` / `<market>/<name>[@<version>]` / 本地路径 / URL；`--from <market>`、`--scope <scope>`（写租户 scope patch，需平台连接）、`--surfaces skills,commands`（只装部分表面）、`--no-code`、`--force-profile`、`--allow-unverified`、`--force`、`--reset-config`、`--dry-run` | 安装（§9.3） |
| `qian remove <ref>…` | `--purge`、`--scope <scope>` | 卸载（§9.4） |
| `qian list` | `--outdated`、`--markets`、`--surfaces`、`--scope <scope>` | 列出已安装组件（来源、版本、digest、表面、条目）；`--outdated` 对比市场最新版 |
| `qian doctor` | `--fix`（可自动修复：缺失默认 config、过期 lock、表面指针）、`--manifest <path>`（只校验一个组件）、`--migrate-manifest <qian-plugin.yaml>` | 健康检查：§10.1 全部校验 + 依赖等待 / 环路 / 缺失 Provider / digest 不符 / `secretRef` 不可解析 / 文档新鲜度 |
| `qian dump-config` | §7.5 | 打印插件树 |
| `qian dev` | `--profile`、`--watch`（声明式表面热重载）、`--aspire`（拉起 PG / Redis / RabbitMQ / Apollo 容器） | 代码部分：本机运行当前 profile 的宿主，取代 v1 `qian plugin dev`（R33） |
| `qian pack` | `--out <dir>` | 代码部分：构建 NuGet / npm 包（组件文件夹进包的 `qian/`）、`service` 的 OCI 制品与文件 digest 清单、SBOM；运行 §10.1 校验（R33） |
| `qian sign` | `--key <ref>` | 代码部分：OCI 制品 cosign 分离签名；组件文件夹 digest 清单 Ed25519 分离签名（沿 v1 §4.2） |
| `qian publish` | `--market <name>`、`--channel stable\|preview` | 代码部分：推送包 / 制品，并向市场仓库提交或更新 marketplace 条目（PR 或直接提交，按市场仓库策略） |

CLI 动词定稿为以上十个，没有 `plugin` 名词（R33）：`add \| remove \| list \| doctor \| dump-config \| init` 面向安装与运维，`dev \| pack \| sign \| publish` 面向代码部分。

## 9.2 `npx qian@latest` 一键形式

这是最初设计的公开 npm 调用形式。本工作区实际使用私有 `qian` 包，安装依赖后执行 `pnpm exec qian`。

```text
npx qian@latest [--skill <name>]… [--agent <name>]… [--command <name>]… [--mcp <name>]… [--plugin <name>]… [--profile <p>] [--from <market>] [--yes]
```

| 参数 | 等价 |
| ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--plugin <name>` | `qian add <name>` |
| `--skill <name>` | `qian add <name> --surfaces skills --no-code`；`<name>` 为 `<component>/<skill>` 时只复制该技能目录 |
| `--agent` / `--command` / `--mcp <name>` | 同上，分别只装 `agents` / `commands` / `mcpServers` 表面 |
| `--yes` | 跳过 `installation: confirm` 的确认 |

各 flag 可重复、可并列；没有构建步骤，组合就是多个 flag 并列（ADR-020 §1 对标项目做法一）。

## 9.3 安装过程（`qian add`）

```text
1 Resolve  按 §8.3 在市场定位条目 → 按 source 取得组件文件夹（local 直接读；url 下载归档；git-subdir 浅克隆到缓存）
2 Verify   市场签名（§11.5）→ source.digest 与实际内容 → 读 plugin.json → Schema + 语义校验（§10.1）
           → tier × form × sandbox（§11.1）→ engines 与宿主实际还原的版本比对（kun 读 NuGet 还原记录里的 Kun.Core，qian 读 npm 安装的 @cavailab/qian-core）
3 Plan     计算并打印变更集：
           · 复制到 .qian/plugins/<component-id>/ 的表面文件（skills、agents、commands、hooks、.mcp.json、tools、metadata、schemas、assets、README、AGENTS）
           · 加入的 NuGet（dotnet add package）/ npm（npm i）依赖 = runtime.nuget[] / npm[]（--no-code 跳过）
           · 写入 profiles/<p>/qian.patch.yml 的条目：id = 组件短名（qian.files → files），config = configSchema 的 default 合成
           · policy.permissions 与 secretRef 需求清单（installation: confirm 在此等待确认）
4 Apply    写 .qian/journal/<timestamp>.json（变更集 + 回滚指令）→ 复制 / 加依赖 / 写 patch → 更新 .qian/lock.json
5 Verify   运行 qian doctor 的组件子集 → 打印 defaultPrompt 与「下一步」（待填写的 secretRef、推荐 profile）
```

`.qian/lock.json` 一行记录：

```json
{ "id": "qian.files", "version": "1.0.0", "market": "qian-official", "source": { "type": "local", "path": "./plugins/qian.files" },
  "digest": "sha256:9f2c…", "installedAt": "2026-10-06T08:20:11Z", "surfaces": ["skills", "commands", "hooks", "tools", "metadata", "schemas"],
  "files": [{ "path": "skills/upload-with-policy/SKILL.md", "sha256": "…", "bytes": 2048 }],
  "packages": { "nuget": ["Kun.Files.Abstractions@1.0.0", "Kun.Files@1.0.0"], "npm": ["@qian/files-ui@1.0.0"] },
  "entries": [{ "profile": "platform", "scope": "global", "id": "files" }] }
```

工作区布局：`.qian/config.yml`（市场与默认 profile）、`.qian/lock.json`（必须提交）、`.qian/plugins/<id>/`（复制进来的表面）、`.qian/journal/`（加入 `.gitignore`）、`profiles/<name>/qian.profile.yml` 与 `qian.patch.yml`。

## 9.4 幂等与回滚

- **幂等**：同一 `<name>@<version>` 重复 `add`：比对 lock 中 digest 与文件哈希，一致则无操作返回 0；文件被本地修改过则列出差异并拒绝覆盖（`--force` 覆盖）。不同版本 = 升级：替换表面文件、更新依赖版本、**保留** patch 中既有 `config`（按新 `configSchema` 重新校验，不兼容时打印差异并失败，`--reset-config` 用新默认值重写）。
- **事务与自动回滚**：步骤 4 任一子步骤失败时按 journal 逆序撤销已完成的子步骤（删除已复制文件、移除已加依赖、还原 patch 文件），返回非零；journal 保留最近 20 次。
- **`qian remove`**：按 lock 逆向执行——删除 `.qian/plugins/<id>/`、移除依赖（仅当无其它已安装组件引用同一包）、patch 条目改 `disabled: true`（默认，保留 `config` 便于重装）或整条删除（`--purge`）。
- **git 友好**：全部产出都是工作区文件，任何一步都能用 git 还原。
- **租户 scope**（`--scope tenant:<id>`）：不动工作区，调用管理面 API 写 `scope_patches`（§7.6），`revision` 乐观并发，失败不留半成品。

## 9.5 管理面端点（R33 / R32）

| 前缀 | 提供者 | 内容 |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/api/registry/*` | `qian.registry` | scope 视图 `GET /api/registry/scopes/{scopeKey}/entries[/{entryId}]`（R86；全树视图由 CLI `qian dump-config` 承担，S1 不设 HTTP 全树端点）、scope patch 写入（`PUT /api/registry/tenants/{tenant}/patches/{scope}/{entry}`，已交付单条 `{revision, patch}` 条件写入、过期修订 409 `CONFLICT`，S1-RT-029）、lock 与来源、组件版本的反向权限声明 `GET /api/registry/plugins/{pluginId}/versions/{version}/permissions`（五类取自已校验的制品清单快照，只认已过准入的制品；权限点复用 `qian.registry:scope:read`，注册表权限拆分时再单列，R120 ①）；对未挂载 / 被过滤的组件，持有 `qian.registry:scope:read` 的调用者得到 403 原因码（`PLUGIN_NOT_MOUNTED` 等四个，R32 / R48），其他调用者 404 |
| `/api/lifecycle/*` | `qian.lifecycle` | `mount` / `unmount` / `reload`（声明式表面）、滚动重启请求、`/api/lifecycle/diagnostics`（Pending / Failed / 环路）；反向权限批准 `PUT / GET /api/lifecycle/tenants/{tenantId}/plugins/{pluginId}/versions/{version}/permissions`（R120）：请求体为五类批准内容、整份替换，只能批准该版本声明过的项；租户管理员持 `qian.lifecycle:install:approve`（默认授予 tenant.owner / tenant.admin），平台运营经 Authz 超管旁路代批，两类主体都要求路径租户等于宿主已建立的租户上下文，其余一律 404；批准记录在 Lifecycle 的租户表 `permission_approvals`（与权益是两道门，`qian.entitlement` 只管授予），每次写入与该租户审计链同事务（ADR-009 D9.8）；开通与升级在权益之后核对批准，目标版本没有自己的批准记录时沿用该租户对该组件最近一次的批准，升级只有新增项须重批（D7 的 S1 口径） |
| `/api/capabilities/*` | `qian.capabilities` | 能力目录（工具、事件、实体），鉴权后按 scope 与权限过滤，响应为信封 `contracts/v0/capability-catalog`（`items`、`ttlMs`、`cacheScope: private`）；`/api/capabilities/openapi.json` 聚合 |
| `POST /api/capabilities/{plugin}/{name}/invoke` | `qian.capabilities` | 通用执行入口（R75）：每次重做与目录同款的判定，不可见与不存在一样 404；请求体先按条目 `inputSchema`（JSON Schema 2020-12）校验，不符返回 400 `INPUT_INVALID`，`errors[]` 带输入 JSON Pointer；请求体读不成确定的 JSON 值（成员重名、孤立的 UTF-16 代理项、绝对值超过 decimal 范围约 7.9e28 的数）返回 400 `BAD_REQUEST`；写类能力可带 `Idempotency-Key`（UUID），同一主体、同一能力、同一键 24 小时内不再执行：回执保存了响应体时返回首次成功响应（`Idempotent-Replayed: true`），按回执策略（见表下）没有保存时返回 409 `CAPABILITY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE`；键相同而输入不同、或同键请求仍在执行，返回 409 `CONFLICT`，失败不留回执，只读能力（`sideEffect: read`）忽略该键；Agent 主体只见 `agent.expose: true` 的能力，S1 不开放 Agent 执行与 Actor 委托；ApiExplorer 不列此通用模板，`openapi.json` 为每个可见能力列出具体路径与 Schema |
| `/api/kernel/*` | 别名 | v1 路径在 S1 内保留为别名，响应带 `Deprecation` 头与 `Link: rel="successor-version"`，S2 移除 |

全部管理面端点只在 `platform` profile 存在，受 `qian.authz` 的 PEP 保护；业务与模型表面（路由、`ctx.Tools`、能力目录、菜单）对未挂载 / 被过滤的组件一律 404（R32）。

**执行入口的回执策略与登记期检查**（S1-RT-020）：幂等回执只在条目 `dataClassification` 为 `public` / `internal`、且响应体不超过组件配置 `receiptMaxBytes`（UTF-8 字节，默认 65536，取值 0–1048576）时保存响应体；`pii` / `finance` / `secret`（及未知分级）与超限的响应只记「已执行」和原因（`data_classification` / `response_too_large`），回放窗口内同键请求返回 409 `CAPABILITY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE` 且不再执行。组件作者要按响应内容标注能力的 `dataClassification`：SDK 默认 `internal`，即默认保存响应体；响应含个人信息、财务或机密数据的能力标为 `pii` / `finance` / `secret`（参考应用响应含客户名称的 `customer.*` 能力标为 `pii`）。回执表另以检查约束限定响应体不超过 1 MiB，迁移以 `NOT VALID` 添加、只约束新写入：存量超限行会让带校验的约束失败，而迁移属主在 FORCE RLS 下删不掉这些行；DDL 校验本身不经 RLS。回执过期后不再回放，物理删除靠本租户后续带键写调用登记时的惰性清理（每次最多 100 行）；长期没有带键写调用的租户由运维清理（运维手册给出 SQL）。条目在能力登记（`ctx.ProvideCapability`）时生成并预编译输入校验器：输入含租户字段、Schema 无法可靠校验（`patternProperties` / `dependentSchemas` 键含 `/` 或 `~`、`$ref` 找不到目标、`enum` / `const` 取值含超出 decimal 范围的数、无法编译）的契约在登记阶段以带组件 ID、能力名与 JSON Pointer 的异常拒绝，组件挂载失败，执行入口不会因此返回 500。登记期检查由宿主调用 `AddKunCapabilities()` 装配，platform profile 宿主必须调用，否则退化为首次读目录或调用时才编译。

# 组件清单 plugin.json

> 本页由构建脚本同步自 [组件模型规格 §3](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md)（仓库 `docs/prd/specs/component-model.md`），不另写；请修改规格源文件。

清单文件名与格式已定稿：`.qian-plugin/plugin.json`（JSON，便于 JSON Schema 校验与源生成器合并）；profile 与 patch 继续用 YAML（人手编辑、需要注释）；`qian doctor --migrate-manifest` 负责从 v1 `qian-plugin.yaml` 迁移（ADR-020 §7 第 2 条，已拍板）。

## 3.1 示例 A：带代码的组件 `qian.files`

`ctx.Files` 的 S1 Provider（§6.2），`runtime.form: module`，由 `Kun.Files` 实现，当前文件服务接入 `Kun.Storage.Local`。下例的其它后端及前端包展示目标清单格式，实际生效的入口和依赖见[文件组件清单](https://github.com/CavaiLAB/kun/blob/main/plugins/qian.files/.qian-plugin/plugin.json)。

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://qian.dev/schemas/plugin/v2",
  "id": "qian.files",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "多租户文件服务：租户前缀、配额、上传策略、文件元数据与预览票据；存储后端可选本地盘 / S3 / OSS",
  "author": { "name": "Qian Platform Team", "url": "https://docs.example.internal/qian" },
  "license": "MIT",
  "engines": { "kun": ">=2026.9", "qian": "^1.0" },
  "interface": {
    "displayName": "文件存储",
    "category": "storage",
    "defaultPrompt": ["把这份合同扫描件上传到当前租户，并给我一个 24 小时有效的下载链接", "列出本租户本月上传量最大的 10 个文件"],
    "icon": "./assets/icon.svg",
    "brandColor": "#0F766E",
    "screenshots": ["./assets/shot-upload.png"]
  },
  "surfaces": { "skills": "./skills", "commands": "./commands", "hooks": "./hooks/hooks.json", "tools": "./tools",
                "ui": "./ui/manifest.json", "metadata": "./metadata", "schemas": "./schemas" },
  "runtime": {
    "form": "module",
    "nuget": [{ "id": "Kun.Files.Abstractions", "version": "1.0.0" }, { "id": "Kun.Files", "version": "1.0.0" }],
    "npm": [{ "name": "@qian/files-ui", "version": "1.0.0" }],
    "entry": "Kun.Files.FilesPlugin, Kun.Files",
    "configSchema": "./schemas/config.schema.json",
    "dbSchema": "plugin_qian_files"
  },
  "inject": ["Tenancy", "Config", "Authz", "Events", "Audit"],
  "provides": ["Files"],
  "policy": {
    "tier": "system", "sandbox": "none", "authentication": "ON_INSTALL", "profiles": ["platform", "standalone"],
    "egress": ["oss-cn-hangzhou.example.internal:443"],
    "permissions": { "platform": ["tenant:read", "audit:write"], "data": ["qian.identity.server:member"],
                     "secrets": [{ "name": "oss/*", "scope": "platform" }], "ui": { "connectSrc": [] } }
  },
  "scopes": ["global", "tenant"]
}
```

`schemas/config.schema.json` 节选——`x-qian-sensitive: true` 的属性只接受 `secretRef://…`（§11.3）：

```json
{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["storage"],
  "properties": {
    "storage": { "type": "object", "required": ["kind"], "properties": {
      "kind": { "enum": ["local", "s3", "oss"] }, "root": { "type": "string" }, "bucket": { "type": "string" }, "endpoint": { "type": "string" },
      "accessKey": { "type": "string", "x-qian-sensitive": true }, "secretKey": { "type": "string", "x-qian-sensitive": true } } },
    "quota": { "type": "object", "properties": { "perTenantBytes": { "type": "integer", "default": 10737418240 } } } } }
```

## 3.2 示例 B：无代码的 skill-only 组件

只教 Agent「如何做租户上线核对」的技能包：没有 `runtime`，安装只复制 `skills/` 与 `commands/`；`community` tier 也能发布。`inject[]` 仍有意义——声明技能正文会用到哪些服务键的工具，装载器在这些键未就绪的 scope 里不暴露该技能，`qian doctor` 据此检查目标 profile 是否满足依赖。

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://qian.dev/schemas/plugin/v2",
  "id": "com.example.skills.tenant-onboarding",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "租户上线核对技能：按清单检查身份连接器、默认角色、文件配额与通知渠道是否就绪",
  "author": { "name": "Example Ops", "email": "ops@example.com" },
  "license": "MIT",
  "interface": { "displayName": "租户上线核对", "category": "operations", "brandColor": "#7C3AED",
                 "defaultPrompt": ["用 tenant-onboarding 技能检查租户 t-001 是否可以上线"] },
  "surfaces": { "skills": "./skills", "commands": "./commands" },
  "inject": ["Tenancy", "Identity", "Files"],
  "provides": [],
  "policy": { "tier": "community", "sandbox": "none", "authentication": "ON_INSTALL", "profiles": ["platform"] },
  "scopes": ["global", "tenant", "agent-session"]
}
```

## 3.3 示例 C：组合包 `qian.bundle.base`

`platform` profile 的 base 组合包（R31，§7.7）：无 `runtime.form`，示例以 `runtime.nuget[]` 表达有包实现的部分，`config/qian.patch.yml`（§7.3）插入条目，`skills/`、`commands/`、`hooks/` 携带平台运维表面。

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://qian.dev/schemas/plugin/v2",
  "id": "qian.bundle.base",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "base 组合包：原 18 个平台插件按 seam 拆包——注册表、生命周期、能力目录、钩子桥接、租户、身份客户端、鉴权、数据、文件、配置、事件、审计、可观测、通知、调度、实时、授权 v0",
  "author": { "name": "Qian Platform Team" },
  "license": "MIT",
  "engines": { "kun": ">=2026.9" },
  "interface": { "displayName": "平台 base 组合包", "category": "bundle", "icon": "./assets/icon.svg" },
  "surfaces": { "patch": "./config/qian.patch.yml", "skills": "./skills", "commands": "./commands", "hooks": "./hooks/hooks.json" },
  "runtime": {
    "nuget": [
      { "id": "Kun.Registry", "version": "1.0.0" }, { "id": "Kun.Lifecycle", "version": "1.0.0" },
      { "id": "Kun.Capabilities", "version": "1.0.0" },
      { "id": "Kun.Tenancy", "version": "1.0.0" }, { "id": "Kun.Identity.Client", "version": "1.0.0" },
      { "id": "Kun.Authorization.Rbac", "version": "1.0.0" }, { "id": "Kun.Data", "version": "1.0.0" }, { "id": "Kun.Data.Dialect.Pg", "version": "1.0.0" },
      { "id": "Kun.Files", "version": "1.0.0" }, { "id": "Kun.Configuration.Apollo", "version": "1.0.0" }, { "id": "Kun.EventBus.EntityFrameworkCore", "version": "1.0.0" },
      { "id": "Kun.Audit.EntityFrameworkCore", "version": "1.0.0" }, { "id": "Kun.Observability", "version": "1.0.0" },
      { "id": "Kun.Scheduler", "version": "1.0.0" }
    ]
  },
  "inject": [], "provides": [],
  "policy": { "tier": "system", "sandbox": "none", "authentication": "ON_INSTALL", "profiles": ["platform"] },
  "scopes": ["global"]
}
```

## 3.4 字段逐项表

分级：S1 = S1 校验器与宿主都消费；S2 / S3 = 校验器接受结构、宿主到该阶段才消费语义（低阶段宿主输出 `warning: field reserved for S2+`，沿 v1 D10）。

**根与标识**

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 | 分级 |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -- |
| `$schema` | `const "https://qian.dev/schemas/plugin/v2"` | 否 | 编辑器提示；版本以文件路径 `.qian-plugin/plugin.json` 为准 | S1 |
| `id` | `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)+$`，≤ 128 | 是 | 反向域名，发布后不可改；`qian.` 前缀保留给官方组件 | S1 |
| `version` | SemVer 2.0 | 是 | 与 Kun CalVer 独立 | S1 |
| `description` | `string`，10–500 字 | 是 | 面向人；模型看 `skills` / `tools` 的描述 | S1 |
| `author` | `{ name, email?, url? }` | 是 | 市场的 `publisher.verified` 在 S3 另行维护，不在清单 | S1 |
| `license` | SPDX 或 `LicenseRef-*` | 是 | 现有平台组件清单的许可为 MIT（→ §13 第 6 条），官方组件写 `MIT`；S3 商业组件的许可证另定 | S1 |
| `engines` | `{ kun?, qian? }` 版本范围 | 否 | `kun` 对应包含 `Kun.Runtime` 在内的后端 CalVer，清单含 `runtime.nuget` 时必填。`qian` 对应 Qian 前端框架的 SemVer，声明 UI 表面时必填，与 UI 清单中的 `engines.qian` 一致。 | S1 |

**展示（`interface`）**

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 | 分级 |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- | -- | ------------------ | -- |
| `displayName` | `string` ≤ 40 字 | 是 | 市场与目录显示名 | S1 |
| `category` | `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` | 是 | 分类短名；官方分类目录由市场仓库维护 | S1 |
| `defaultPrompt[]` | ≤ 5 条 | 否 | 安装后展示给用户的首批提示词 | S1 |
| `icon` / `screenshots[]` | `assets/` 下相对路径 | 否 | 截图 ≤ 6 张 | S1 |
| `brandColor` | `^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$` | 否 | 品牌色 | S1 |
| `locales` | `{ [locale]: { displayName?, description? } }` | 否 | 多语言；S1 只校验结构 | S3 |

**表面指针（`surfaces`）**——相对组件根；省略取默认；指向不存在的路径是 error。

| 字段 | 默认 | 指向 |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `skills` / `agents` / `commands` / `tools` / `metadata` / `schemas` | `./skills` 等同名目录 | 目录；`metadata/` 承载本组件定义的权限点、默认角色、事件、消息类型——已裁决（R37） |
| `hooks` / `mcpServers` / `ui` / `patch` | `./hooks/hooks.json` / `./.mcp.json` / `./ui/manifest.json` / `./config/qian.patch.yml` | 文件 |

**运行时（`runtime`）**——无代码组件省略整个对象。

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 | 分级 |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `form` | `module \| service \| function \| ui \| package` | 有 `src/` 时是 | 代码的物理形态（v1 `kind` 退化而来，§3.6）：进程内程序集 / 独立工作负载 / Wasm 函数 / 仅前端远程模块 / 低代码元数据包。组合包不写；连接器组件按实现取 `module` 或 `service`（R28） | S1（`function`、`package` S2） |
| `nuget[]` / `npm[]` | `{ id \| name, version, digest? }[]` | 否 | 精确版本；`digest` 为包内容 `sha256:`，S1 可选、S3 第三方必填 | S1 |
| `entry` | `string` | `module` 时是 | .NET `"<Type>, <Assembly>"`（实现 `IKunPlugin`）；TS 为 npm 包导出名（默认 `default`） | S1 |
| `image` | `^oci://.+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$` | `service` 时是 | 只接受 digest 引用（ADR-002 D2.7）；`service{ protocols, resources, health }` 沿 v1 `components.service` | S1 |
| `wasm` / `limits` | `…@sha256:…` / `{ fuel, memoryMiB, timeoutMs }` | `function` 时是 | 预留 | S2 |
| `configSchema` | 相对路径 | 有 config 时是 | JSON Schema 2020-12；装载器在 `Apply` 前校验 | S1 |
| `dbSchema` | `^plugin_[a-z0-9_]+$` | 否 | 默认 `plugin_<id 以下划线连接>` | S1 |

**依赖、提供、作用域**

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 | 分级 |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -- |
| `inject[]` | 服务键数组，每项 `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*(\.[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)?$` | 是（可空） | 依赖的服务键：`<Key>`（单例 seam）或 `<Key>.<Registry>:<name>`（注册表 seam 的某个具名注册，R38）；全部就绪才 `Apply`；装载顺序由此推导 | S1 |
| `optionalInject[]` | 同上 | 否 | 可选依赖：缺失时仍 `Apply`，`TryInject` 为空 | S1 |
| `provides[]` | 同上 | 是（可空） | `Apply` 时会 `Provide` 的键，或向注册表子服务 `Register(name, …)` 的「注册表键:名称」（R38）；与 `inject` 不相交；代码组件由源生成器派生 | S1 |
| `scopes[]` | `global \| tenant \| app \| agent-session` 非空数组 | 是 | 允许挂载的 scope 种类；条目 `scope` 不在列表内即失败；`["global"]` = 只能作为全局条目挂载 | S1 |

**策略（`policy`）**

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 | 分级 |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- |
| `tier` | `system \| official \| partner \| private \| community` | 是 | 信任等级（ADR-002 D2.4）；决定允许的 `form`、`sandbox`、hooks 类型与进程边界（§11.1） | S1 |
| `sandbox` | `none \| worker \| iframe \| wasm \| workload` | 是 | `none` 共享进程 / 外壳直接加载；`worker` / `iframe` 不可信 UI；`wasm` 函数；`workload` 独立工作负载 | S1 |
| `authentication` | `ON_INSTALL \| ON_USE` | 是 | 安装时一次性批准反向权限与密钥，或首次使用时由当前用户授权（S3 连接器组件） | S1（`ON_USE` S3） |
| `profiles[]` | `string[]` | 否 | 推荐 / 允许的 profile；不在列表的 profile 安装需 `--force-profile` | S1 |
| `required` | `boolean`，默认 `false` | 否 | `true` = 该组件的条目不可被任何 scope patch 禁用或遮蔽，`qian remove` 拒绝卸载（取代 v1 `alwaysEnabled`，R34）；只允许 `tier: system` | S1 |
| `egress[]` | `string[]`，每项 `<host>[:<port>]`（host 可含 `*.` 前缀） | 否；连接器组件必填 | 允许的出网目标（R28）；为空 = 默认拒绝出网（NetworkPolicy / 出口代理）；`hooks.json`、`.mcp.json` 的 `url` 域名必须在其中 | S1 |
| `permissions` | `{ platform[], data[], secrets[], ui{ connectSrc[] } }` | 否 | 反向权限，沿 v1 `permissions.*` 保留（含义见 `plugin-manifest.md` §3.2；v1 `permissions.egress` 升为 `policy.egress`）；形状以 permissions/v2 Schema 为准：`platform`、`data`、`ui.connectSrc` 为字符串数组（v1 的 `data` 对象形状 `{ entity, access }` 不再使用），`secrets` 项为 `{ name, scope: platform \| tenant \| dev }`（R120 ⑥）；开通时列出并批准，升级新增即重批（S1 口径见 §9.5）。落点已裁决（R37） | S1 |

根对象 `additionalProperties: false`，接受 `^x-` 自定义字段。

## 3.5 JSON Schema 2020-12 骨架

完整 Schema 随 CLI 发布并托管在 `https://qian.dev/schemas/plugin/v2`；骨架如下（省略 `description`）。`tier × form × sandbox` 联合约束、`inject ∩ provides = ∅`、指针路径存在、`secretRef` 只出现在 `x-qian-sensitive` 属性等属于语义校验（§10.1），不写进 Schema。

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://qian.dev/schemas/plugin/v2",
  "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "patternProperties": { "^x-": {} },
  "required": ["id", "version", "description", "author", "license", "interface", "inject", "provides", "policy", "scopes"],
  "properties": {
    "$schema": { "const": "https://qian.dev/schemas/plugin/v2" },
    "id": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(\\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)+$", "maxLength": 128 },
    "version": { "$ref": "#/$defs/semver" },
    "description": { "type": "string", "minLength": 10, "maxLength": 500 },
    "author": { "type": "object", "required": ["name"], "additionalProperties": false,
                "properties": { "name": { "type": "string" }, "email": { "type": "string", "format": "email" }, "url": { "type": "string", "format": "uri" } } },
    "license": { "type": "string" },
    "engines": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
                 "properties": { "qian": { "type": "string" }, "kun": { "type": "string" } } },
    "interface": { "type": "object", "required": ["displayName", "category"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": { "displayName": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 40 }, "category": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$" },
        "defaultPrompt": { "type": "array", "maxItems": 5, "items": { "type": "string" } }, "icon": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" },
        "brandColor": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$" }, "screenshots": { "type": "array", "maxItems": 6, "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" } },
        "locales": { "type": "object" } } },
    "surfaces": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": { "skills": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" }, "agents": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" }, "commands": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" },
        "hooks": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" }, "mcpServers": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" }, "tools": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" },
        "ui": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" }, "metadata": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" }, "schemas": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" }, "patch": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" } } },
    "runtime": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "form": { "enum": ["module", "service", "function", "ui", "package"] },
        "nuget": { "type": "array", "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/pkgRef" } }, "npm": { "type": "array", "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/pkgRef" } },
        "entry": { "type": "string" }, "image": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^oci://.+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$" }, "service": { "type": "object" },
        "wasm": { "type": "string", "pattern": "@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$" }, "limits": { "type": "object" },
        "configSchema": { "$ref": "#/$defs/relPath" }, "dbSchema": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^plugin_[a-z0-9_]+$" } },
      "allOf": [
        { "if": { "properties": { "form": { "const": "module" } }, "required": ["form"] }, "then": { "required": ["entry"] } },
        { "if": { "properties": { "form": { "const": "service" } }, "required": ["form"] }, "then": { "required": ["image"] } },
        { "if": { "properties": { "form": { "const": "function" } }, "required": ["form"] }, "then": { "required": ["wasm"] } } ] },
    "inject": { "$ref": "#/$defs/serviceKeys" }, "optionalInject": { "$ref": "#/$defs/serviceKeys" }, "provides": { "$ref": "#/$defs/serviceKeys" },
    "policy": { "type": "object", "required": ["tier", "sandbox", "authentication"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": { "tier": { "enum": ["system", "official", "partner", "private", "community"] },
        "sandbox": { "enum": ["none", "worker", "iframe", "wasm", "workload"] }, "authentication": { "enum": ["ON_INSTALL", "ON_USE"] },
        "required": { "type": "boolean", "default": false },
        "egress": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^(\\*\\.)?[a-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]{1,5})?$" } },
        "profiles": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "permissions": { "$ref": "https://qian.dev/schemas/plugin/v2/permissions" } } },
    "scopes": { "type": "array", "minItems": 1, "uniqueItems": true, "items": { "enum": ["global", "tenant", "app", "agent-session"] } }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "semver": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^(0|[1-9]\\d*)\\.(0|[1-9]\\d*)\\.(0|[1-9]\\d*)(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?(\\+[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$" },
    "relPath": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^\\./" },
    "serviceKeys": { "type": "array", "uniqueItems": true,
                     "items": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*(\\.[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)?$" } },
    "pkgRef": { "type": "object", "required": ["version"], "additionalProperties": false,
                "properties": { "id": { "type": "string" }, "name": { "type": "string" }, "version": { "$ref": "#/$defs/semver" },
                                "digest": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$" } } }
  }
}
```

## 3.6 v1 → v2 字段迁移对照

`qian-plugin.yaml` → `.qian-plugin/plugin.json`；CLI `qian doctor --migrate-manifest <qian-plugin.yaml>` 输出 v2 草稿（文件名与格式 → §13 第 2 条）。

| v1 字段 | v2 落点 | 备注 |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemaVersion` | `$schema`（可选） | 版本由文件位置决定 |
| `id` / `version` / `license` | 同名 | 不变 |
| `kind: module \| service \| package \| function \| ui` | `runtime.form` 同名值（`service` 加 `runtime.image`，`function` 加 `runtime.wasm`，`ui` 加 `surfaces.ui`） | 顶层分类改为表面 |
| `kind: connector` | **不是** `runtime.form` 取值。连接器 = 为某个 seam 提供 Provider 的组件：向该 seam 的注册表子服务按名称注册，`provides` 写 `["Identity.Connectors:oidc"]` 这类「注册表键:名称」（R38）+ `policy.egress[]` 声明出网目标（域名 / 端口）；`runtime.form` 按实现取 `module \| service`（R28） | S3 `policy.authentication: ON_USE` 的连接器同此；例见 §6.3 身份连接器 |
| `kind: bundle` + `components{}` | 组合包：有 `config/qian.patch.yml`，可携带多个组件（经 `runtime.nuget[] / npm[]` 引用或内联 `components/<id>/`），无 `runtime.form`；v1 `components` 下各组件各自成为独立组件。应用 = 组合包 + marketplace 条目（R28） | — |
| `role` | 删除 | 由 `provides[]`（Provider）、`inject[]`（Consumer）与表面组合（App）体现 |
| `tier` | `policy.tier` | 枚举不变 |
| `distribution` | S2 低代码表面的属性，不在清单根 | ADR-014 修订后由 `qian.metadata` spec 定义 |
| `displayName` / `description`（多语言映射） | `interface.displayName`、根 `description`；多语言放 `interface.locales` | — |
| `publisher` / `icon` / `links` / `categories` | 删除（S3 市场维护）/ `interface.icon` / `author.url` / `interface.category` | — |
| `engines.*` | `engines.kun`、`engines.qian` | v1 的前端键 `engines.yue` 在 v2 对应 `engines.qian`。v2 的 `engines.kun` 表示后端版本范围，包含平台运行时（§3.4）。 |
| `dependencies[]` | `inject[]` | 依赖服务键而非具体组件（D20.4） |
| `provides.capabilities[]`（含 Agent 字段） | `tools/<name>.json`（§4.6） | `sideEffect`、`policyHint`、`idempotent`、`requiredScopes`、`requiredPermission`、`requiredSecrets`、`dataClassification`、`schemaSha256`、`contractVersion`、`agent{ expose, requiresConfirmation }` 字段名不变 |
| `provides.events` / `permissions` / `defaultRoles` / `messageTypes` | `metadata/events.json` / `permissions.json` / `roles.json` / `message-types.json` | 已裁决（R37） |
| `provides.extensionPoints` / `resources` | 扩展点 = 事件定义（waterfall / bail，D20.3）；`resources` 进 `metadata/`（S2） | — |
| `provides.skills`（S3） | `surfaces.skills`（S1） | 前移 |
| `contributes[]` | `Apply` 中对目标服务键做可逆注册（如 `ctx.Shell().Nav.Add(...)`）；声明式贡献放 `ui/manifest.json`（`pages[].nav`）或 `metadata/` | 插槽 = 服务键上的注册 |
| `components.module.assembly / dbSchema` | `runtime.nuget[]` / `runtime.dbSchema` | — |
| `components.ui.federation / sandbox` | `ui/manifest.json` / `policy.sandbox` | — |
| `permissions.platform / data / secrets / ui` | `policy.permissions.*` | 原样保留；已裁决（R37） |
| `permissions.egress[]` | `policy.egress[]`（`<host>[:<port>]`） | 升为 `policy` 顶层字段（R28） |
| `tenancy.modes / dataIsolation` | 条目 `config`（Provider 自己的配置） | 不再是清单字段 |
| `tenancy.perTenantEnable` / `alwaysEnabled` | `scopes[]` 含 `tenant` / `policy.required: true` | 租户开关 = scope patch（D20.5）；`required` 见 R34 |
| 租户级状态 `Available → Entitled → … Enabled ⇄ Disabled …` | 挂载状态只存 `scope_patches` 行（§7.6）；「买没买」留在 `qian.entitlement` | 不再有 Enabled / Disabled 状态机（R34） |
| `lifecycle.hooks.*` | `Apply` + `ctx.Effect` + 监听 `tenant/*` 事件 | 两层生命周期取消 |
| `lifecycle.migrations.*` | 随 NuGet 包的 EF 迁移（ADR-019 D19.2）；逐租户迁移由 `tenant/provisioned` 监听器执行 | — |
| `config.schema / scopes` | `runtime.configSchema` / `scopes[]` | — |
| `agent.mcp.expose` | `tools/*.json` 的 `agent.expose` 与 `.mcp.json` | — |
| `marketplace.*` | 市场条目（§8），不在清单 | — |
| `audit.emits[]` | `metadata/events.json` 中 `audit: true` 的事件 | — |

***

## 3.7 代码入口与程序集的组件归属（S1-DEC-028）

一个组件 ID 对应一个文件夹、一份 `.qian-plugin/plugin.json` 与一个 `runtime.entry`。一个程序集可以包含多个标注不同 ID 的 `[KunPlugin]` 入口；源生成器分别派生元数据，`qian-plugin check|sync` 按目标清单的 ID 选择。重复 ID、没有匹配入口与跨组件能力归属均须明确失败，不能默认取第一个或把所有组件的 `Inject` / `Provide` 混在一起。

`IKunPlugin` 还被契约包装器、运行时快照适配器及宿主组合子插件使用，这些实现构件不等同于独立可安装组件，不强制生成另一份清单。必须在 SDK 文档与 CI 分类清单中记录其归属，新增实现不得静默漏检。确需多个实现共同构成一个组件时，使用承担依赖与生命周期的单一组合入口；构建期不得执行组件代码推测派生结果。真实入口的 `scopes` 和派生字段仍必须与代码一致，补齐元数据不等于通过真实 `qian add` 验收，`x-skeleton` 的去留继续遵循 S1-DEC-018；platform profile 预装的六个平台组件按 R144 ③ 以平台生产宿主的装配与集成测试为启动证据去标，平台宿主同进程身份分支预装的 `qian.identity.server` 与 `qian.tenancy.signup` 按 R150 ① 同样去标，`qian add` 独立安装另行验收。

---

# 组件文件夹布局

> 本页由构建脚本同步自 [组件模型规格 §2](/design/prd/specs/component-model.md)（仓库 `docs/prd/specs/component-model.md`），不另写；请修改规格源文件。

## 2.1 目录树（ADR-020 D20.6 展开）

```text
<plugin>/
  .qian-plugin/plugin.json      清单（§3）。唯一必需文件
  skills/<name>/SKILL.md        技能：front matter + 正文（§4.1）；同目录可放 references/、scripts/
  agents/<name>.md              子 Agent：front matter + 系统提示（§4.2）
  commands/<name>.md            人类斜杠命令：front matter + 命令体（§4.3）
  hooks/hooks.json              钩子：Agent 宿主事件与 Qian 事件的桥接（§4.4）
  .mcp.json                     MCP 服务器声明（§4.5）
  tools/<name>.json             面向模型的工具描述：代码派生或手写（§4.6）
  ui/manifest.json  ui/dist/    前端框架远程模块：exposes、页面、控件、设置卡（§4.7）
  metadata/                     permissions.json、roles.json、events.json、message-types.json（v1 provides.* 的落点）
  forms/ lists/ flows/ pages/   低代码元数据（S2 起）
  schemas/                      config.schema.json（有 config 的组件必需）与其它 JSON Schema
  config/qian.patch.yml         对其他条目的 patch；组合包用它插入条目（§4.8、§7.4）
  components/<id>/              组合包内联携带的组件（可选；也可经 runtime.nuget / npm 引用，R28）
  assets/                       图标、截图
  README.md  AGENTS.md          README 含「模型体验」「已知限制与延期项」两节（D20.9）
  src/                          可选：.NET 或 TypeScript 代码 → NuGet / npm
```

- 只有 `.qian-plugin/plugin.json` 必需。清单的表面指针（§3.4 `surfaces`）默认即上述路径，使用默认布局时可不写。
- 目录与文件名全部小写短横线（`<name>` 匹配 `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`）；`SKILL.md`、`README.md`、`AGENTS.md` 例外。
- 组件文件夹可以是 git 子目录、npm 包或 NuGet 包内的 `qian/` 内容目录（§7.3），三种载体布局相同；CLI 与装载器以 `.qian-plugin/plugin.json` 的位置为组件根。
- 组件文件夹是**分发形态**，运行态的真相源是注册表（`platform` profile 下为 `qian.registry`，§7.6）；两者用同一校验器（§10.1）；git 修订就是分发版本（R35）。

## 2.2 表面一览

| 表面 | 路径 | 进入的注册表 | 受 scope 过滤 | S1 热重载 |
| ------------ | ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------- |
| `skills` | `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | `ctx.Tools`（kind = skill） | 是 | 是 |
| `agents` | `agents/<name>.md` | `ctx.Agents` | 是 | 是 |
| `commands` | `commands/<name>.md` | `ctx.Commands` | 是 | 是 |
| `hooks` | `hooks/hooks.json` | `ctx.Hooks` | 是 | 是 |
| `mcpServers` | `.mcp.json` | `ctx.McpServers` | 是 | 是 |
| `tools` | `tools/<name>.json` | `ctx.Tools`（kind = tool） | 是 | 手写：是；代码派生：否 |
| `ui` | `ui/manifest.json` | `ctx.Ui`（前端框架外壳） | 是 | 否 |
| `metadata` | `metadata/*.json` | `qian.authz` / `qian.events` / `qian.notify` 各自注册表 | 是 | 是 |
| `schemas` | `schemas/*.schema.json` | 契约仓库 | 否 | 是 |
| `patch` | `config/qian.patch.yml` | 插件树 | 条目自带 `scope` | 是 |
| 低代码表面 | `forms/ lists/ flows/ pages/` | S2 定义 | 是 | S2 定义 |

## 2.3 无代码组件与带代码组件

- **无代码组件**：无 `src/`，清单无 `runtime.form`。安装只做「复制表面 + 写 patch」，任何 tier 都可发布（§11.1）。典型：只带 `skills/` 的运维技能包、只带 `config/qian.patch.yml` 的环境配置包、只带 `metadata/roles.json` 的角色模板包。
- **带代码组件**：有 `src/`，`runtime.form ∈ { module, service, function, ui, package }`，`runtime.nuget[] / npm[]` 列出发布后的包。代码部分的清单字段（`runtime.entry`、`inject`、`provides`、代码派生的 `tools/*.json`、`configSchema`）由源生成器派生并**合并进同一份 `plugin.json`**（D20.6：不再有手写与派生两份文件）；CI 比对派生结果与仓库清单，漂移即失败（§10.3 G1）。
